BEGIN

 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(-1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

/* CHK-DCLTN-B4-CLR */
BEGIN

/*
 IF CHK_DCLTN_B4_DISPLAY = 0 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF :SYSTEM.CURRENT_FORM = 'DCLN2295' THEN

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2220_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2220_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2220_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

/* CGBS$MULTIPLE_MASTER_O_P_D */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
DECLARE
 start_item CONSTANT VARCHAR2(61) := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM;
 start_level CONSTANT NUMBER := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
BEGIN
 IF ( get_record_property( get_block_property('DCLTN_HDR', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DCLTN_HDR', STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT')) THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 5;
 CGBS$.COORD_RELATION( find_relation( 'DCLTN_HDR.CGFK$DCLTN_INV_DCLTN_FK'), :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
 IF (( get_record_property( get_block_property('DCLTN_INVOICES', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DCLTN_INVOICES', STATUS) IN ('CHANGED', 'QUERY'))
 ) THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_RELATION( find_relation( 'DCLTN_HDR.CGFK$DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_FK'), :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM != start_item) THEN
 go_item(start_item);
 END IF;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := start_level;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := start_level;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 DO_CHECK BOOLEAN;
 v_inv_type NUMBER(3);--CR-7757
BEGIN
 -- THE FIELD IS MANDATORY AND MUST HAVE ZERO NOT NULL
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS, 0) <= 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS := 0;
 END IF;

 -- WHEN DOES THE VALUE MUST BE GREATER THAN 0?
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/*IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN.DT_IR AND
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE = DCLTN.IT_CIF AND
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD <> DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 DO_CHECK := FALSE;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE = DCLTN.IT_EXCEP THEN*/
 -- CR-7757
 IF get_setting_cr_7757 = 1 THEN
 IF get_port_type IN (1,2) THEN -- SEA and DRY
 v_inv_type := 12;--CIF
 ELSE
 v_inv_type := 17;--CIP
 END IF;
 ELSE
 v_inv_type := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CIF');--old CIF
 END IF;
 -- end CR-7757
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = V_INV_TYPE AND -- CR-7757 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CIF') AND -- 5 CIF
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CIF') AND
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 DO_CHECK := FALSE;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_EXCEP') THEN
--&&& END
 DO_CHECK := FALSE;
 ELSE
 DO_CHECK := TRUE;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS = 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 -- CHECK IF THE VALUE IS VALID
 IF DO_CHECK = TRUE THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 40, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD, 0) = 0 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD := DCLTN.KSA;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA');
--&&& END
 SELECT CURCY_ARBC_NAME
 INTO :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_NAME
 FROM CURRENCIES
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- WHERE CURCY_CD = DCLTN.KSA;
 WHERE CURCY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA');
--&&& END
 END IF;
 END IF; -- DO_CHECK = TRUE
 ELSE
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE <> DCLTN.IT_EXCEP THEN
 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_EXCEP') THEN
--&&& END
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS = 0

 -- BY SHERIFT 03-03-2005--
 :PARAMETER.P_NEED_PRINT :=1;
 -- --
 :GLOBAL.INV_UPDT :=1;

END;

 BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.DO_RECALC := 1;
END;

DECLARE
 FRT_PCTG NUMBER;
BEGIN
 FRT_PCTG := NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG, 0);

 -- IF PERCENTAGE IS OUT OF RANGE, FAIL
 IF FRT_PCTG < 0 OR FRT_PCTG > 100 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 70, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- ENABLE/DISABLE FREIGHT CONTROLS
 IF FRT_PCTG = 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS', TRUE);
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS * FRT_PCTG / 100;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_NAME := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_NAME;

 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS', TRUE);
 END IF;--CR-7757

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_BILL_CHARGE NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_CHARGE NUMBER;
 V_BILL_RATE NUMBER;
 CALC_DT DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_BILL_INTL_CD VARCHAR2(3);
 v_inv_type NUMBER(3);--CR-7757
BEGIN
 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF TO_NUMBER(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID) IN (DCLTN.DU_BRKR, DCLTN.DU_AFF) AND
 --CR-7757
 IF get_setting_cr_7757 = 1 THEN
 v_inv_type := 12;-- new CIF
 ELSE
 v_inv_type := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CIF');-- 5 old CIF
 END IF;
 --end CR-7757
 IF TO_NUMBER(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID) IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) AND
-- :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE IN (DCLTN.IT_CF, DCLTN.IT_CIF) AND
 --:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CF'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CIF')) AND
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_CF'), v_inv_type) AND -- 4 C&F ,5 CIF [12]--CR-7757
--&&& END
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS > 0 THEN

 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS, 0) <= 0 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 80, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT CRNCY_CODE
 INTO V_BILL_INTL_CD
 FROM BILLS
 WHERE (PORT_CD, CARR_PREFIX, BILL_NBR, BILL_DT) =
 (
 SELECT DISTINCT PORT_CD, CARR_PREFIX, BILL_NBR, BILL_DT
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF V_BILL_INTL_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT CURCY_CD
 INTO :BILL_CURCY_CD
 FROM CURRENCIES
 WHERE CURCY_INTL_CD = V_BILL_INTL_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :BILL_CURCY_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT L_CUR.CURCY_ARBC_NAME
 INTO :BILL_CURCY_NAME
 FROM CURRENCIES L_CUR
 WHERE L_CUR.CURCY_CD = :BILL_CURCY_CD
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- V_BILL_RATE := DUTY.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (:BILL_CURCY_CD, CALC_DT);
 IF TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') >='1430-03-17' THEN
 V_BILL_RATE := REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (:BILL_CURCY_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT);
 ELSE
 V_BILL_RATE := REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (:BILL_CURCY_CD, CALC_DT);
 END IF;

--&&& END

 IF V_BILL_RATE IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لم يمكن الحصول على سعر تحويل عملة شحن البوليصة', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_AIR_CARGO_CHARGE(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, V_BILL_CHARGE, V_DCLTN_CHARGE);

 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS > V_DCLTN_CHARGE THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 90, 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;

 :DCLTN_INVOICES.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS * V_BILL_RATE;
 :GLOBAL.DO_RECALC := 1;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('عملة شحن البوليصة غير معرفة في جداول التحويل', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ .. عملة شحن البوليصة معرفة أكثر من مرة', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- BY SHERIFT 03-03-2005--
 :PARAMETER.P_NEED_PRINT :=1;
 -- --
 :GLOBAL.INV_UPDT :=1;



END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_SRCE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الأجنبية المصدرة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_SHPMT_CURCY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات عملة الشحن - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الميناء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_OTHER_CURCY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات عملة المصاريف الأخرى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_INV_CURCY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات عملة الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_INVTYP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع الفاتـورة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_INT_CURR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'العـــمـــلـــــة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_INS_CURCY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات عملة التأمين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات البيان الجمركي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_BILL_CUR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملة بوليصة الشحن الجوي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_INV_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الفواتير','الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الفواتير','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الفواتير','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

/* CGRI$CASCADE_DELETE */
/* This performs referential integrity checks/updates prior to the */
/* deletion of a row. It first performs any block deletion checks, */
/* and then any database updates required due to the delete. */

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$MULTIPLE_MASTER_O_P_D */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
DECLARE
 start_item CONSTANT VARCHAR2(61) := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM;
 start_level CONSTANT NUMBER := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
BEGIN
 IF ( get_record_property( get_block_property('DCLTN_INVOICES', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DCLTN_INVOICES', STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT')) THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 5;
 IF (( get_record_property( get_block_property('DCLTN_HDR', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DCLTN_HDR', STATUS) IN ('CHANGED', 'QUERY'))
 ) THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_RELATION( find_relation( 'DCLTN_INVOICES.CGFK$DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_INV_FK'), :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM != start_item) THEN
 go_item(start_item);
 END IF;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := start_level;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := start_level;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

BEGIN

 END IF;
 END IF;

DECLARE
 V_APL_DT DATE;
 V_RET NUMBER;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT FINAL_CTRY_CD
 INTO V_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 V_APL_DT := NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PROD_DT, HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date);

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = DCLTN.KSA THEN
 IF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN
--&&& END
 V_RET := CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION (:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD, V_APL_DT, 1);
 IF V_RET <> 0 THEN
 IF CHCK_ITEM_GRP (:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,108)=1 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 STR.DispAlert('هذا البند محظور..لا يمكن استخدامه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 -- By Mohamed Al-Sheerif DM-189 15/06/2021
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) THEN
 V_RET := CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION (:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD, V_APL_DT, 13);
 IF V_RET <> 0 THEN
 STR.DispAlert(' هذا البند محظور تصديره','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- END By Mohamed Al-Sheerif DM-189 15/06/2021


 END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 V_APL_DT DATE;
 V_EFF_DT DATE;
 V_RET NUMBER;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_STATUS VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN

 -- Start Yasser Helmy WO281309 --But DM-189 Code in the first --
 -- By Mohamed Al-Sheerif DM-189 15/06/2021
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) THEN
 V_RET := CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION (:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD, V_APL_DT, 13);
 IF V_RET <> 0 THEN
 STR.DispAlert(' هذا البند محظور تصديره','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- END By Mohamed Al-Sheerif DM-189 15/06/2021
 -- END Yasser Helmy WO281309 --But DM-189 Code in the first --

 SELECT FINAL_CTRY_CD
 INTO V_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

-- V_APL_DT := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;


 IF (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR IS NULL) THEN
 V_APL_DT := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 ELSE
 V_APL_DT := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT;
 END IF;


-- V_RET := TARIFF.TRF_ITEM_STAT(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD, V_APL_DT, V_EFF_DT, V_STATUS);
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 V_RET := TARIFF.TRF_ITEM_STAT(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD, V_APL_DT, V_EFF_DT, V_STATUS,1, 1);
 ELSE
 V_RET := TARIFF.TRF_ITEM_STAT(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD, V_APL_DT, V_EFF_DT, V_STATUS,2, 1);
 END IF;


 /* --COMMENTED AND USED INTERNAL --
 IF V_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND V_RET NOT IN (3,4,5) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_STATUS, 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 */
 IF V_RET <> 1 THEN
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -------------------------------- MAIH EXCEPT IMPT ----------------------------------------------
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 CHK_TARIFF_EXCEPT(V_STATUS,V_RET,:INS_TARIFF_CD) ;

 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_DT := V_EFF_DT;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 ELSIF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN
 V_APL_DT := NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PROD_DT, HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date);
 V_RET := CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION (:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD, V_APL_DT, 1);
 IF V_RET = 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_DT := V_EFF_DT;
 ELSE
 IF CHCK_ITEM_GRP (:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD,108)=1 THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_DT := V_EFF_DT;
 ELSE
 STR.DispAlert('هذا البند محظور..لا يمكن استخدامه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_SUM NUMBER;
BEGIN

 --- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONRM @ 01/08/2005
 IF (NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST,0) < 0) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(1, 220, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST,0) = 0) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(1, 220, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF (NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST,0) >= 1000000000) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(1, 360, 'INFORMATION');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ---

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 SELECT SUM(INV_COST)
 INTO V_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN;
 ELSE
 SELECT SUM(INV_COST)
 INTO V_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN
 AND ITEM_SEQ <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;
IF :PARAMETER.P_AIR_PASS <> 1 THEN
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST, 0) > NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS, 0) - NVL(V_SUM,0) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 110, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
 :PARAMETER.P_NEED_PRINT :=0;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 P_PRV NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(100);
 CIF_VAL NUMBER;
 DUTY_VAL NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST < :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_CIF_COST THEN
 P_PRV := prtl_nebras_services.have_priv(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,'DCLN_R76');

 IF P_PRV = 1 THEN
 CALL_LESS_PRICE_RSN;
 ---------- التاكد من ان اليوزر قد اختار سبب
 IF :GLOBAL.RSN IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_ITEM_LESS_PRICE(PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, LESS_PRICE_RSN_CD, ENTRY_USER_ID, ENTRY_DT)
 VALUES (:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN, :GLOBAL.RSN, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, SYSDATE);

 :GLOBAL.RSN := '';

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; --MESSAGE('ERR = '||DBMS_ERROR_TEXT);
 END;

 ELSIF :GLOBAL.RSN IS NULL THEN
 V_MSG := 'يجب اختيار السبب';
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ---------- التاكد من ان اليوزر قد اختار سبب

 ------A.ABDELHADI CR-4970-----
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_CIF_COST ,0) = 0 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST < :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعديل لان القيمة بتقدير الجمرك أقل من القيمة سيف', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 GET_DUTY_WITHOUT_CSTMS( CIF_VAL , DUTY_VAL ) ;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST < CIF_VAL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن التعديل لان القيمة بتقدير الجمرك أقل من القيمة سيف '||CIF_VAL, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_CIF_COST := CIF_VAL ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -----------------------------

 ELSE
 STR.DispArbMsg(22,140,'ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST >= :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST OR :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST IS NULL THEN

 ------A.ABDELHADI CR-4970-----
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_CIF_COST ,0) = 0 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST < :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعديل لان القيمة بتقدير الجمرك أقل من القيمة سيف', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 GET_DUTY_WITHOUT_CSTMS( CIF_VAL , DUTY_VAL ) ;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST < CIF_VAL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن التعديل لان القيمة بتقدير الجمرك أقل من القيمة سيف '||CIF_VAL, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_CIF_COST := CIF_VAL ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -----------------------------


 DELETE DCLTN_ITEM_LESS_PRICE
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_PORT_CD VARCHAR2(3);
 V_DCLTN_TYPE VARCHAR2(2);
 V_DCLTN_NBR VARCHAR2(6);
 V_MI VARCHAR2(2);
 V_MM VARCHAR2(2);
 V_YY VARCHAR2(2);
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :U_IN_DCLTN_DATA IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_PORT_CD := SUBSTR(:U_IN_DCLTN_DATA, 1, 3);
 V_DCLTN_TYPE := SUBSTR(:U_IN_DCLTN_DATA, 4, 2);
 V_DCLTN_NBR := SUBSTR(:U_IN_DCLTN_DATA, 6, 6);

 V_MI := SUBSTR(:U_IN_DCLTN_DATA, 12, 2);
 V_MM := SUBSTR(:U_IN_DCLTN_DATA, 14, 2);
 V_YY := SUBSTR(:U_IN_DCLTN_DATA, 16, 2);

 V_DCLTN_DT := TO_DATE('14'||V_YY||'-'||V_MM||'-'||V_MI, 'YYYY-MM-MI');

 IF V_DCLTN_TYPE NOT IN (1, 2) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('نوع البيان الوارد يجب أن يكون بيان جمركي أو تصفية فورية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :PORT_CD_IMPD_AT := V_PORT_CD;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY := V_DCLTN_TYPE;
 :DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY := V_DCLTN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY := V_DCLTN_DT;

 :U_IN_DCLTN_DATA := NULL;

/*
 BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_2(
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNAME_IMPD_AT
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الإستيراد للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_14(
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DTYPE_IMPD_BY
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في نوع البيان الجمركي للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
 END;
*/
 END IF;
 ELSE
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN

/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_XRD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات نوع الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK3') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الإستيراد للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RETITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر الحجز', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RACT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'RACT_ACTION_NBR,PORT_CD,RACT_RET_BILL_NBR,RACT_AC' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_MU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس علي الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LSITMS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى بيانات المبيعات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LFTITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر المتروكات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LACIT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'LACIT_ACTION_CD,LACIT_LFT_ITEM_NBR,PORT_CD,LACIT_' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'INS_TARIFF_CD,INS_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_IMU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس الدولية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_ICA_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_FINAL_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FINAL_TARIFF_CD,FINAL_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_FINAL_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_TYP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز نوع الإعفاء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_DTL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_DCREE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات نوع الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DIR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب التأمين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_INV_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات البيان الجمركي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTNT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في نوع البيان الجمركي للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DAPPL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء الدبلوماسي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_CTRY_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('يجب اختيار بلد الشراء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الدولة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_BRKR_TRF_XP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_TARIFF_CD,BRKR_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_BRKR_TRFD_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_APPRV_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستعمل', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_AM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم الاتفاقية,رقم العضو في الاتفاقية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DIL_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','Dcltn Item Letrs' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'D_USD_VH_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','مواصفات السيارة المستعملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DIC_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','جدول يحتوي تأكيدات الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DTSH_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'DCLTN_ITEMS','DCLTN_ITEM_SUB_HRMNZ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DSCDL_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'RCN_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DIV_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DSB_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DS_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','إيقاف البيان بسبب التعليمات' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الأص','الفواتير, البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الأ','الفواتير, البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ IS NULL THEN

 -- BY SHERIFT 30/08/2006
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN

 :PRICING_APPRV :=2;

 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = 9 THEN

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3, 34, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ||'!'||:ITEM_ISN) THEN

 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_pricing_tariff = 1 THEN --hashmali

 VALUES(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:ITEM_ISN,:PRC_DTL_SEQ,:FINAL_TARIFF_CD);
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_AIR_PASS = 1 THEN
 :PRICING_APPRV :=3;

 :PRICING_APPRV :=1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 UPDATE_NEED_PRINT;

DECLARE
V_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
------------------------------------
IF (:DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL) AND
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (3,4) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('هذا البند التفصيلي للبيان الصادر أو إعادة التصدير فقط','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

------------------------------------
IF (:DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NULL) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال كل البنود التفصيلية', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
------------------------------------

IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4) THEN
 BEGIN
 V_CNT := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM PETR_EXP_PRICES PEP
 WHERE PEP.HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD
 AND PEP.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1
 AND PEP.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 IF NVL(V_CNT,0) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('كود البيتومين أو أحد مشتقاته غير موجود, أمل إعادة الإدخال أو تغيير البند','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
------------------------------------

IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4) THEN
 BEGIN
 V_CNT := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM PETR_EXP_PRICES PEP
 WHERE PEP.HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD
 AND PEP.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1
 AND PEP.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 IF NVL(V_CNT,0) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('كود البيتومين أو أحد مشتقاته غير موجود, أمل إعادة الإدخال أو تغيير البند','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
----------------------------------
IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4) THEN
 BEGIN
 V_CNT := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM PETR_EXP_PRICES PEP
 WHERE PEP.HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND PEP.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1 = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_1
 AND PEP.ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2 = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ANAL_ITEM_CODE_2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 IF NVL(V_CNT,0) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('كود البيتومين أو أحد مشتقاته غير موجود, أمل إعادة الإدخال أو تغيير البند','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
------------------------------------

END;

DECLARE
 v_invst_cnt NUMBER;
 v_impr NUMBER;
 v_imp_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_invst_cnt
 FROM dcltn_invst
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn;

 IF v_invst_cnt = 0
 THEN
--THE OLD ONE IN STATS_DCLTNS IS NOT INVEST COMPANY
 SELECT impr_nbr
 INTO v_impr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_imp_cnt
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND impr_nbr = v_impr
 AND impr_type_cd = 19
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2;

 IF v_imp_cnt > 0
 THEN
 IF :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_dt IS NOT NULL
 AND :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_nbr IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 BEGIN
 -- INSERT RECORD INTO DCLTN_INVST
 INSERT INTO dcltn_invst
 (port_cd, dcltn_isn,
 dcltn_dt, dcltn_nbr, dcltn_type_cd,
 impr_nbr, dcn_status
 )
 VALUES (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd, :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn,
 :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_dt, :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_nbr, 1,
 v_impr, 0
 ); -- 1 MEANS DECLARATIONS 2 MEANS STATS
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
END;

 INTO v_invst_cnt

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DispArbMsg(21, 980,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM WAIVERS WVH, WVR_ITEMS WVI
 WHERE WVH.WVR_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND WVH.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WVH.DCLTN_TYPE = 1
 AND WVI.WVR_PORT_CD = WVH.WVR_PORT_CD
 AND WVI.WVR_SEQ_NBR = WVH.WVR_SEQ_NBR
 AND WVI.ISSUED_DT = WVH.ISSUED_DT
 AND WVI.DOC_DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن حذف الصنف - يوجد تعهد مرتبط بهذا الصنف - يجب حذف التعهد أولا','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VHCL_CARDS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن حذف الصنف - توجد بطاقة جمركية مرتبطة بهذا الصنف','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 TMPLT.KEY_DELETE_RECORD;
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nRet NUMBER;
 txtOut VARCHAR2(1000);

BEGIN
 /*DCLTN.ADJ_DCLTN_FUNS(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD,
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,
 :PARAMETER.P_LEVEL,

 -- [[ BY RAMY GOMAA 26-12-2005

 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الحفظ لعدم القدرة بالتعامل مع سجلات الترحيل ', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
--------Omar Mansour ---------
 ADD_TRF_EXEMPTION;
 END;

Trigger.Name: POST-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('FRAUD_VALUE_PREDICT',21),0) = 1 THEN
prtl_nebras_services.NBRS_FRAUD_WS(:dcltn_items.port_cd,:dcltn_items.dcltn_isn,:dcltn_items.item_isn);
END IF;
DECLARE
 V_CURR VARCHAR2(2000) := ' ';
 V_NEXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_WVR_ITEMS_COUNT NUMBER;
 nRet NUMBER;
 txtOut VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_NEW_CIF NUMBER;
 V_NEW_DUTY NUMBER;
 ALERT_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(1000);
 ALERT_RET VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_BL_TOT_ITEMS NUMBER;
 V_BL_TOT_KG_WGT NUMBER;
 V_BL_CNTNRS_QTY NUMBER;


 V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT NUMBER;
 V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_MFST_NBR NUMBER;
 V_MFST_DT DATE;
 V_BL_SEQ NUMBER;



BEGIN

 -- [[ BY RAMY GOMAA 26-12-2005
 nRet:=DCLTN.process_confirmation(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE,txtOut) ;
 IF nRet=-1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن اختبار تأكيد الصنف '||txtOut, 'ERROR');--'--
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 -- BY RAMY GOMAA 26-12-2005 ]]


 IF :PARAMETER.P_SUP_TAR = 1 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.BRKR_FEES_DIFF = 1 THEN
 LOCAL_GET_DUTY(V_NEW_CIF,V_NEW_DUTY);

 :GLOBAL.BRKR_FEES_DIFFRENT := :GLOBAL.OLD_RQRD_DUTY - V_NEW_DUTY ;
 ALERT_MESSAGE := 'تنبيه اعلام المخلص أنه يوجد فرق فى الرسوم لصالح المخلص على النحو التالى : ' || CHR(30) || CHR(40);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || ' الرسوم القديمة : ' || :GLOBAL.OLD_RQRD_DUTY || CHR(15) || CHR(20);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'الرسوم الجديدة : ' || V_NEW_DUTY || CHR(15) || CHR(20);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'فرق الرسوم : ' || :GLOBAL.BRKR_FEES_DIFFRENT || CHR(15) || CHR(20);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := 'مع العلم بان رسوم الصنف على هذا البيان لن تتأثر ' || CHR(20) || CHR(25);
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT(ALERT_MESSAGE,'INFORMATION');
 -- STR.DISPALERT('الرسوم القديمة '|| :GLOBAL.OLD_RQRD_DUTY || 'الرسوم الجديدة'||V_NEW_DUTY,'INFORMATION');--
 END IF;
 :PARAMETER.P_SUP_TAR := 0 ;
 :GLOBAL.OLD_RQRD_DUTY := 0;
 :GLOBAL.BRKR_FEES_DIFF := 0;
 :GLOBAL.BRKR_FEES_DIFFRENT :=0;
 Jornaling_Close;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_SUP_QTY = 1 THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_SUP_QTY := 0 ;
 Jornaling_Close;
 END IF;

 IF :Global.UPDATE_BAND =2 THEN

 Jornaling_Close;
 :Global.UPDATE_BAND:=0;

 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_SUPPORT_ON<>0 THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_SUPPORT_ON:=0;
 END IF;

 V_NEXT := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', FIRST_ITEM);
 IF V_NEXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE V_NEXT <> V_CURR
 LOOP
 V_CURR := 'DCLTN_ITEMS.' || V_NEXT;
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(V_CURR, VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(V_CURR, ITEM_TYPE) <> 'BUTTON' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(V_CURR, UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(V_CURR, ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 V_NEXT := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(V_CURR, NEXTITEM);
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_WVR_ITEMS_COUNT FROM WVR_ITEMS
 WHERE DOC_DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND ITEM_TYPE_CD = 21
 ;

 IF V_WVR_ITEMS_COUNT <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY THEN
 DELETE WVR_ITEMS
 WHERE DOC_DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND ITEM_TYPE_CD = 21
 ;
 ADD_CNTNR_WVR;
 ADD_CNTNR_WVR_ITEMS(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN,:ITEM_ISN);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ADD_CNTNR_EXEMPTION;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD',DATABASE_VALUE)!= :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD THEN
 IF DCLTN.REG_TYPE_DECISION(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN,0,1) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الحفظ لعدم القدرة بالتعامل مع سجلات الترحيل ', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --------Omar Mansour ---------
 ADD_TRF_EXEMPTION;



 ----------------HATEM 25-12-2013 ---------------------
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD =6 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA') THEN --hatem 22-12-2013

 select sum(BL_TOT_ITEMS),sum(BL_TOT_KG_WGT) ,SUM(BL_CNTNRS_QTY)
 ,MAX(MFST_TYPE),MAX(MFST_NBR),MAX(MFST_DT),MAX(BL_SEQ)

 into V_BL_TOT_ITEMS,V_BL_TOT_KG_WGT,V_BL_CNTNRS_QTY
 ,V_MFST_TYPE,V_MFST_NBR,V_MFST_DT,V_BL_SEQ
 from vssl_bls
 where vssl_bls.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 and vssl_bls.dcltn_isn=:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_BL_TOT_ITEMS=1 AND V_BL_CNTNRS_QTY<2 THEN


 select sum(GROSS_WT)
 into V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT
 from DCLTN_ITEMS
 where DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 and DCLTN_ITEMS.dcltn_isn=:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT <> V_BL_TOT_KG_WGT THEN
 UPDATE vssl_bls SET BL_TOT_KG_WGT=V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT

 where vssl_bls.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 and VSSL_bls.MFST_TYPE=V_MFST_TYPE
 and VSSL_bls.MFST_NBR=V_MFST_NBR
 and VSSL_bls.MFST_DT=V_MFST_DT
 and VSSL_bls.BL_SEQ=V_BL_SEQ;


 UPDATE vssl_bl_items
 SET ACTL_WGT=V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT ,REGSTRD_WT=V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT,WT_BALC=V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT
 where VSSL_bl_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE=V_MFST_TYPE
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.MFST_NBR=V_MFST_NBR
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.MFST_DT=V_MFST_DT
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.BL_SEQ=V_BL_SEQ;


 UPDATE BL_ITEM_ENTRIES
 SET ENTRD_WT=ENTRD_WT+V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT-V_BL_TOT_KG_WGT
 where BL_ITEM_ENTRIES.MFST_TYPE=V_MFST_TYPE
 and BL_ITEM_ENTRIES.MFST_NBR=V_MFST_NBR
 and BL_ITEM_ENTRIES.MFST_DT=V_MFST_DT
 and BL_ITEM_ENTRIES.BL_SEQ=V_BL_SEQ
 and BL_ITEM_ENTRIES.ITEM_SEQ=1
 and BL_ITEM_ENTRIES.ENTRY_SEQ=1;

 if V_BL_CNTNRS_QTY=1 THEN

 UPDATE VSSL_CNTNRS
 SET GOODS_WT=GOODS_WT+V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT-V_BL_TOT_KG_WGT
 where
 exists
 ( select * from vssl_bl_items
 where VSSL_bl_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE=V_MFST_TYPE
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.MFST_NBR=V_MFST_NBR
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.MFST_DT=V_MFST_DT
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.BL_SEQ=V_BL_SEQ
 and VSSL_bl_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ=VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ);
 END IF; ---if V_BL_CNTNRS_QTY=1

 ALERT_MESSAGE := 'تم تعديل الوزن فى الشحن ';
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT(ALERT_MESSAGE,'INFORMATION');



 end if; --IF V_DCLTN_GROSS_WT <> V_BL_TOT_KG_WGT

 END IF; -- IF V_BL_TOT_ITEMS=1 AND V_BL_CNTNRS_QTY<2 THEN
 END IF; ----hatem 26-12-2013


END;

END;

BEGIN
set_BLOCK_property('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
:GLOBAL.CERT_UPDATE_FLAG:=0;
IF :PARAMETER.P_AIR_PASS = 1 THEN
UPDATE DCLTN_INVOICES SET TOTAL_EXPS =
(SELECT NVL(SUM(INV_COST),0)
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD),items_cnt =
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcltn_items WHERE
 DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD)
WHERE PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
--ITEMS BLOCK PRIVILAGES
DECLARE
 V_ITEMS_CNT NUMBER;
 V_TASK_ID NUMBER;
 V_UNIT_COST NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_TASK_ID := TO_NUMBER(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);

 V_UNIT_COST := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('UNIT_COST',21),0);

 IF V_UNIT_COST <> 1 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_DISPLAY_ONLY, 0) <> 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ITEMS_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN;

 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT > V_ITEMS_CNT THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF (V_ITEMS_CNT > 0) THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ3', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 -- SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ3', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ3', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DRCT_CLRNC !=1 OR :DCLTN_HDR.DRCT_CLRNC IS NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ3', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

DECLARE
x NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(400);
BEGIN
x:=LIB_USR.hours24_services.check_before_update_items (:DCLTN_HDR.port_cd,
 :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn,

STR.DISPALERT(v_msg_txt,'ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END ;
check_iden_cert;

IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
DECLARE
X NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO X
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GRP_CODE = 143
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = :FINAL_TARIFF_CD;
IF X > 0 AND :EXPIRY_DT IS NULL THEN
STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال تاريخ الإنتهاء','ERROR');

 --

 THEN

 THEN

 ----------AHMED MOMEN DM 650 ---

 --- ayman gad 20-08-2025 -------

THEN
IF :ICA_IDNT_ISN = 50 THEN
IF TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,4)) = 0
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,5,1) <> '-'
OR TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,6,7)) = 0 THEN
RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;
ELSIF :ICA_IDNT_ISN = 27 THEN
IF SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1) <> 'A'
OR LENGTH(:IDEN_CERT_NBR) <> 11
OR TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,10)) = 0 THEN
RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;

ELSIF :ICA_IDNT_ISN = 47 THEN

IF
 (LENGTH(:IDEN_CERT_NBR) <> 17
OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1)) < 65
OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1)) > 122
OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1)) BETWEEN 91 AND 96
OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,1)) < 65
OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,1)) > 122
OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,1)) BETWEEN 91 AND 96
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,3,1) <> '/'
OR TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,4,4)) < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))-1
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,8,1) <> '/'
OR TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,9,2)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 12 --= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'MM')
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,11,1) <> '/'
OR TRANSLATE(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,12),'0123456789xX','XXXXXXXXXXYY') <> 'XXXXXX') THEN

 V_IS_VALID := 0;
ELSE
 V_IS_VALID := 1;
END IF;

IF V_IS_VALID = 0 THEN
 IF
 (LENGTH(:IDEN_CERT_NBR) <> 16
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1)) < 65
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1)) > 122
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,1)) BETWEEN 91 AND 96
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,1)) < 65
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,1)) > 122
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,2,1)) BETWEEN 91 AND 96
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,3,1)) < 65
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,3,1)) > 122
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,3,1)) BETWEEN 91 AND 96
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,4,1)) < 65
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,4,1)) > 122
 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,4,1)) BETWEEN 91 AND 96
 OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,5,1) <> '/'
 OR To_Number(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,6,4)) < To_Number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))-1
 OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,10,1) <> '/'
 OR TRANSLATE(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,11),'0123456789xX','XXXXXXXXXXYY') <> 'XXXXXX') THEN

 V_IS_VALID := 0;
 ELSE
 V_IS_VALID := 1;
 END IF;

END IF;

IF V_IS_VALID = 0 THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;

ELSIF :ICA_IDNT_ISN = 41 THEN
IF SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,1,3) <> 'SAU'
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,4,1) <> ' '
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,9,1) <> ' '
OR SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,16,1) <> '/'
OR LENGTH(:IDEN_CERT_NBR) <> 20
OR TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,10,6)) = 0
OR TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,17,4)) = 0
OR TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:IDEN_CERT_NBR,5,4),'YYYY') = SYSDATE THEN
RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;
END IF;
END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
STR.DISPALERT('رقم شهادة المطابقة غير صحيح','ERROR');
RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
END;

DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DIM_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DCLTN_ISN,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Dcltn Items Mqsa Dtls','الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Dcltn Items Mqsa Dtls','الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: KEY_CONTROL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY KEY_CONTROL IS
PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY IS
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=1;

DECLARE
 FLAG1 NUMBER := 0;
 V_UPDATE NUMBER := 0;
 V_DELETE NUMBER := 0;
 V_INSERT NUMBER := 0;

 CURSOR C_FK(VROLE VARCHAR2) IS

 SELECT RL_SYS_UPDATE,RL_SYS_INSERT,RL_SYS_DELETE
 FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID = VROLE
 AND SYS_TYPE IN (5,6);

 CURSOR C_ROLES IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES SCUR
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCUR.ROLE_ID)
 UNION
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES SCGR,SC_USER_GROUPS SCUG
 WHERE SCUG.GROUP_ID = SCGR.GROUP_ID
 AND SCUG.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND SCUG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCGR.ROLE_ID)
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1;
 vc varchar2(2000) ;
 vrol_password varchar2(200) ;
 V_ROLE VARCHAR2(2000);

BEGIN
 FOR J in c_roles LOOP
 FOR I IN C_FK(J.ROLE_ID)LOOP
 FLAG1 :=1;
 IF I.RL_SYS_INSERT =1 THEN V_INSERT := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_DELETE =1 THEN V_DELETE := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_UPDATE =1 THEN V_UPDATE := 1 ; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF FLAG1 =1 THEN
 IF V_INSERT = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_DELETE =0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END;
 FK_DISPLAY;
END;



 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY IS
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.V_INSERT = 0 AND :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.SAVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.V_DELETE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.REMOVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: KEY_CONTROL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE KEY_CONTROL IS
 PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY ;
 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY ;
END;

FUNCTION CHECK_TIMEOUT RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 HFILE TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE;
 V_FILENAME VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_FILENAME
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = 999
 AND VAR_NAME = 'NO_TIMEOUT_FILENAME'
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 END;

 HFILE := TEXT_IO.FOPEN(V_FILENAME, 'R');
 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 RETURN(FALSE);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;


 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 98 THEN
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;
 END IF ;
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_USER_ID VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_ROLE_ID VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
BEGIN
 SELECT UR.ROLE_ID INTO V_ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR, SC_USER_GROUPS UG
 WHERE UG.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND GR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UER.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN(FALSE);
END;
 IF V_ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL' THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TURN_MSG

PROCEDURE TURN_MSG IS
 tim timer;

begin
 if Id_Null(Find_Timer('TURN')) then

--Stop the Return timer
 if not Id_Null(Find_Timer('RETURN')) then

 end if;
 Synchronize;
