ProgramUnit.Name: WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG IS

 Timer_Expired varchar2(30);
 Tim timer;
 dummy varchar2(32);

begin
 Timer_Expired := Get_Application_Property(TIMER_NAME);
 if Timer_Expired = 'TURN' then
 dummy := To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS));
 if dummy <= 5.5 then
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 5.5);
 Delete_Timer('TURN');
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))-0.006);
 end if;

 :global.timer := 1;
 elsif Timer_Expired = 'RETURN' then
 if To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS)) >= 8.5 then
--Stop this timer
 Delete_Timer('RETURN');
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 8.5);
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))+0.006);
 end if;
 :global.timer := 2;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE */
PROCEDURE CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE IS
BEGIN
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
/* Read the values for dynamic lists from the CG_REF_CODES table */
BEGIN
 CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
END;

/* CGLY$INIT_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$INIT_TAB_BLOCKS */
/* Initialise tabbed canvases */
BEGIN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
END;

/* CGBS$STARTUP */
/* Perform start-up processing for Block Synchronization */
BEGIN
 /* Set the defaults for the globals */
 :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 /* Set the relations to the default query mode */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the query mode items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''INV_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''ISD_CHK_VALUE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.U_ISD_CHK', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''TEMP_ITEM'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.TEMP_ITEM', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DUTY_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''CAR_MODEL'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''IMPD_BY_CHECK'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.IMPD_BY_CHECK', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_ */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER) IS /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE TYPE_ID = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,P_DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC. */
 ,P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_DCLTN_STA_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_DESC
 ,L_DCLTNT.TYPE_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS DCLTN_ST
 ,DCLTN_TYPES L_DCLTNT
 WHERE (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD = P_DCLTN_STA_CD OR
 (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL AND
 P_DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL ))
 AND DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND L_DCLTNT.TYPE_ID = DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 , P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU(

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INV_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CUR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CUR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CUR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CUR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRCE_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CUR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STMT_IT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_UK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'EXPITM_PK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'EXPITM_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'البند المنسق,رمز البند التحليلي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMU_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز وحدة القياس الدولية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MU_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'وحدة القياس' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CTRY_PK') THEN

 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'البند المنسق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRFD_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'EFF_DATE,HRMNZD_CODE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'HT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'البند المنسق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRFD_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'EFF_DATE,HRMNZD_CODE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'HT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'البند المنسق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CTRY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الدولة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);

 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Find the canvases associated with the current canvas and record which */
/* base canvas is displayed in each window */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_current_canvas = 'CG$M_TAB_1') THEN
 P_base_canvas := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 ELSE
 P_BASE_CANVAS := P_CURRENT_CANVAS;
 END IF;
 IF (get_view_property(P_CURRENT_CANVAS, WINDOW_NAME) = 'CGSO$WINDOW_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE := P_BASE_CANVAS;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS */
PROCEDURE CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(
 P_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Current canvas */
/* Raise the current canvas, plus any dependant canvases to the top */
BEGIN
 set_view_property(P_CANVAS, VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 IF ( P_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$M_TAB_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN
 IF ( (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS IS NULL) OR (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS != current_canvas) ) THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS := current_canvas;
 set_window_property( get_view_property( current_canvas, WINDOW_NAME ), VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 canvas_list := :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST;
 END IF;
 CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(canvas_list, current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST := canvas_list;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE

/* CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Send a message to the status line indicating the current query mode */
BEGIN
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode on', 'I', 'OFG', 0);

ProgramUnit.Name: VIN_SHOW_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VIN_SHOW_LIST(P_PRICE_UNIT NUMBER ) IS
 pl_id paramlist;
 pl_name VARCHAR2 (100) := 'VIN';
 ret NUMBER;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_chk_ccr NUMBER;
 v_ccr_required NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
 v_vhcl_type_cd NUMBER (10);
 v_spcfc_seq_nbr NUMBER (10);
BEGIN
/*
SELECT INV_NBR ,INV_DATE
INTO V_INV_NBR ,V_INV_DATE
FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
WHERE
PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN ;

*/

-----------------------------------------------------
IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_NBR IS NULL OR :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_DATE IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'يجب أدخال رقم و تاريخ الفاتورة معا , توجد بيانات ناقصة','ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;
-----------------------------------------------------



-----------------------------------------------------
 SELECT impr_nbr
 INTO v_impr_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd AND dcltn_isn =
 :dcltn_items.dcltn_isn;

 BEGIN
 v_chk_ccr := 0;
 :GLOBAL.ccr_start_year := 0;

 BEGIN
 SELECT var_value
 INTO :GLOBAL.ccr_start_year
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE sysobj_id = 7 AND var_name LIKE 'CCR_START_YEAR';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 :GLOBAL.ccr_start_year := NVL (:GLOBAL.ccr_start_year, 0);

 DECLARE
 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT spcfc_seq_nbr, prodct_yr
 FROM vhcl_vin_cards
 WHERE impr_nbr = v_impr_nbr
 AND invoice_nbr = :dcltn_invoices.inv_nbr
 AND invoice_dt = :dcltn_invoices.inv_date
 AND prodct_yr >= :GLOBAL.ccr_start_year;
 BEGIN
 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT vhcl_type_cd
 INTO v_vhcl_type_cd
 FROM vhcl_card_spcfcs
 WHERE spcfc_seq_nbr = x.spcfc_seq_nbr;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT TO_NUMBER (NVL (filler1, '1'))
 INTO v_ccr_required
 FROM vhcl_types
 WHERE vhcl_type_cd = v_vhcl_type_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_ccr_required, 0) = 1
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM vhcl_ccr
 WHERE spcfc_seq_nbr = x.spcfc_seq_nbr
 AND ccr_year = x.prodct_yr;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 v_chk_ccr := v_chk_ccr + 1;
 v_spcfc_seq_nbr := x.spcfc_seq_nbr||'!';
 --EXIT;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_chk_ccr, 0) > 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('يجب إدخال بيانات CCR للمواصفة رقم' || v_spcfc_seq_nbr,
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
-----------------------------------------------------
 ELSE
-------------------------------------------


-------------------------------------------
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;



 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'TARIFF_LOV', TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PRICE_UNIT', TEXT_PARAMETER,P_PRICE_UNIT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'IMPORTER_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_IMPR_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'INVO_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'INVO_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'INVO_DATE', TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_DATE , 'DD-MM-YYYY'));

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CURR_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ITEM_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ORGNL_DUTY', TEXT_PARAMETER,:ORGNL_DUTY );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ITEM_QTY', TEXT_PARAMETER,:INV_QTY );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD );

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_WS_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, ' قائمة أرقام السيارات');


 CALL_FORM('LOV_ITEM_CAR_AGENT.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 query_only,
 pl_id);


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
-------------------------------------------
END IF;

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VIN_CONTROL_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE vin_control_old IS
V_VCARD_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
V_UNIT_PRICE NUMBER := 0;

V_CAR_AGENT_FLAG NUMBER := 0;
V_HRMNZD_GRP NUMBER := 0;
V_DUTY_TYPE NUMBER := 0;
V_CARS_MODEL NUMBER := 0;
V_IDEN_CERT_NBR NUMBER := 0;
V_VCARD_CNT NUMBER := 0;


BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_VCARD_COUNT
 FROM VHCL_CARDS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT CAR_AGENT_FLAG INTO V_CAR_AGENT_FLAG
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 ;

 IF V_CAR_AGENT_FLAG <> 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'المستورد ليس وكيل سيارات','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END IF;
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE (:FINAL_TARIFF_CD) <> 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'بند التعرفه على الصنف ليس من بنود مجموعة السيارات','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END IF;
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DUTY_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS , GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE
 AND DUTY_TYPE IN (7,8,26)
 ;

 IF V_DUTY_TYPE > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'توجد أصناف محجوزه او متلفه أو معاد تصديرها','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END IF;
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CARS_MODEL
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN =:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND (CARS_MODEL NOT IN (1,2) OR CARS_MODEL IS NULL)
 ;

 IF V_CARS_MODEL > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'يجب ان يكون نوع المركبه على الأصناف جديده او جديده غير مباشر','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END IF;
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /* SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_IDEN_CERT_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN =:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND IDEN_CERT_NBR IS NULL
 ;

 IF V_IDEN_CERT_NBR > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'توجد أصناف ليس لها شهادات مطابقه','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END IF;*/
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 IF V_VCARD_COUNT = 0 THEN -- ANY VCARD WAS NOT ADDED TO THIS ITEM
 IF :INV_QTY > 0 THEN
 VIN_SHOW_LIST(0);
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT( 'يجب أدخال كمية الصنف قبل أظهار تلك القائمة ','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END IF;
 /*
 IF :GLOBAL.VIN_CNT > 0 THEN
 IF TO_NUMBER(:GLOBAL.VIN_CNT) <> :INV_QTY THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( ' كمية الصنف لا تساوي عدد السيارات المختاره من القائمة ','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 ELSE
 IF STR.DISPALERT('سوف يتم تكوين بطاقات جمركية لهذا الصنف , هل تريد الأستمرار' ,'WARNING')= ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 VIN_ADD_VCARD(:GLOBAL.VIN_CHASE_LIST , :GLOBAL.VIN_CNT );
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 */

 ELSE -- ALREADY EXIST VCARD

 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_PRICE
 INTO V_UNIT_PRICE
 FROM VHCL_CARDS VC, VHCL_VIN_CARDS VVC
 WHERE DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND VC.CHASE_NBR = VVC.CHASE_NBR
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT( 'يوجد بطاقه جمركيه على الصنف , ولكن بياناتها غير مكتمله','ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END;
 VIN_SHOW_LIST(V_UNIT_PRICE);

 --STR.DISPALERT( 'الصنف قد تم ادخال له سيارات من قبل , لا يمكن أضافة أو تعديل في تلك البيانات مع هذا الصنف هذا ','ERROR');
 --RETURN ;

 END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VIN_ADD_VCARD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VIN_ADD_VCARD(P_VIN_LIST VARCHAR2 , P_VIN_CNT NUMBER ) IS


V_VIN_CD NUMBER ;
V_VIN_LIST VARCHAR2(4000);
V_LOC NUMBER ;

V_CNT_RECORD NUMBER ;

V_CHASE_NBR VARCHAR2(50);
V_ENGINE_NBR VARCHAR2(50);
V_PRODCT_YR NUMBER;
V_COLOR_CD_1 NUMBER;
V_COLOR_CD_2 NUMBER;
V_COLOR_CD_3 NUMBER;
V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR NUMBER ;
V_CARD_NBR NUMBER ;
V_CARD_DATE DATE ;
V_GDATE DATE ;
V_CARD_ISU_YEAR NUMBER ;
V_CUSTOM_DUTY NUMBER ;
V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER ;


BEGIN
 V_VIN_LIST := P_VIN_LIST ;
 FOR I IN 1..P_VIN_CNT
 LOOP
 V_LOC := INSTR(V_VIN_LIST ,'#');
 V_VIN_CD := SUBSTR(V_VIN_LIST ,1,V_LOC-1);
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT CHASE_NBR,ENGINE_NBR ,PRODCT_YR ,COLOR_CD_1,COLOR_CD_2,COLOR_CD_3,SPCFC_SEQ_NBR
 INTO V_CHASE_NBR,V_ENGINE_NBR ,V_PRODCT_YR ,V_COLOR_CD_1,V_COLOR_CD_2,V_COLOR_CD_3 ,V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR
 FROM VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 WHERE VIN_CD = V_VIN_CD ;

 SELECT VCARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL
 INTO V_CARD_NBR
 FROM SYS.DUAL;

 V_CARD_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;

 HIJDATE.TO_GREG(V_CARD_DATE,V_GDATE);
 V_CARD_ISU_YEAR := SUBSTR(V_GDATE ,3, 2);

 V_CUSTOM_DUTY := :ORGNL_DUTY / :INV_QTY ;
 --- INSERT DATA --------------
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO VHCL_CARDS ( PORT_CD, VHCL_CARD_NBR, VHCL_CARD_DT, CHASE_NBR, ENGINE_NBR, PRODCT_YR,
 COLOR_CD_1, COLOR_CD_2, COLOR_CD_3, VHCL_STATUS, SPCFC_SEQ_NBR, DCLTN_ISN, DCLTN_ITEM_ISN,
 ISU_USR, DCLTN_TYPE,CARD_ISU_YEAR, CUSTOM_DUTY,
 REC_STATUS, AUTO_CREATE , PRNT_NUM ) VALUES (
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ,V_CARD_NBR ,V_CARD_DATE,V_CHASE_NBR,V_ENGINE_NBR ,V_PRODCT_YR ,
 V_COLOR_CD_1,V_COLOR_CD_2,V_COLOR_CD_3,1,V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN , :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD , V_CARD_ISU_YEAR , V_CUSTOM_DUTY ,
 1,1 , 0 );

 UPDATE VHCL_VIN_CARDS
 SET VC_CREATE = 1
 WHERE VIN_CD = V_VIN_CD ;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(7, 6, 1, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ||'!'||V_CARD_NBR||'!'||V_CARD_DATE)
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 EXIT ;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 STR.DISPALERT( 'حدث خطأ أثناء أضافة بطاقة جمركية آليا , رقم البطاقة -- '|| V_CHASE_NBR ||' -- ERROR ->'||DBMS_ERROR_TEXT ,'ERROR');
 RETURN ;
 END ;

 --------------------------------------------------------------
 V_VIN_LIST := SUBSTR(V_VIN_LIST,V_LOC+1);
 END LOOP;

 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');


 :GLOBAL.VIN_CNT := 0 ;
 :GLOBAL.VIN_CHASE_LIST := '' ;
 :GLOBAL.PRICE_LIST := NULL;

 STR.DISPALERT( 'تم تكوين البطاقات الجمركية بنجاح','INFORMATION');

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 STR.DISPALERT( 'حدث خطا عام عند أضافة البطاقة الجمركية -- '|| V_CHASE_NBR ||' -- ERROR ->'||DBMS_ERROR_TEXT ,'ERROR');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPD_IMPR_RULE_TARIFF
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--MAIH 26-03-2013 --
PROCEDURE UPD_IMPR_RULE_TARIFF IS
 V_OLD_TARIFF NUMBER ;
 V_OLD_QTY NUMBER ;
 V_NEW_TARIFF NUMBER ;
 V_NEW_QTY NUMBER ;
 V_CNT_EXCPT NUMBER ;
 V_OLD_EXCPT BOOLEAN ;
 V_NEW_EXCPT BOOLEAN ;
 V_IMPR_NPR NUMBER ;
 V_RULE_ISN NUMBER ;
 V_RET BOOLEAN ;
 -- INSERT NEW EXCEPT RECORD AND ADJUST REMAINED QTY --
 PROCEDURE INSER_EXCEPT IS
 BEGIN
 IF chk_excpt_qty(V_NEW_QTY /*IN*/,V_RULE_ISN /*OUT*/ ) THEN
 INSERT INTO IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS (RULE_ISN,DCLTN_PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,HRMNZD_CODE,USED_QTY,REC_STATUS)
 VALUES(V_RULE_ISN,:dcltn_items.port_cd,:dcltn_items.ITEM_ISN,:dcltn_items.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:dcltn_items.INTL_QTY,1);
 UPDATE IMPR_RULE_TARIFF_HQ
 SET REMAINED_QTY = REMAINED_QTY - V_NEW_QTY
 WHERE RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = V_NEW_TARIFF ;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ فى الكمية المستثناه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;
 END IF;

 END ;
 -- UPDATE EXIST QTY AND ADJUST REMAINED QTY --
 PROCEDURE UPDT_EXCEPT IS
 BEGIN

 IF chk_excpt_qty(V_NEW_QTY - V_OLD_QTY /*IN*/,
 V_RULE_ISN /*OUT*/ ) THEN

 UPDATE IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
 SET USED_QTY = V_NEW_QTY
 WHERE DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN ;
 update IMPR_RULE_TARIFF_HQ
 set REMAINED_QTY = REMAINED_QTY + V_OLD_QTY - V_NEW_QTY
 where RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN
 and HRMNZD_CODE = V_OLD_TARIFF ;
 ELSE

 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ فى الكمية المستثناه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;
 END IF;

 END ;
 -- SET EXISTING EXCEPT UN-USED IN CASE OF NEW TARIFFIS NOT EXCEPTED --
 -- AND ADJUST THE REMAINED QTY --
 PROCEDURE SET_UNUSED IS
 BEGIN

 SELECT RULE_ISN
 INTO V_RULE_ISN
 FROM IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
 WHERE DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;

 DELETE FROM IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS

 WHERE DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;

 UPDATE IMPR_RULE_TARIFF_HQ
 SET REMAINED_QTY = REMAINED_QTY + V_OLD_QTY
 WHERE RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = V_OLD_TARIFF ;

 END ;
BEGIN
/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
 SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD , INTL_QTY
 INTO V_OLD_TARIFF , V_OLD_QTY
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;
/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
 V_NEW_TARIFF := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD ;
 V_NEW_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY ;
/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
 SELECT IMPR_NBR
 INTO V_IMPR_NPR
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;
/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT_EXCPT
 FROM IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
 WHERE DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = V_OLD_TARIFF
 AND REC_STATUS = 1 ;


/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */


 /* ********************************************************** */
 /* ********************************************************** */
 -- THE NEW TARIFF IS EXCEPTED EITHER IMPORT OR EXPORT --
 -- BASED IN THE VALIDATE OF THE ITEM --
 IF :U_EXCPT_TARIFF = 1 THEN
 V_NEW_EXCPT := TRUE ;
 ELSE
 V_NEW_EXCPT := FALSE ;
 END IF;
/* ********************************************************** */
 -- THE OLD TARIFF IS EXCEPTED EITHER IMPORT OR EXPORT --
 -- BASED IN THE VALIDATE OF THE ITEM --
 IF V_CNT_EXCPT > 0 THEN
 V_OLD_EXCPT := TRUE ;
 ELSE
 V_OLD_EXCPT := FALSE ;
 END IF;
 /* ********************************************************** */
 /* ********************************************************** */



-----------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------------



 IF V_NEW_TARIFF <> V_OLD_TARIFF THEN -- TARIFF CHANGED

 IF V_NEW_QTY <> V_OLD_QTY THEN -- QTY_CHANGED
 IF V_OLD_EXCPT THEN -- OLD TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 IF V_NEW_EXCPT THEN -- NEW TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 SET_UNUSED ;
 INSER_EXCEPT ;
 ELSE -- NEW NOT EXCEPTED
 SET_UNUSED ;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- OLD NOT EXCEPTED
 IF V_NEW_EXCPT THEN -- NEW TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 INSER_EXCEPT ;
 ELSE --NEW NOT EXCEPTED
 -- DO NOTHING --
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- QTY NOT CHANGED

 IF V_OLD_EXCPT THEN -- OLD TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED

 IF V_NEW_EXCPT THEN -- NEW TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 SET_UNUSED ;
 INSER_EXCEPT ;
 ELSE -- NEW NOT EXCEPTED

 SET_UNUSED ;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- OLD NOT EXCEPTED
 IF V_NEW_EXCPT THEN -- NEW TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 INSER_EXCEPT ;
 ELSE --NEW NOT EXCEPTED
 -- DO NOTHING
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- TARIFF NOT CHANGED
 IF V_NEW_QTY <> V_OLD_QTY THEN -- QTY_CHANGED
 IF V_OLD_EXCPT THEN -- OLD TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 UPDT_EXCEPT ;
 ELSE -- OLD NOT EXCEPTED
 IF V_NEW_EXCPT THEN -- NEW TARIFF WAS EXCEPTED
 -- DO NOTHING
 NULL;
 ELSE --NEW NOT EXCEPTED
 -- DO NOTHING
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- QTY NOT CHANGED
 -- DO NOTHING
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;

-----------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------------

COPY('0','U_EXCPT_TARIFF');

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;

END;

PROCEDURE Show_Support_Form (P_Port_CD NUMBER,P_Item VARCHAR2)
IS
 pl_id ParamList;
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;
 PL_ID := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 PL_ID := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('Error creating parameter list SUPPORT_ENTRY','SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_X_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,1.5);

 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_MODE',TEXT_PARAMETER,0);

 CALL_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY.FMX',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,NO_QUERY_ONLY,PL_ID);
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);
 IF :GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_SUPPORT_ON:=1;--Raisethe support flag --
 GO_ITEM(P_Item); -- forcing the trigger 'new record instance ' to fire --
 ELSE
 -- operation was cancelled --
 ResetGlobals; -- back to initial state --
 :PARAMETER.P_SUPPORT_ON:=0;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('Parameter list '||'SUPPORT_ENTRY'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_SETTLE_TRF
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--SET_SETTLE_TRF
--DESCRIPTION : TO CHECK IF TARIFF IS DANGER OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 01-06-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------

FUNCTION SET_SETTLE_TRF(TRF_CD VARCHAR2, TRF_DESC VARCHAR2, TRF_DT DATE) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR C_TRF(T_CD VARCHAR2, T_DT DATE) IS SELECT *
 FROM TARIFF_DETAILS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = T_CD
 AND EFF_DATE = T_DT;
 TRF_REC TARIFF_DETAILS%ROWTYPE;
 V_ADD_FEES_CNT NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_PMT_METHOD NUMBER;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD := TRF_CD;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_ARBC_DESC := TRF_DESC;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_DT := TRF_DT;

 --- BY MOHAMED ABD_ELMONEM TO CANCEL CONFIRMATION OF TAIFF BAND
 --:DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_CONFN_DT := NULL;
 ---

 --BY SHERIFT 01-06-2005 --
 IF IS_TARIF_DANGER(:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT)=1 THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC:=SUBSTR(TRF_DESC,1,100);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC' , FALSE);

 ELSE

 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC' , TRUE);
 END IF;
 ----
 -- GET THE TARRIF DETAILS RECORD
 OPEN C_TRF(TRF_CD, TRF_DT);
 FETCH C_TRF INTO TRF_REC;
 CLOSE C_TRF;

 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT := TRF_REC.TRF_INTL_UNIT;


BEGIN
 SELECT IMSR_ARBC_NAME
 INTO :DCLTN_ITEMS.IMSR_ARBC_NAME
 FROM INTL_MSR_UNITS
 WHERE INTL_MSR_UNIT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;

 IF TRF_REC.DUTY_RATE_CODE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.DRC_EXMPTD') THEN

 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY := 0;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EXM_BY_TRF');
 ELSE

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EXM_BY_TRF') THEN
 SELECT PMT_METHOD
 INTO V_PMT_METHOD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_PMT_METHOD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DPM_DOC_INS') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DOC_INS');
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DEF');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :GLOBAL.FINAL_DUTY_UNIT := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.FINAL_MIN_DUTY_UNIT := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.FINAL_INST_MSR_UNIT := NULL;

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN

 IF TRF_REC.DUTY_RATE_CODE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.DRC_PERCENT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.DRC_EXMPTD')) THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY := NULL;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY' , FALSE);
 ELSE
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.FINAL_DUTY_UNIT := TRF_REC.DUTY_UNIT;
 END IF;

 IF TRF_REC.MIN_DUTY_RATE_CODE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.MDC_NONE') THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY := NULL;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY' , FALSE);
 ELSE
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.FINAL_MIN_DUTY_UNIT := TRF_REC.MIN_DUTY_UNIT;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ADD_FEES_CNT
 FROM TARIFF_INSTRUCTIONS
 WHERE INST_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.TRF_INST_ADD_FEES')
 AND INST_CODE IN (SELECT INST_CODE FROM GROUP_INSTRUCTIONS
 WHERE GRP_CODE IN (SELECT GRP_CODE FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD))
 AND TARIFF_INSTRUCTIONS.EXPRY_DATE > NVL(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT , hijdate_db.cur_hij_date) ; --CR-6072;;
IF V_ADD_FEES_CNT > 1 THEN

 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 100, 'ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE -- V_ADD_FEES_CNT > 1

 IF V_ADD_FEES_CNT = 1 THEN
 SELECT INST_MSR_UNIT
 INTO :GLOBAL.FINAL_INST_MSR_UNIT
 FROM TARIFF_INSTRUCTIONS
 WHERE INST_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.TRF_INST_ADD_FEES')
 AND INST_CODE IN (SELECT INST_CODE FROM GROUP_INSTRUCTIONS
 WHERE GRP_CODE IN (SELECT GRP_CODE FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD))
 AND TARIFF_INSTRUCTIONS.EXPRY_DATE > NVL(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT , hijdate_db.cur_hij_date) ; --CR-6072

 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY := NULL;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY' , FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF; -- V_ADD_FEES_CNT > 1
 END IF;


BEGIN
 SELECT ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT
 INTO V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT
 FROM HARMONIZED_TARIFF
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = TRF_CD;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;

 SELECT FINAL_CTRY_CD
 INTO V_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;


 IF (DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_IMPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL'))) OR
 (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_EXPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL'))) THEN
-- IF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN
 if nvl(:parameter.p_air_pass,0) <> 1 then
 CALL_ITEM_RSRCTS_LOV(TRF_CD);
 end if;
-- END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_BILL_WAIT_STATUS_TXT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_bill_wait_status_txt(p_sta_adj IN NUMBER,p_code OUT NUMBER) IS
 -- CR-5180 Suzan Ibrahim Mohamed Shehata 18-10-2022
 -- تعديل آلية رفع المنافست للصادر الجوي
 v_dcltn_sta_cd number(2);
BEGIN
 if nvl(gnrl.get_customs_setting('AIR_EXP_MFST',21),0) = 1 then -- تفعيل الاعداد
 -- تاريخ بداية التفعيل أقل من تاريخ البيان
 if hijdate_db.to_greg(:dcltn_hdr.dcltn_dt) - nvl(hijdate_db.to_greg(to_date(gnrl.get_customs_setting('AIR_EX_MFST_DT',21),'YYYY-MM-MI')),to_date('31-12-3000','dd-mm-yyyy')) >= 1 then
 if :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_type_cd in (3,4,6) then
 select dcltn_sta_cd
 into v_dcltn_sta_cd
 from declarations
 where port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 and dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 ;
 if v_dcltn_sta_cd = 2 then
 if :dcltn_sta_cd = 2 then -- حالة البيان الأصلية
 if get_bill_wait_status_1 = 1 then
 if p_sta_adj = 1 then
 :DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'فى انتظار الربط بالبوليصة';
 elsif p_sta_adj = 2 then
 p_code := 1;
 end if;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.TRAN_SEQ,VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 INTO V_PLATE_NO,V_TRAN_SEQ,V_TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM
 (
 (SELECT DISTINCT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.TRAN_SEQ,VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT,DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM,DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE (D.PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD)
 AND (D.DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (D.PORT_CD =DLM.PORT_CD)
 AND (D.DCLTN_ISN =DLM.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DLM.PORT_CD =DLMT.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN =DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN )
 AND (DLMT.PORT_CD =VT.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLMT.TRAN_SEQ =VT.TRAN_SEQ )
 AND (DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H =VT.TRANS_DATE_H )
 )
 UNION
 (
 SELECT DISTINCT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.TRAN_SEQ,VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM DECLARATIONS D,DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT,VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT
 WHERE (D.PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD)
 AND (D.DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DGT.DCLTN_ISN =D.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD =D.PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD =VT.PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE =VT.TRANS_DATE_H)
 AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR =VT.TRAN_SEQ)
 AND (DGT.DGT_TYPE =4)
 )
 )VT ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_PLATE_NO := NULL;
 V_TRAN_SEQ := NULL;
 V_TRANS_DATE_H := NULL;

 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 IF STR.DISPALERT('يوجد أكثر من حركة على هذا البيان يجب إختيار أحد الحركات من القائمة' ,'WARNING')= ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 CALL_LOV_VHCL_BILL ;
 IF :global.TRAN_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_PLATE_NO := :global.PLATE_NO;
 V_TRAN_SEQ := :global.TRAN_SEQ;
 V_TRANS_DATE_H := :global.TRANS_DATE_H;
 ELSE
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END ;

 A_SHPMT_TYPE=V_A_SHPMT_TYPE,A_MFST_NBR=V_A_MFST_NBR,
 A_MFST_YEAR=V_A_MFST_YEAR,A_MFST_TYPE=V_A_MFST_TYPE,
 S_MFST_PORT_CD=V_S_MFST_PORT_CD,S_MFST_TYPE=V_S_MFST_TYPE,
 S_MFST_NBR=V_S_MFST_NBR,S_MFST_DT=V_S_MFST_DT,
 S_BL_SEQ=V_S_BL_SEQ,L_MNFST_ISN=V_L_MFST_ISN,
 L_BILL_NBR=V_L_BILL_NBR,
 DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_NBR=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR,
 DCLTN_DT=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT,IMPR_NBR=:DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR,
 OWNER_NAME=V_OWNER_NAME,NAT_CTRY_CD=V_NAT_CTRY_CD,
 ADDRESS=V_OWNER_ADRS,TEL_NBR=V_OWNER_TEL,ID_TYPE=V_ID_TYPE,
 ID_NBR=V_ID_NBR,ID_DT=V_ID_DT,SPECIAL_BILL_NBR=V_SPCL_BILL_NBR,
 BILL_QTY=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,BILL_WT=:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,
 BILL_DESC=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC,BILL_CTGRY=V_ITEM_CTGRY,
 RET_TYPE=2,TRANS_SEQ=V_TRAN_SEQ,TRANS_DT=V_TRANS_DATE_H,
 REP_TYPE=1,STAGE_CD=2,STATUS=0,S_BL_STA_CD=V_BILL_STATUS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT;

ELSIF (V_COUNT_REP_REPS=0)THEN


 -- 1 -- START إعطاء مسلسل عام و مسلسل حسب السنة و تاريخ لمحضر الحجز --
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(MAX (RET_BILL_NBR),0) + 1 INTO V_RET_BILL_NBR
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;

 TODAY := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 REQ_YEAR_DT := REVENUE.GET_FISCAL_YEAR_START(TODAY,ERROR_MSG);
 IF REQ_YEAR_DT IS NULL THEN
 IF ERROR_MSG IS NULL THEN
 ERROR_MSG := 'خطأ في احتساب بداية السنة المالية';
 END IF;
 STR.DISPALERT(ERROR_MSG,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 SELECT NVL(MAX(REP_NBR),0) + 1 INTO V_REP_NBR
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND TO_CHAR(REP_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI') >= TO_CHAR(REQ_YEAR_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI');

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
-- STR.DISPALERT('يوجد خطأ في ترقيم محضر الحجز' ,'ERROR');
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,11,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 -- END إعطاء مسلسل عام و مسلسل حسب السنة و تاريخ لمحضر الحجز --
BEGIN

 S_MFST_PORT_CD, S_MFST_TYPE, S_MFST_NBR, S_MFST_DT, S_BL_SEQ,
 L_MNFST_ISN, L_BILL_NBR,
 DCLTN_ISN, STATS_ISN, DCLTN_NBR, DCLTN_DT, IMPR_NBR,

 SPECIAL_BILL_NBR, BILL_QTY, BILL_WT, BILL_DESC, BILL_CTGRY, RET_TYPE,

 V_S_MFST_PORT_CD, V_S_MFST_TYPE, V_S_MFST_NBR,V_S_MFST_DT, V_S_BL_SEQ,
 V_L_MFST_ISN , V_L_BILL_NBR,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,NULL,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT,:DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR,
 V_OWNER_NAME,V_NAT_CTRY_CD,V_OWNER_ADRS,V_OWNER_TEL,V_ID_TYPE,V_ID_NBR,V_ID_DT,
 V_SPCL_BILL_NBR ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC,V_ITEM_CTGRY,2,
 V_TRAN_SEQ,V_TRANS_DATE_H,

 ) ;

/*

 */

 V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT:=V_RET_BILL_NBR;
:GLOBAL.NEW_RET_REPS:=1;
ELSIF V_COUNT_REP_REPS>1 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,6,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

END IF;
------------------------------------------------------------------RET_ITEMS
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET_ITEM
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND STAGE_CD IN(99,97)
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ ;

 IF V_RET_ITEM =1 THEN
 SELECT STAGE_CD INTO V_STAGE_CD
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND STAGE_CD IN(99,97)
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ ;

 IF V_STAGE_CD=99 THEN

 DELETE FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ ;
BEGIN

 INSERT INTO RET_ITEMS(PORT_CD, RET_BILL_NBR, RET_ITEM_NBR,
 ITEM_QTY, ITEM_WT, ITEM_CTRY_CD, ITEM_DESC,
 HRMNZD_CODE, STAGE_CD, STATUS,
 RESON_CD,BLNC_QTY, BLNC_WT, ITEM_ISN, INV_MSR_UNIT,DCLTN_QTY,DCLTN_WT)

 VALUES
 (:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,2,0,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.RET_RESONS,:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN, :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT);
 /*
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN

 str.dispalert('error in insert into ret_reps 22222 '||ERROR_CODE||' '||ERROR_TYPE||' '||ERROR_TEXT||' '||SQLCODE||' '||SQLERRM,'error');
 */

END;
 ELSIF V_STAGE_CD=97 THEN
 UPDATE RET_ITEMS SET ITEM_QTY=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY, ITEM_WT=:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,
 ITEM_CTRY_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD, ITEM_DESC=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC,
 HRMNZD_CODE=:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,
 STAGE_CD=2, STATUS=0,RESON_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.RET_RESONS,
 BLNC_QTY=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,BLNC_WT=:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,
 ITEM_ISN=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN,INV_MSR_UNIT=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT,
 DCLTN_QTY=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,DCLTN_WT=:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET_ITEM_H
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND STAGE_CD = 97
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT ;

 IF V_RET_ITEM_H >0 THEN
 UPDATE RET_REPS SET STAGE_CD=97,STATUS=0
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT;


 END IF;


 END IF;
 ELSIF V_RET_ITEM =0 THEN
BEGIN

 INSERT INTO RET_ITEMS(PORT_CD, RET_BILL_NBR, RET_ITEM_NBR,
 ITEM_QTY, ITEM_WT, ITEM_CTRY_CD, ITEM_DESC,
 HRMNZD_CODE, STAGE_CD, STATUS,
 RESON_CD,BLNC_QTY, BLNC_WT, ITEM_ISN, INV_MSR_UNIT,DCLTN_QTY,DCLTN_WT)

 VALUES
 (:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,2,0,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.RET_RESONS,:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN, :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT);


--EXCEPTION

--WHEN OTHERS THEN

-- str.dispalert('error IN INSERT INTO ret_reps 3333 '||ERROR_CODE||' '||ERROR_TYPE||' '||ERROR_TEXT||' '||SQLCODE||' '||SQLERRM,'error'); --

END;
 END IF;

----------------------------------------------------------------SOFT DELETE FOR RET_HANDING IF THIER EXIST
BEGIN
 SELECT ret_handings.RET_HANDING_NBR INTO V_RET_HANDING_NBR
 FROM RET_HANDING_BILLS,ret_handings
 WHERE (ret_handings.port_cd = ret_handing_bills.port_cd)
 AND (ret_handings.ret_handing_nbr = ret_handing_bills.ret_handing_nbr)
 AND ret_handing_bills.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND ret_handing_bills.RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND ret_handings.STATUS = 1;

 UPDATE RET_HANDINGS
 SET STATUS = 9
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_HANDING_NBR = V_RET_HANDING_NBR;



EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد خطأ في سجلات محاضر التسليم' ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END ;

-------------------------------------------------------------------ADJUST ON HAND
SELECT SUM(ITEM_QTY) ,SUM(ITEM_WT)
 INTO V_SUM_ITEM_QTY ,V_SUM_ITEM_WT
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND STATUS=0 ;

IF V_SUM_ITEM_QTY IS NULL AND V_SUM_ITEM_WT IS NULL THEN
 V_SUM_ITEM_QTY:=0;
 V_SUM_ITEM_WT :=0;
END IF;

UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET BILL_QTY=V_SUM_ITEM_QTY,BILL_WT=V_SUM_ITEM_WT,BLNC_QTY=V_SUM_ITEM_QTY,BLNC_WT=V_SUM_ITEM_WT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT;


 --هل يوجد صنف خطير أم لا
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS FROM RET_ITEMS RI
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1
 FROM harmonized_tariff HT,group_items gro,tariff_groups tar,group_instructions ginst,tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE ((HT.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (HT.HRMNZD_CODE =RI.HRMNZD_CODE )
 AND (tar_inst.DECREE_STATUS = 1)
 AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT >= TO_CHAR(tar_inst.eff_date,'RRRR-MM-MI'))
 AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT <= TO_CHAR(tar_inst.expry_date,'RRRR-MM-MI'))
 AND (tar_inst.INST_TYPE= 7)))
 AND PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT
 AND STATUS=0;


IF V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS=0 THEN

UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET BILL_CTGRY = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT;

ELSIF V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS>0 THEN

UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET BILL_CTGRY = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT;

END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.NEW_RET_REPS=1 THEN
 V_MESSAGE := 'تم إنشاء محضر حجز رقم ' ||V_RET_BILL_NBR||' بتاريخ ' ||TO_CHAR(TODAY,'MI-MM-YYYY');
 V_MESSAGE := V_MESSAGE ||' وصنف محضر حجز برقم '|| :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ;
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MESSAGE ,'INFORMATION');
 :GLOBAL.NEW_RET_REPS:=0;
ELSIF :GLOBAL.NEW_RET_REPS=0 THEN
 V_MESSAGE := 'تم إنشاء صنف محضر حجز رقم ' ||:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ ;
 V_MESSAGE := V_MESSAGE ||' لمحضر الحجز رقم '||V_RET_BILL_NBR_PARENT ;
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MESSAGE ,'INFORMATION');

END IF;

END;

/* Formatted on 2014/05/24 11:15 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
-- MODIFYIED BY MAIH@4145 IN 20/04/2008 OT ACHIEVE NEW BUSINESSES REQUIRED FOR BOOKED ITEMS

PROCEDURE ret_item
IS
 today DATE := NULL;
 req_year_dt DATE := NULL;
 error_msg VARCHAR2 (100) := NULL;
 v_ret_bill_nbr NUMBER := NULL;
 v_rep_nbr NUMBER := NULL;
 v_ret_item_nbr NUMBER := NULL;
 v_ret_bill_nbr_parent NUMBER := NULL;
 v_cnt NUMBER := NULL;
 v_count_rep_reps NUMBER;
 v_sum_item_qty NUMBER;
 v_sum_item_wt NUMBER;
 v_count_dangerouse_items NUMBER;
 v_ret_item NUMBER;
 -- AIR --
 v_a_carr_prefix NUMBER := NULL;
 v_a_bill_nbr VARCHAR2 (100) := NULL;
 v_a_bill_dt DATE := NULL;
 v_a_shpmt_type NUMBER := NULL;
 v_a_mfst_nbr NUMBER := NULL;
 v_a_mfst_year NUMBER := NULL;
 v_a_mfst_type NUMBER := NULL;
 -- SEA --
 v_s_mfst_port_cd NUMBER := NULL;
 v_s_mfst_type NUMBER := NULL;
 v_s_mfst_nbr NUMBER := NULL;
 v_s_mfst_dt DATE := NULL;
 v_s_bl_seq NUMBER := NULL;
 -- LAND --
 v_l_mfst_isn NUMBER := NULL;
 v_l_bill_nbr VARCHAR2 (100) := NULL;
--
 v_owner_name VARCHAR2 (200) := NULL;
 v_owner_tel VARCHAR2 (200) := NULL;
 v_owner_adrs VARCHAR2 (100) := NULL;
 v_nat_ctry_cd NUMBER := NULL;
 v_id_type NUMBER := NULL;
 v_id_nbr NUMBER := NULL;
 v_id_dt DATE := NULL;
--
 v_bill_ctgry NUMBER := 0;
 v_chk_bill NUMBER := 0;
 v_item_ctgry NUMBER := 1;
 v_plate_no VARCHAR2 (200) := NULL;
 v_tran_seq NUMBER := NULL;
 v_trans_date_h DATE := NULL;
 v_bill_status NUMBER := NULL;
 v_message VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_spcl_bill_nbr VARCHAR2 (50);
 v_ret_handing_nbr NUMBER;
 v_stage_cd NUMBER;
 v_hand_status NUMBER;
 v_ret_item_h NUMBER;
 v_ret_reps NUMBER;
BEGIN
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- START التحقق من نوع الجمرك هل هو بري او بحري او جوي و اختيار البوالص حسب نوع الجمرك --
 -- START التحقق من وجود محضر حجز خاص ببيان و بوليصة الصنف المختار و في حال وجوده التحقق من حالة محضر الحجز هل عادي ام خطر
 --
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = 4
 THEN -- جوي --
 BEGIN
 SELECT air.carr_prefix, air.bill_nbr, air.bill_dt, air.shpmt_type,
 air.mfst_nbr, air.mfst_year, air.mfst_type
 INTO v_a_carr_prefix, v_a_bill_nbr, v_a_bill_dt, v_a_shpmt_type,
 v_a_mfst_nbr, v_a_mfst_year, v_a_mfst_type
 FROM declarations d, air_dlvy_orders air
 WHERE ( (d.port_cd = air.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = air.stmt_isn)
 AND (d.port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn)
 );
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 cal_lov_air_dlvry_ordr;

 IF :GLOBAL.a_carr_prefix IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 v_a_carr_prefix := :GLOBAL.a_carr_prefix;
 v_a_bill_nbr := :GLOBAL.a_bill_nbr;
 v_a_bill_dt := :GLOBAL.a_bill_dt;
 v_a_shpmt_type := :GLOBAL.a_shpmt_type;
 v_a_mfst_nbr := :GLOBAL.a_mfst_nbr;
 v_a_mfst_year := :GLOBAL.a_mfst_year;
 v_a_mfst_type := :GLOBAL.a_mfst_type;
 END IF;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF v_a_carr_prefix IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT bills.bill_status
 INTO v_bill_status
 FROM declarations d,
 air_dlvy_orders air,
 bill_items bil,
 bills bills
 WHERE ( (d.port_cd = air.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = air.stmt_isn)
 AND (air.port_cd = bil.port_cd)
 AND (air.carr_prefix = bil.carr_prefix)
 AND (air.bill_nbr = bil.bill_nbr)
 AND (air.bill_dt = bil.bill_dt)
 AND (bil.port_cd = bills.port_cd)
 AND (bil.carr_prefix = bills.carr_prefix)
 AND (bil.bill_nbr = bills.bill_nbr)
 AND (bil.bill_dt = bills.bill_dt)
 AND (d.port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn)
 )
 AND ROWNUM = 1;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT owner_name, owner_tel
 INTO v_owner_name, v_owner_tel
 FROM bills
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND carr_prefix = v_a_carr_prefix
 AND bill_nbr = v_a_bill_nbr
 AND bill_dt = v_a_bill_dt;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 SELECT arbc_impr_name
 INTO v_owner_name
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND impr_nbr =
 (SELECT impr_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn);
 END;

--**KAMEL
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count_rep_reps
 FROM ret_reps
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND NVL (stage_cd, 0) IN (99, 2)
 --AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 1
 AND a_carr_prefix = v_a_carr_prefix
 AND a_bill_nbr = v_a_bill_nbr
 AND a_bill_dt = v_a_bill_dt

 --هل يوجد صنف خطير أم لا
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count_dangerouse_items
 FROM ret_items ri
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM harmonized_tariff ht,
 group_items gro,
 tariff_groups tar,
 group_instructions ginst,
 tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE ( (ht.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (ht.hrmnzd_code = ri.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar_inst.decree_status = 1)
 AND (:dcltn_hdr.dcltn_dt >=
 TO_CHAR (tar_inst.eff_date, 'RRRR-MM-MI')
 )
 AND (:dcltn_hdr.dcltn_dt <=
 TO_CHAR (tar_inst.expry_date, 'RRRR-MM-MI')
 )

 ))
 AND port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND ret_bill_nbr = v_ret_bill_nbr_parent
 AND status = 0;

 IF v_count_dangerouse_items = 0
 THEN

 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND ret_bill_nbr = v_ret_bill_nbr_parent;
 ELSIF v_count_dangerouse_items > 0

 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND ret_bill_nbr = v_ret_bill_nbr_parent;

 IF :GLOBAL.new_ret_reps = 1
 THEN
 v_message :=

 || v_REP_NBR
 || ' بتاريخ '

 THEN

 v_message := v_message || ' لمحضر الحجز رقم ' || v_REP_NBR;
 str.dispalert (v_message, 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REJECT_CERT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REJECT_CERT IS
DEPT_ID NUMBER;
BEGIN

BEGIN
SELECT SPCL_DEPT_ID
 INTO DEPT_ID
FROM DECLARATIONS
WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END ;


 --***************** <<>> MOHAMED HABIB <<>> *********************
 --*************وظيفه الرفض على شهادة المطابقه **********************--
 --***************************************************************

IF :IDEN_CERT_APPRV=8 AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) AND DEPT_ID IS NULL THEN
STR.DispALERT(' هذة المعامله يجب تحويلها للمعمل لاسباب الاختيار العشوائى لا يمكن تأكيد شهادة المطابقة ','information');
terminate_fun;
ELSE


 IF(:IDEN_CERT_APPRV =1 OR :IDEN_CERT_APPRV IS NULL) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) AND DEPT_ID IS NULL THEN -- رئيس مجموعة

 UPDT_CERT(1,1); -- رئيس مجموعة --

 ELSIF :IDEN_CERT_APPRV IN (3,5) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_RSTRCT') AND DEPT_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.RSTRCT_DEPT') THEN -- موظف قيود

 UPDT_CERT(3,1);

 ELSIF :IDEN_CERT_APPRV IN(6,8) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_SMPL') AND DEPT_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.LAB_DEPT') THEN -- موظف تحليل عينات--

 UPDT_CERT(6,1);

 END IF;





END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_DELETE_EXCEMPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PALESTINE_DELETE_EXCEMPTION(V$STMT_UPDATE NUMBER DEFAULT 0,V$DCLTN_PAYED NUMBER ) IS

V$DECREE_ISN NUMBER;
BEGIN


IF V$STMT_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 IF V$DCLTN_PAYED =0 THEN
 IF :EXMTN_TYPE=4 AND CHK_EXCEMTION_ISN_PALESTINE(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN) =TRUE THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD := NULL;
 :EXMTN_DECREE_ISN := NULL;
 :EXMTN_TYPE := NULL;
 :EXMTD_CIF := NULL;
 :EXMTD_DUTY := NULL;
 :EXMTN_APRVL_DT := NULL;
 :EXMTN_APPRV_USR_ID := NULL;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE



DECLARE


CURSOR ITEMS IS SELECT ITEM_ISN,CTRY_CD,EXMTN_TYPE,CIF_COST,ORGNL_DUTY,EXMTN_DECREE_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE
 PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND INV_ISN=:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND CTRY_CD=165
 AND EXMTN_TYPE=4 ;
BEGIN

 FOR CUR IN ITEMS LOOP

 IF CHK_EXCEMTION_ISN_PALESTINE(CUR.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN) =TRUE THEN
 IF V$DCLTN_PAYED =0 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS SET
 EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD = NULL
 ,EXMTN_DECREE_ISN = NULL
 ,EXMTN_TYPE = NULL
 ,EXMTD_CIF = NULL
 ,EXMTD_DUTY = NULL
 ,EXMTN_APRVL_DT = NULL
 ,EXMTN_APPRV_USR_ID = NULL
 WHERE
 ITEM_ISN=CUR.ITEM_ISN AND PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لايمكن تغير بلد المنشأ لغير فلسطين لأن البيان مدفوع','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END LOOP;

END;

END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION(V$EXEMPTION_ISN NUMBER,V$STMT_UPDATE NUMBER DEFAULT 0,V$INV_ISN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL) IS
V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(3500):=NULL;
 RET NUMBER;
 V$BUTTON NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF DCLTN.DCLTN_PAYED(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) =0 THEN
IF V$STMT_UPDATE = 0 THEN



SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD;
 :EXMTN_DECREE_ISN := V$EXEMPTION_ISN;
 :EXMTN_TYPE := 4;
 :EXMTD_CIF := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST;
 :EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY;
 :EXMTN_APRVL_DT := NULL;
 :EXMTN_APPRV_USR_ID := NULL;
ELSE


BEGIN

FOR CUR IN (SELECT ROWNUM||'- الصنف'||'('||ITEM_SEQ ||')' MSG FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND INV_ISN= :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND CTRY_CD=165 AND DUTY_TYPE=1
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL) LOOP


 IF LENGTH (V_MSG || CUR.MSG)<3000 THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CUR.MSG||CHR(10);
 END IF;
END LOOP;

 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V$BUTTON:= STR.DISPALERT('هل تريد أنشاء اعفاء بضائع فلسطينية على الصنف ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF V$BUTTON=ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS SET
 EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 ,EXMTN_DECREE_ISN = V$EXEMPTION_ISN
 ,EXMTN_TYPE = 4
 ,EXMTD_CIF = CIF_COST
 ,EXMTD_DUTY = ORGNL_DUTY
 ,EXMTN_APRVL_DT = NULL
 ,EXMTN_APPRV_USR_ID = NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND INV_ISN= :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND CTRY_CD=165 AND DUTY_TYPE=1
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL;

 V_MSG:='هناك اصناف تم اعفائها وهي:-'||CHR(10)||V_MSG;
 RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR', 1, 'الاصناف التي تم اعفائها اعفاء فلسطيني',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1150, 'r0g0b75', 12);

 END IF;
 END IF;



END;



END IF;
END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;

END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION(V$INV_ISN NUMBER,V$DATABASE_SRCNAME NUMBER DEFAULT 1) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
V$SRCE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
V$EXEMPTION_ISN NUMBER;
RESULT NUMBER;
BEGIN



BEGIN
IF V$DATABASE_SRCNAME = 1 THEN
SELECT src.srce_name INTO V$SRCE_NAME
 FROM dcltn_invoices dcl, srce_cmpys src
 WHERE ((src.port_cd = dcl.port_cd) AND (src.srce_nbr = dcl.srce_nbr))
 AND dcl.port_cd=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD AND dcl.INV_ISN =V$INV_ISN;

ELSE
V$SRCE_NAME:=:SRCE_NAME;
END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION;
END;


 DECLARE
 CURSOR NAME_EXP IS SELECT EXPR_ARB_NAME FROM PALESTINE_EXPORTER WHERE STATUS=1 ;

 BEGIN
 FOR LOOP$NAME_EXP IN NAME_EXP LOOP
 RESULT:= STR_DB.NAMESMATCH( LOOP$NAME_EXP.EXPR_ARB_NAME, V$SRCE_NAME, 1, 0);
 IF RESULT=0 THEN
 V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION:=TRUE;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END;

RETURN V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_ALARM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PALESTINE_ALARM(V$INVOISE_CHNG NUMBER DEFAULT 0) IS
V$EXEMPTION_ISN NUMBER;
V$BUTTON NUMBER;
V$EXMTN_TYPE NUMBER;
V$DCLTN_PAYED NUMBER:=NVL(DCLTN.DCLTN_PAYED(:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN),0);
BEGIN


IF V$INVOISE_CHNG =0 THEN
IF V$DCLTN_PAYED =0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE INTO V$EXMTN_TYPE FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE
 PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND ITEM_ISN=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN;
 END;



 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF') THEN
 IF PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN) =TRUE THEN
 IF CHK_VALID_DECREE(V$EXEMPTION_ISN)=TRUE AND V$EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL THEN
 V$BUTTON:= STR.DISPALERT('هل تريد أنشاء اعفاء بضائع فلسطينية على الصنف ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF V$BUTTON=ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION(V$EXEMPTION_ISN);
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('الرجاء مراجعة قرار الاعفاء بسبب انه لايمكن اعتماده','ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('الشركة المصدره ليست ضمن القوائم الفلسطينية','ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
ELSE
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF') THEN
 IF PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION(NULL,0) =TRUE THEN
 IF V$DCLTN_PAYED =0 THEN
 IF CHK_VALID_DECREE(V$EXEMPTION_ISN)=TRUE THEN
 PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION(V$EXEMPTION_ISN,1);
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('الرجاء مراجعة قرار الاعفاء بسبب انه لايمكن اعتماده','ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 PALESTINE_DELETE_EXCEMPTION(1,V$DCLTN_PAYED);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: OPN_BLK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE OPN_BLK IS
BEGIN

 :GLOBAL.CERT_UPDATE_FLAG:=1;
 set_BLOCK_property('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 set_item_property('IDEN_CERT_NBR',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('IDEN_CERT_NBR',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 set_item_property('IDEN_CERT_DT',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

ProgramUnit.Name: MULTI_DOC_WVRS_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE MULTI_DOC_WVRS_OLD IS
Y VARCHAR2(200);
RET NUMBER;
V_RESULT NUMBER;
FUNCTION CREATE_WVR(V_WVR_TYPE NUMBER,V_END_DAYS NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_WVR_SEQ NUMBER;
V_ISSUED_DT DATE;
V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
V_BRK_LIC_TYPE NUMBER;
V_BRK_LIC_NBR NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER;
V_BRKR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
V_CUR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
V_ITEM_SER_NBR NUMBER;
V_END_DATE DATE;
X NUMBER;

V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 --str.dispalert(' 0 ','error'); --------------------------- MAIH
SELECT COUNT(WVR_SEQ_NBR) INTO X FROM CUSTOMS.WAIVERS WHERE WVR_PORT_CD=:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD AND (DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN OR STATS_ISN=:DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN);
IF X > 0 THEN
 --str.dispalert(' 1 ','error'); --------------------------- MAIH
SELECT WVR_SEQ_NBR,ISSUED_DT INTO V_WVR_SEQ,V_ISSUED_DT FROM CUSTOMS.WAIVERS WHERE WVR_PORT_CD=:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD AND (DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN OR STATS_ISN=:DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN) AND ROWNUM=1;
SELECT NVL(MAX(ITEM_SER_NBR),0)+1 INTO V_ITEM_SER_NBR FROM CUSTOMS.WVR_ITEMS WHERE WVR_PORT_CD=:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD AND WVR_SEQ_NBR=V_WVR_SEQ AND ISSUED_DT=V_ISSUED_DT;
ELSE
 --str.dispalert(' 2 ','error'); --------------------------- MAIH
SELECT WVR_SEQ.NEXTVAL INTO V_WVR_SEQ
 FROM SYS.DUAL;
V_ISSUED_DT:=HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
V_ITEM_SER_NBR:=1;
SELECT IMPR_NBR, LIC_TYPE, LIC_NBR,DCLTN_TYPE_CD,BRKR_PORT_CD INTO V_IMPR_NBR, V_BRK_LIC_TYPE, V_BRK_LIC_NBR,V_DCLTN_TYPE,V_BRKR_PORT_CD
FROM DECLARATIONS WHERE DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN;
 --str.dispalert(' 3 ','error'); --------------------------- MAIH
INSERT INTO CUSTOMS.WAIVERS
(WVR_PORT_CD, WVR_SEQ_NBR, ISSUED_DT, WVR_TYPE, DCLTN_TYPE, DCLTN_ISN, IMPR_NBR, BRK_PORT_CD, BRK_LIC_TYPE, BRK_LIC_NBR, WVR_STATUS)
 VALUES
(:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD, V_WVR_SEQ, V_ISSUED_DT,1,1, :DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN, V_IMPR_NBR,V_BRKR_PORT_CD, V_BRK_LIC_TYPE, V_BRK_LIC_NBR, 1);
 --STANDARD.COMMIT; ---- MAIH
 --str.dispalert(' 4 ','error'); --------------------------- MAIH
IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(4, 1, 1, :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD||'!'||V_WVR_SEQ||'!'||V_ISSUED_DT) THEN
 RAISE FORm_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;
END IF;
V_END_DATE:=HIJDATE_DB.ADD_HIJ_MONTHS(HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,V_END_DAYS,V_MSG_TXT);
 --str.dispalert(' 5 ' || :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD||' '|| V_WVR_SEQ||' '|| V_ISSUED_DT||' '||V_ITEM_SER_NBR||' '||HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE||' '||V_END_DATE||' '||V_WVR_TYPE||' '||:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN,'error'); --------------------------- MAIH
INSERT INTO CUSTOMS.WVR_ITEMS
 (WVR_PORT_CD, WVR_SEQ_NBR, ISSUED_DT, ITEM_SER_NBR, ITEM_ISSUE_DT, ITEM_END_DT, ITEM_TYPE_CD, DOC_INVOISE_ISN)
 VALUES
(:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD, V_WVR_SEQ, V_ISSUED_DT,V_ITEM_SER_NBR,HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,V_END_DATE,V_WVR_TYPE,:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN);
 --str.dispalert(' 6 ','error'); --------------------------- MAIH
IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(4, 5, 1, :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD||'!'||V_WVR_SEQ||'!'||V_ISSUED_DT||'!'||V_ITEM_SER_NBR) THEN
 RAISE FORm_Trigger_Failure;
END IF;

RETURN V_WVR_SEQ;
END;

BEGIN
IF :INV_PMT_METHOD = 1 THEN
 RET:=STR.DISPALERT('فى حالة الدفع النقدى لا يمكن إنشاء تعهد','ERROR');
ELSIF :INV_PMT_METHOD = 6 THEN
 RET:=STR.DISPALERT('سيتم إنشاء تعهد بإحضار مستندات لصفقه مفرده لمدة سنة فى حالة ضغط زر "نعم" , فى حالة ضغط زر "لا" سيتم إنشاء تعهد بإحضار مستندات لصفقه متعدده لمدة سنة , فى حال ضغط زر "إلغاء" لن يتم إنشاء تعهدات','CFG_ASK_COMMIT');
ELSE
 RET:=STR.DISPALERT('سيتم إنشاء تعهد بإحضار مستندات لصفقه مفرده لمدة 3 شهور فى حالة ضغط زر "نعم" , فى حالة ضغط زر "لا" سيتم إنشاء تعهد بإحضار مستندات لصفقه متعدده لمدة 3 شهور , فى حال ضغط زر "إلغاء" لن يتم إنشاء تعهدات','CFG_ASK_COMMIT');
END IF;
IF RET=ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF :INV_PMT_METHOD = 1 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF :INV_PMT_METHOD = 6 THEN
 V_RESULT:=CREATE_WVR(15,12);
 ELSE
 V_RESULT:=CREATE_WVR(15,3);
 END IF;
Y:='تم إنشاء تعهد برقم '||TO_CHAR(V_RESULT)||'وبتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,'MI-MM-YYYY');
IF :INV_PMT_METHOD <> 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(Y,'INFORMATION');
END IF;
ELSIF RET=ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 IF :INV_PMT_METHOD = 6 THEN
 V_RESULT:=CREATE_WVR(16,12);
 ELSE
 V_RESULT:=CREATE_WVR(16,3);

 END IF;
Y:='تم إنشاء تعهد برقم '||TO_CHAR(V_RESULT)||'وبتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,'MI-MM-YYYY');
 STR.DISPALERT(Y,'INFORMATION');
ELSE
 NULL;
END IF;
STANDARD.COMMIT;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MULTI_DOC_WVRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2014/01/15 13:54 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
-- --> 07/01/2014 AHMED A-MONIM Using Payment Methods

PROCEDURE multi_doc_wvrs
IS
 y VARCHAR2 (200);
 ret NUMBER;
 v_result NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
 v_inv_pmt_method NUMBER;
 v_deal_flag NUMBER;

--========================================================================================================
 FUNCTION create_wvr (v_inv_isn NUMBER, v_wvr_type NUMBER, v_end_days NUMBER)
 RETURN NUMBER
 IS
 v_wvr_seq NUMBER;
 v_issued_dt DATE;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_brk_lic_type NUMBER;
 v_brk_lic_nbr NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_type NUMBER;
 v_brkr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_cur_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_item_ser_nbr NUMBER;
 v_end_date DATE;
 x NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2 (200);
 BEGIN
--------------------------- MAIH
 SELECT COUNT (wvr_seq_nbr)
 INTO x
 FROM customs.waivers
 WHERE wvr_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND ( dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
-- OR stats_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 );

 IF x > 0
 THEN
--------------------------- MAIH
 SELECT wvr_seq_nbr, issued_dt
 INTO v_wvr_seq, v_issued_dt
 FROM customs.waivers
 WHERE wvr_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND ( dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
-- OR stats_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 )
 AND ROWNUM = 1;

 SELECT NVL (MAX (item_ser_nbr), 0) + 1
 INTO v_item_ser_nbr
 FROM customs.wvr_items
 WHERE wvr_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND wvr_seq_nbr = v_wvr_seq
 AND issued_dt = v_issued_dt;
 ELSE
--------------------------- MAIH
 SELECT wvr_seq.NEXTVAL
 INTO v_wvr_seq
 FROM SYS.DUAL;

 v_issued_dt := hijdate_db.cur_hij_date;
 v_item_ser_nbr := 1;

 SELECT impr_nbr, lic_type, lic_nbr, dcltn_type_cd,
 brkr_port_cd
 INTO v_impr_nbr, v_brk_lic_type, v_brk_lic_nbr, v_dcltn_type,
 v_brkr_port_cd
 FROM declarations
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn;

 IF v_dcltn_type IN ( 1,2 ) THEN
 v_dcltn_type := 1;
 ELSIF v_dcltn_type IN ( 3,4,5,6 ) THEN
 v_dcltn_type := 3;
 END IF;

--------------------------- MAIH
 INSERT INTO customs.waivers
 (wvr_port_cd, wvr_seq_nbr, issued_dt, wvr_type,
 dcltn_type, dcltn_isn, impr_nbr,
 brk_port_cd, brk_lic_type, brk_lic_nbr, wvr_status
 )
 VALUES (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd, v_wvr_seq, v_issued_dt, 1,
 v_dcltn_type, :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn, v_impr_nbr,
 v_brkr_port_cd, v_brk_lic_type, v_brk_lic_nbr, 1
 );

--------------------------- MAIH
 IF NOT activity.add_activity (4,
 1,
 1,
 :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_wvr_seq
 || '!'
 || v_issued_dt
 )
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 v_end_date :=
 hijdate_db.add_hij_months (hijdate_db.cur_hij_date,
 v_end_days,
 v_msg_txt
 );

 INSERT INTO customs.wvr_items
 (wvr_port_cd, wvr_seq_nbr, issued_dt,
 item_ser_nbr, item_issue_dt, item_end_dt,
 item_type_cd, doc_invoise_isn
 )
 VALUES (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd, v_wvr_seq, v_issued_dt,
 v_item_ser_nbr, hijdate_db.cur_hij_date, v_end_date,
 v_wvr_type, v_inv_isn
 );

--------------------------- MAIH
 IF NOT activity.add_activity (4,
 5,
 1,
 :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_wvr_seq
 || '!'
 || v_issued_dt
 || '!'
 || v_item_ser_nbr
 )
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

--==========================================================================
--V_WVR_SEQ, V_ISSUED_DT,V_ITEM_SER_NBR

 UPDATE dcltn_deal_dtls
 SET wvr_seq_nbr = v_wvr_seq,
 wvr_dt = v_issued_dt,
 item_ser_nbr = v_item_ser_nbr
 WHERE dcltn_stats_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND doc_delivered_flag = 0
 AND inv_pmt_method > 1
 AND ((inv_pmt_method = 6 AND V_inv_pmt_method = 12) OR
 (inv_pmt_method <> 6 AND V_inv_pmt_method = 3))
 AND deal_flag IN (1, 2, 3)
 AND inv_isn = v_inv_isn;

--==========================================================================
 RETURN v_wvr_seq;
 END;
--========================================================================================================
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM dcltn_deal_dtls
 WHERE dcltn_stats_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND doc_delivered_flag = 0
 AND inv_pmt_method > 1
 AND deal_flag IN (1, 2, 3)
 AND wvr_seq_nbr IS NULL);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يمكن إنشاء تعهدات لعدم وجود مستندات لم يتم تسليمها',
 'ERROR'
 );
 ELSE
 DECLARE
 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT inv_isn, deal_flag, inv_pmt_method,DEAL_DTLS_SEQ
 FROM dcltn_deal_dtls
 WHERE dcltn_stats_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND doc_delivered_flag = 0
 AND inv_pmt_method > 1
 AND deal_flag IN (1, 2, 3)
 AND wvr_seq_nbr IS NULL
 ORDER BY DEAL_DTLS_SEQ;
 v_count3 NUMBER;
 v_count12 NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
 v_count3 := 0;
 v_count12 := 0;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count3
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM wvr_items
 WHERE item_type_cd IN (15, 16)
 AND doc_invoise_isn = x.inv_isn
 AND item_end_dt - item_issue_dt < 6*30
 AND X.inv_pmt_method <> 6);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count3 := 0;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count12
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM wvr_items
 WHERE item_type_cd IN (15, 16)
 AND doc_invoise_isn = x.inv_isn
 AND item_end_dt - item_issue_dt > 6*30
 AND X.inv_pmt_method = 6);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count12 := 0;
 END;

 v_count := NVL(v_count3, 0) + NVL(v_count12, 0);



 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 IF x.deal_flag = 2
 THEN
 v_deal_flag := 16;
 ELSE
 v_deal_flag := 15;
 END IF;

 IF x.inv_pmt_method = 6
 THEN
 v_inv_pmt_method := 12;
 ELSE
 v_inv_pmt_method := 3;
 END IF;

 v_result :=
 create_wvr (x.inv_isn, v_deal_flag, v_inv_pmt_method);
 y :=
 'تم إنشاء تعهد برقم '
 || TO_CHAR (v_result)
 || 'وبتاريخ '
 || TO_CHAR (hijdate_db.cur_hij_date, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 str.dispalert (y, 'INFORMATION');
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 END IF;
END;
-- --< 07/01/2014 AHMED A-MONIM Using Payment Methods

 HRMNZ_TAX VARCHAR2(100);

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_ITEM_SUB_HRMNZ
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND ITEM_ISN=:ITEM_ISN AND HRMNZD_CODE=:GLOBAL.HTHRMNZD_CODE;

 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN





begin
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_ITEM_SUB_HRMNZ (PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,HRMNZD_CODE,TAX_SEQ,REC_STATUS)
 VALUES
 (:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:ITEM_ISN,:GLOBAL.HTHRMNZD_CODE,:GLOBAL.TAX_SEQ,1);


exception

when others then
STR.DISPALERT( sqlerrm,'ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;




 end ;

 forms_ddl('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT( 'تم إضافة السعر بنجاح','INFORMATION');

 ELSE


 -- BEGIN
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEM_SUB_HRMNZ
 SET TAX_SEQ=:GLOBAL.TAX_SEQ
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND ITEM_ISN=:ITEM_ISN AND HRMNZD_CODE=:GLOBAL.HTHRMNZD_CODE;

 /*
 exception

when others then
STR.DISPALERT( sqlerrm,'ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;




 end ;
 */




 forms_ddl('COMMIT');

ProgramUnit.Name: LOCAL_GET_DUTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LOCAL_GET_DUTY(CIF_VAL OUT NUMBER, DUTY_VAL OUT NUMBER) IS
 INV_REC DUTY.T_DCLTN_INVOICES_DUTY;
 LIN DUTY.T_DCLTN_ITEMS_DUTY;
 CALC_DT DATE;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_MSG_TXT_cif VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_TEMP NUMBER;
 V_TRF_CALC_DT DATE;
 cif_val_true NUMBER;
BEGIN
 CIF_VAL := NULL;
 DUTY_VAL := NULL;

 -- FILL THE RECORD FROM THE BLOCK
 INV_REC.INV_TYPE := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG := :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG;
 INV_REC.INS_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.INS_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD ;
 -- CR-8539 start
 INV_REC.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES ;
 INV_REC.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD ;
 -- CR-8539 end
 INV_REC.OTHER_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.OTHER_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.DISC_PCTG := :DCLTN_INVOICES.DISC_PCTG ;
 INV_REC.TOTAL_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.INV_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD ;

 -- FILL THE RECORD FROM THE BLOCK
 LIN.PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD ;
 LIN.ITEM_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;
 LIN.INV_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN ;
 LIN.BRKR_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD ;
 LIN.BRKR_TARIFF_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_DT ;
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD ;
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_DT ;
 LIN.DUTY_TYPE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE ;
 LIN.PNLTY_RQR := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNLTY_RQR ;
 LIN.TRF_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.INV_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST ;
 LIN.CIF_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST ;
 LIN.CSTMS_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST ;
 LIN.GROSS_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT ;
 LIN.ORGNL_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY ;
 LIN.EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY ;

 CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_TRF_CALC_DT := NVL(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT, CALC_DT);

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT FINAL_CTRY_CD
 INTO V_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN
 V_TEMP := DUTY.GET_ITEM_DUTY (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT, CIF_VAL, DUTY_VAL, V_MSG_TXT);
 IF V_TEMP = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 CIF_VAL_true := DUTY.GET_LINE_CIF (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT,CIF_VAL,v_msg_txt_cif);
 V_TEMP := S_DUTY.GET_GULF_TRF_DUTY (V_FINAL_CTRY_CD, LIN.TRF_UNIT_QTY, LIN.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY, CIF_VAL,
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_CD, LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_DT, V_TRF_CALC_DT, DUTY_VAL, V_MSG_TXT, :DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD);
 IF V_TEMP = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF CIF_VAL_true = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT_cif, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 -- STOP ROUNGDING FROM S_DUTY FOR STATISTICAL IMPORT 14-06-2004
 DUTY_VAL := DCLTN.SET_HALALA(DUTY_VAL);
 END IF;
 DUTY_VAL := NVL(DUTY_VAL, 0);
 END IF; -- DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE

 IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 CIF_VAL_true := DUTY.GET_LINE_CIF (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT,CIF_VAL,v_msg_txt_cif);
 DUTY_VAL := 0;
 IF CIF_VAL_true = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT_cif, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LIGHT_OR_HIKAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION light_or_hikal RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 -- CR-5680
 V_FEES_USED_CARS_5060 NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('FEES_USED_CARS_5060', 21), 0);
 V_FEES_USED_CARS_DATE DATE := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('FEES_USED_CARS_DATE', '21'), '01-01-1450'),'MI-MM-YYYY') ;
 v_CHASIS_NO_ENTRY NUMBER := NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting('CHASIS_NO_ENTRY',21),0);
 v_chasis_effect_dt NUMBER;

 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER ;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER ;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 v_car_agent_flag NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,car_agent_flag
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD ,V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,v_car_agent_flag
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE IMPORTERS.IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 AND IMPORTERS.PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 ;
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS GI
 WHERE GI.HRMNZD_CODE = :FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND GI.GRP_CODE = 269
 ;


 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 2 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 THEN
 IF V_FEES_USED_CARS_5060 = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT >= V_FEES_USED_CARS_DATE AND DCLTN.GET_TARIFF_GROUP_CD(:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD) = 1 AND (V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD IN (3,5) OR V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 9) THEN
 RETURN 'light';
 END IF;
 -------------
 v_chasis_effect_dt := hijdate_db.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_dt) - NVL(hijdate_db.to_greg(TO_DATE(gnrl.get_customs_setting('CHASIS_NO_STRT_DT',21),'YYYY-MM-MI')),TO_DATE('31-12-3000','dd-mm-yyyy'));
 IF v_CHASIS_NO_ENTRY = 1 AND v_chasis_effect_dt >= 0 AND V_CNT = 1 AND v_car_agent_flag = 0 THEN
 RETURN 'haikal';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --------------
 RETURN 'others';
END;
