ProgramUnit.Name: ITEM_RET_REPS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ITEM_RET_REPS IS
 V_ITEM_STAGE_CD NUMBER;
 V_ACTION_CD NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_STAGE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 VV_ITEM_STAGE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_ACTION_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_RET_BILL_NBR NUMBER;
 V_RET_ITEM_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DUTY_TYPE = 26 THEN
SELECT STAGE_CD,RET_BILL_NBR,RET_ITEM_NBR INTO V_ITEM_STAGE_CD,V_RET_BILL_NBR,V_RET_ITEM_NBR
FROM RET_ITEMS WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD AND ITEM_ISN=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN;
IF V_ITEM_STAGE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN

 BEGIN
 IF V_ITEM_STAGE_CD IN (90,91) THEN
 --- 1
 SELECT DISTINCT RAI.ACTION_CD INTO V_ACTION_CD
 FROM RET_ACTION_ITEMS RAI
 WHERE
 RAI.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND RAI.RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND RAI.RET_ITEM_NBR = V_RET_ITEM_NBR
 --mohamed habib
 AND ACTION_NBR = (SELECT MAX(ACTION_NBR)
 FROM RET_ACTION_ITEMS RAI
 WHERE
 RAI.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND RAI.RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND RAI.RET_ITEM_NBR = V_RET_ITEM_NBR) ;
 ----------------------------------------------------
 --- 2
 SELECT DISTINCT RLA.ACTION_DESC INTO V_ACTION_NAME
 FROM RET_LFT_ACTIONS RLA
 WHERE RLA.ACTION_CD = V_ACTION_CD ;
 --- 3
 SELECT DISTINCT STAGE_NAME
 INTO V_ITEM_STAGE_NAME
 FROM RET_LFT_STAGES
 WHERE STAGE_CD = V_ITEM_STAGE_CD;
 --- 4
 VV_ITEM_STAGE_NAME := V_ITEM_STAGE_NAME ||'('||V_ACTION_NAME||')';

 ELSE
 SELECT DISTINCT STAGE_NAME
 INTO VV_ITEM_STAGE_NAME
 FROM RET_LFT_STAGES
 WHERE STAGE_CD = V_ITEM_STAGE_CD;

 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 STR.DISPALERT(' هذا الصنف حالته '||VV_ITEM_STAGE_NAME,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;

END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_TARIF_DANGER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--IS_TARIF_DANGER
--DESCRIPTION : TO CHECK IF TARIFF IS DANGER OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 01-06-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION IS_TARIF_DANGER(V_HARMONIZED_TARIFF VARCHAR2,V_DCLTN_DT DATE) RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_DATE DATE;
BEGIN
 V_DATE := V_DCLTN_DT ;
 IF V_DATE IS NULL THEN
 V_DATE :=HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM harmonized_tariff HT,
 group_items gro,
 tariff_groups tar,
 group_instructions ginst,
 tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE ((HT.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (HT.HRMNZD_CODE=V_HARMONIZED_TARIFF)
 AND (tar_inst.DECREE_STATUS=1)
 AND (V_DATE >=tar_inst.eff_date)
 AND (V_DATE <=tar_inst.expry_date)
 AND (tar_inst.INST_TYPE=7)
 );
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_SUS_COMP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_SUS_COMP (V_NAME IN VARCHAR2, V_COMP_LIST OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
----------------------------------- SHAPE STRING -------------------------------------------
 SINGLE_QUOTE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := '''';
 DOUBLE_QUOTE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := '''''';
 DELIMITER CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := ' ';
 NEW_DELIMITER CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := CHR(1000); -- THIS CHARACTER NOT REMOVED BY STR.STRFORMAT()
 COMMA CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := ', ';
------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 RG_NAME CONSTANT VARCHAR2(20) := 'CHK_BOYCOTT_RG';
 RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
 RG_POP NUMBER;
 V_TEMP VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_QRY VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 GC_ID GROUPCOLUMN;
BEGIN
------------------------------------ SHAPE STRING -------------------------------------------
 V_TEMP := LTRIM(RTRIM(V_NAME));
 V_TEMP := REPLACE(V_TEMP, DELIMITER, NEW_DELIMITER);
 V_TEMP := STR.STRFORMAT(V_TEMP);
 V_TEMP := REPLACE(V_TEMP, NEW_DELIMITER, SINGLE_QUOTE || COMMA || SINGLE_QUOTE);
 V_TEMP := SINGLE_QUOTE || V_TEMP || SINGLE_QUOTE;

------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 RG_ID := FIND_GROUP(RG_NAME);
 IF NOT ID_NULL(RG_ID) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 END IF;

 V_TEMP := UPPER(V_TEMP);

-- STR.DISPALERT('EEE '||V_TEMP,'ERROR'); --

 V_QRY := '(SELECT
BC.COMP_ENG_NM COMP_ENG_NM,
BC.COMP_ARB_NM COMP_ARB_NM,
BC.CTRY_CD CTRY_CD,
BC.EXP_COMP_ISN,
BC.SUS_TYPE SUS_TYPE,
BC.COMMENTS COMMENTS
 FROM SUSEXPCOMP_WORDS BW, SUS_EXP_COMPS BC, COUNTRIES C,CG_REF_CODES CG
 WHERE
WORD_STD IN(''||V_TEMP||'')
AND TO_CHAR(BW.EXP_COMP_ISN) = TO_CHAR(BC.EXP_COMP_ISN)
 AND C.CTRY_CD = BC.CTRY_CD
 AND CG.RV_DOMAIN = ''SUS_TYPE''
 AND CG.RV_LOW_VALUE=BC.SUS_TYPE
 AND BC.SUS_TYPE<>4
 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
 GROUP BY
BC.COMP_ENG_NM,
 BC.COMP_ARB_NM,
 BC.CTRY_CD,
BC.EXP_COMP_ISN,
BC.SUS_TYPE,
 BC.COMMENTS)';

 RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY(RG_NAME, V_QRY);
 IF ID_NULL(RG_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' المراقبة لا يمكن البحث داخل الشركات ', 'ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 RG_POP := POPULATE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 IF RG_POP <> 0 THEN
 -- IF RECORDGROUP IS EMPTY
 IF RG_POP = 1403 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن البحث داخل الشركات المراقبة - خطأ رقم ' || RG_POP, 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 V_CNT := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(RG_ID);
 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 V_COMP_LIST := 'عدد الشركات المراقبة المشابهة : ' || V_CNT || CHR(10);




 FOR I IN 1 .. V_CNT
 LOOP
 V_COMP_LIST := V_COMP_LIST || GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(GC_ID, I) || CHR(10);
 END LOOP;

 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_SUS_BCOTT_COMP_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_SUS_BCOTT_COMP_OLD (V_NAME IN VARCHAR2, V_COMP_LIST OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
----------------------------------- SHAPE STRING -------------------------------------------
 SINGLE_QUOTE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := '''';
 DOUBLE_QUOTE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := '''''';
 DELIMITER CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := ' ';
 NEW_DELIMITER CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := CHR(1000); -- THIS CHARACTER NOT REMOVED BY STR.STRFORMAT()
 COMMA CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := ', ';
------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 RG_NAME CONSTANT VARCHAR2(20) := 'CHK_BOYCOTT_RG';
 RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
 RG_POP NUMBER;
 V_TEMP VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_QRY VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 GC_ID GROUPCOLUMN;
V_MSG_LVL NUMBER;

BEGIN
IF V_NAME IS NULL THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
END IF;
------------------------------------ SHAPE STRING -------------------------------------------
 V_TEMP := LTRIM(RTRIM(V_NAME));
 V_TEMP := REPLACE(V_TEMP, DELIMITER, NEW_DELIMITER);
 V_TEMP := STR.STRFORMAT(V_TEMP);
 V_TEMP := REPLACE(V_TEMP, NEW_DELIMITER, SINGLE_QUOTE || COMMA || SINGLE_QUOTE);
 V_TEMP := SINGLE_QUOTE || V_TEMP || SINGLE_QUOTE;

------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 RG_ID := FIND_GROUP(RG_NAME);
 IF NOT ID_NULL(RG_ID) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 END IF;

 V_TEMP := UPPER(V_TEMP);

-- STR.DISPALERT('EEE '||V_TEMP,'ERROR'); --

 V_QRY := '(
SELECT COMP_ENG_NM,
 COMP_ARB_NM,
CTRY_CD,
EXP_COMP_ISN,
SUS_TYPE,
COMMENTS

FROM
(
 SELECT
BC.COMP_ENG_NM COMP_ENG_NM,
BC.COMP_ARB_NM COMP_ARB_NM,
BC.CTRY_CD CTRY_CD,
BC.EXP_COMP_ISN,
BC.SUS_TYPE SUS_TYPE,
BC.COMMENTS COMMENTS
 FROM SUSEXPCOMP_WORDS BW, SUS_EXP_COMPS BC
 WHERE
WORD_STD IN('||V_TEMP||')
AND
 TO_CHAR(BW.EXP_COMP_ISN) = TO_CHAR(BC.EXP_COMP_ISN)
 AND BC.SUS_TYPE<>4
 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
 GROUP BY
BC.COMP_ENG_NM,
 BC.COMP_ARB_NM,
 BC.CTRY_CD,
BC.EXP_COMP_ISN,
BC.SUS_TYPE,
 BC.COMMENTS

 UNION

SELECT
BC.COMP_ARBC_NAME COMP_ARBC_NAME,
BC.COMP_ENG_NAME COMP_ENG_NAME,
BC.CTRY_CTRY_CD CTRY_CTRY_CD,
BC.COMP_NBR,
BC.BOYCOTT_TYPE BOYCOTT_TYPE,
BC.COMMENTS COMMENTS
 FROM BCOTWORDS BW, BOYCOTT_COMPANIES BC
 WHERE
WORDS_STD IN('||V_TEMP||')
AND
 BW.CTRY_CD = BC.CTRY_CTRY_CD
 AND TO_CHAR(BW.COMP_NBR) = TO_CHAR(BC.COMP_NBR)
 AND BC.BOYCOTT_TYPE<>4
 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
 GROUP BY BC.COMP_ARBC_NAME , BC.COMP_NBR,
 BC.COMP_ENG_NAME,
 BC.CTRY_CTRY_CD,
 BC.COMP_NBR,
BC.BOYCOTT_TYPE,
 BC.COMMENTS

 ) ) ' ;

V_MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL ;
:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25 ;
 RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY(RG_NAME, V_QRY);
 IF ID_NULL(RG_ID) THEN
 -- STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن البحث داخل الشركات ', 'ERROR'); --
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;



 RG_POP := POPULATE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 IF RG_POP <> 0 THEN
 -- IF RECORDGROUP IS EMPTY
 IF RG_POP = 1403 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 -- STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن البحث داخل الشركات - خطأ رقم ' || RG_POP, 'ERROR');
 NULL;
 END IF;

 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 V_CNT := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(RG_ID);
 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 V_COMP_LIST := 'عدد الشركات المشابهة : ' || V_CNT || CHR(10);


:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL :=V_MSG_LVL;

/*
 FOR I IN 1 .. V_CNT
 LOOP
 V_COMP_LIST := V_COMP_LIST || GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(GC_ID, I) || CHR(10);
 END LOOP;
*/
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN TRUE;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_SUS_BCOTT_COMP_ERRR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_SUS_BCOTT_COMP_ERRR (V_NAME IN VARCHAR2, V_COMP_LIST OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS

------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 V_TEMP VARCHAR2(2000);

 c1 ctype;

------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------

STR.DISPALERT(V_TEMP,'ERROR');
 V_MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL ;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25 ;

SELECT cnt

 bc.comp_arb_nm,
 bc.ctry_cd,
 bc.exp_comp_isn,
 bc.sus_type,
 bc.comments
 UNION
 SELECT COUNT (*) cnt
 FROM bcotwords bw, boycott_companies bc
 WHERE words_std IN (v_temp)
 AND bw.ctry_cd = bc.ctry_ctry_cd
 AND TO_CHAR (bw.comp_nbr) = TO_CHAR (bc.comp_nbr)
 AND bc.boycott_type <> 4
 HAVING COUNT (*) >= 1
 GROUP BY bc.comp_arbc_name,
 bc.comp_nbr,
 bc.comp_eng_name,
 bc.ctry_ctry_cd,
 bc.comp_nbr,
 bc.boycott_type,
 bc.comments) ;
fetch c1 into V_CNT ;
CLOSE c1 ;
STR.DISPALERT(V_CNT,'ERROR');

STR.DISPALERT(V_CNT,'ERROR') ;
 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN

 RETURN TRUE;

 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE ;
 END IF;

:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL :=V_MSG_LVL;


EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_SUS_BCOTT_COMP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION is_sus_bcott_comp (v_name IN VARCHAR2, v_comp_list OUT VARCHAR2)
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS
 v_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF v_name IS NULL
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM (SELECT 1
 FROM sus_exp_comps bc
 WHERE ( str_db.namesmatch (comp_arb_nm, v_name) = 0
 OR str_db.namesmatch (comp_eng_nm, UPPER (v_name)) = 0
 )
 AND bc.sus_type <> 4
 UNION
 SELECT 2
 FROM boycott_companies bc
 WHERE ( str_db.namesmatch (comp_arbc_name, v_name) = 0
 OR str_db.namesmatch (comp_eng_name, UPPER (v_name)) = 0
 )
 AND bc.boycott_type <> 4) ;

 IF v_cnt > 0
 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 RETURN FALSE;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_QTY_OK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_QTY_OK(V_UNIT NUMBER, V_QTY NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_MIN_GRS_TON NUMBER;
 V_MIN_NET_TON NUMBER;
 V_MAX_GRS_TON NUMBER;
 V_MAX_NET_TON NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF V_QTY IS NULL THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 IF (V_UNIT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT AND V_QTY <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY) OR
 (V_UNIT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT AND V_QTY <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY) OR
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/* (V_UNIT = UNIT.MU_GRS_KG AND V_QTY <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT) OR
 (V_UNIT = UNIT.MU_NET_KG AND V_QTY <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT) THEN*/
 (V_UNIT = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('UNIT.MU_GRS_KG') AND V_QTY <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT) OR
 (V_UNIT = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('UNIT.MU_NET_KG') AND V_QTY <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT) THEN
--&&& END
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 V_MIN_GRS_TON := FLOOR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT) / 1000;
 V_MAX_GRS_TON := FLOOR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT + 1) / 1000;
 V_MIN_NET_TON := FLOOR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT) / 1000;
 V_MAX_NET_TON := FLOOR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT + 1) / 1000;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF (V_UNIT = UNIT.MU_TONS AND
 IF (V_UNIT = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('UNIT.MU_TONS') AND
--&&& END
 V_QTY NOT BETWEEN V_MIN_GRS_TON AND V_MAX_GRS_TON AND
 V_QTY NOT BETWEEN V_MIN_NET_TON AND V_MAX_NET_TON ) OR
 (V_UNIT = 46 AND
 V_QTY NOT BETWEEN V_MIN_GRS_TON AND V_MAX_GRS_TON ) THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_PRICING_TARIFF_CD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_PRICING_TARIFF_CD RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 hrmnzd_cd VARCHAR2 (20) := NULL;
 v_dtl_seq NUMBER;
 v_critria NUMBER;
 v_hq_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_brkr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_lic_nbr NUMBER;
 v_lic_type NUMBER;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 BEGIN
IF :GLOBAL.chk_pricing_tariff = 1 THEN
 SELECT impr_nbr, brkr_port_cd, lic_type, lic_nbr
 INTO v_impr_nbr, v_brkr_port_cd, v_lic_type, v_lic_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn;

 SELECT hq_impr_nbr
 INTO v_hq_impr_nbr
 FROM importers
 WHERE importers.impr_nbr = v_impr_nbr
 AND importers.port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd;


 SELECT hrmnzd_code
 INTO hrmnzd_cd
 FROM item_value_checks
 WHERE ( (hrmnzd_code = NVL(:FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:BRKR_TARIFF_CD))
 OR ( SUBSTR (hrmnzd_code, 1, 4) =
 SUBSTR (NVL(:FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:BRKR_TARIFF_CD), 1, 4)
 AND hrmnzd_type = 2
 )
 OR ( SUBSTR (hrmnzd_code, 1, 2) =
 SUBSTR (NVL(:FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:BRKR_TARIFF_CD), 1, 2)
 AND hrmnzd_type = 1
 )
 )
 AND hrmnzd_code_status = 1;

 IF hrmnzd_cd IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_critria
 FROM item_value_check_dtls i1
 WHERE i1.hrmnzd_code = hrmnzd_cd AND i1.dtl_status = 1;
 IF v_critria > 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT i1.dtl_seq
 INTO v_dtl_seq
 FROM item_value_check_dtls i1
 WHERE i1.hrmnzd_code = hrmnzd_cd
 AND i1.dtl_status = 1
 AND ( :dcltn_hdr.port_cd IN (
 SELECT i2.port_cd
 FROM sd_port_val_checks i2
 WHERE i2.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i2.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 OR 0 =
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM sd_port_val_checks i2
 WHERE i2.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i2.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 )
 AND ( v_hq_impr_nbr IN (
 SELECT i3.hq_impr_nbr
 FROM impr_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 OR 0 =
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM impr_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 )
 AND ( :ctry_cd IN (
 SELECT i3.ctry_cd
 FROM orgn_cntry_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 OR 0 =
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM orgn_cntry_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 )
 AND ( (v_brkr_port_cd, v_lic_type, v_lic_nbr) IN (
 SELECT i3.brkr_port_cd, i3.lic_type,
 i3.lic_nbr
 FROM brkr_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 OR 0 =
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM brkr_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 )
 AND ( :srce_name IN (
 SELECT i3.srce_name
 FROM srce_cmpys_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 OR 0 =
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM srce_cmpys_val_checks i3
 WHERE i3.hrmnzd_code = i1.hrmnzd_code
 AND i3.dtl_seq = i1.dtl_seq)
 )
 AND ROWNUM = 1;
 :prc_dtl_seq := v_dtl_seq;
 RETURN hrmnzd_cd;
 END;
 ELSE
 RETURN hrmnzd_cd;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN hrmnzd_cd;
 ELSE
 RETURN PRICING_DB.IS_PRICING_TARIFF_CD(NVL(:FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:BRKR_TARIFF_CD));
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_IMPR_HAS_RULE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- /*إختبار ان المستورد او المصدر له قواعد استثناء فى هذه الجمرك ومناسبة مع نوع البيان وله استثناء على بند التعرفة وله كمية باقية فى الإستثناء*/ --
 --MAIH 23-03-2013 --
FUNCTION is_impr_has_rule(p_port_cd NUMBER,p_impr_nbr NUMBER, p_rule_type NUMBER , p_hrmnzd_code NUMBER ) RETURN BOOLEAN IS

v_cnt NUMBER ;
BEGIN

SELECT COUNT (*)
INTO v_cnt
 FROM importers im, impr_rules ir, impr_rule_tariff_HQ irt
 WHERE im.hq_impr_nbr = ir.hq_impr_nbr
 AND ( (ir.ALL_BRNCH_FLAG = 1)
 OR (0 <
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM impr_rule_ports irp
 WHERE irp.rule_isn = ir.rule_isn
 AND irp.rec_status = 1
 AND irp.port_cd = p_port_cd)
 )
 )
 AND ( (ir.rule_type IN (9, 10) AND p_rule_type = 1) /*import*/
 OR (ir.rule_type IN (9, 11) AND p_rule_type = 2) /*export*/
 )
 AND ir.rule_isn = irt.rule_isn
 AND irt.hrmnzd_code = p_hrmnzd_code
 AND irt.remained_qty > 0
 AND ir.rec_status = 1

 AND im.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND im.impr_nbr = p_impr_nbr;



 IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_DCLTN_EXISTS_IN_PRICING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_DCLTN_EXISTS_IN_PRICING(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_ITEM_ISN NUMBER:=NULL
 ,V_INV_ISN NUMBER :=NULL
 ,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER :=NULL )
 RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER:=0;
 V_PRICING_SOFT_DEL NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_PRICING_SOFT_DEL := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('PRICING_SOFT_DEL',21),0);

 IF V_ITEM_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 --MODIFIED BY KAMEL TO UNDISPLAY DATA OF PRICING WHERE DECLARATION DATE EQUAL OR LESS THAN '1426'
 /*SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VALUE_DCLTN_PRMTRS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = V_ITEM_ISN ;
 */
 IF V_PRICING_SOFT_DEL > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM value_dcltn_prmtrs, value_declarations
 WHERE ( (value_declarations.port_cd = value_dcltn_prmtrs.port_cd)
 AND (value_declarations.dcltn_isn = value_dcltn_prmtrs.dcltn_isn)
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.ITEM_ISN = V_ITEM_ISN )
 --AND (TO_CHAR(value_declarations.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY')>='1427')
 AND value_declarations.SOFT_DEL_DT IS NULL
 );
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM value_dcltn_prmtrs, value_declarations
 WHERE ( (value_declarations.port_cd = value_dcltn_prmtrs.port_cd)
 AND (value_declarations.dcltn_isn = value_dcltn_prmtrs.dcltn_isn)
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.ITEM_ISN = V_ITEM_ISN )
 AND (TO_CHAR(value_declarations.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY')>='1427')
 );
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_INV_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 --MODIFIED BY KAMEL TO UNDISPLAY DATA OF PRICING WHERE DECLARATION DATE EQUAL OR LESS THAN '1426'
 /* SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VALUE_DCLTN_PRMTRS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN IN
 ( SELECT ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN);*/
 IF V_PRICING_SOFT_DEL > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM value_dcltn_prmtrs, value_declarations
 WHERE ( (value_declarations.port_cd = value_dcltn_prmtrs.port_cd)
 AND (value_declarations.dcltn_isn = value_dcltn_prmtrs.dcltn_isn)
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.ITEM_ISN IN( SELECT ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN))
 -- AND (TO_CHAR(value_declarations.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY')>='1427')
 AND value_declarations.SOFT_DEL_DT IS NULL
 );
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM value_dcltn_prmtrs, value_declarations
 WHERE ( (value_declarations.port_cd = value_dcltn_prmtrs.port_cd)
 AND (value_declarations.dcltn_isn = value_dcltn_prmtrs.dcltn_isn)
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.ITEM_ISN IN( SELECT ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN))
 AND (TO_CHAR(value_declarations.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY')>='1427')
 );
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 --MODIFIED BY KAMEL TO UNDISPLAY DATA OF PRICING WHERE DECLARATION DATE EQUAL OR LESS THAN '1426'
 /*SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VALUE_DCLTN_PRMTRS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN ;*/
 SELECT COUNT(ITEM_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM value_dcltn_prmtrs, value_declarations
 WHERE ( (value_declarations.port_cd = value_dcltn_prmtrs.port_cd)
 AND (value_declarations.dcltn_isn = value_dcltn_prmtrs.dcltn_isn)
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (value_dcltn_prmtrs.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
-- AND (TO_CHAR(value_declarations.DCLTN_DT,'YYYY')>='1427')
 AND value_declarations.SOFT_DEL_DT IS NULL
 );

 END IF;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_BOYCOTT_COMPANY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_BOYCOTT_COMPANY(V_NAME IN VARCHAR2, V_COMP_LIST OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
------------------------------------ SHAPE STRING -------------------------------------------
 SINGLE_QUOTE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := '''';
 DOUBLE_QUOTE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := '''''';
 DELIMITER CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := ' ';
 NEW_DELIMITER CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := CHR(1000); -- THIS CHARACTER NOT REMOVED BY STR.STRFORMAT()
 COMMA CONSTANT VARCHAR2(5) := ', ';
------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 RG_NAME CONSTANT VARCHAR2(20) := 'CHK_BOYCOTT_RG';
 RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
 RG_POP NUMBER;
 V_TEMP VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_QRY VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 GC_ID GROUPCOLUMN;
BEGIN
------------------------------------ SHAPE STRING -------------------------------------------
 V_TEMP := LTRIM(RTRIM(V_NAME));
 V_TEMP := REPLACE(V_TEMP, DELIMITER, NEW_DELIMITER);
 V_TEMP := STR.STRFORMAT(V_TEMP);
 V_TEMP := REPLACE(V_TEMP, NEW_DELIMITER, SINGLE_QUOTE || COMMA || SINGLE_QUOTE);
 V_TEMP := SINGLE_QUOTE || V_TEMP || SINGLE_QUOTE;

------------------------------- CHECK BOYCOTT COMPANY ---------------------------------------
 RG_ID := FIND_GROUP(RG_NAME);
 IF NOT ID_NULL(RG_ID) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 END IF;

 V_TEMP := UPPER(V_TEMP);

-- STR.DISPALERT('EEE '||V_TEMP,'ERROR'); --

 V_QRY := 'SELECT BC.COMP_ENG_NAME || '' - '' || C.CRTY_ARBC_NAME COMP_NAME ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'FROM BCOTWORDS BW, BOYCOTT_COMPANIES BC, COUNTRIES C ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'WHERE WORDS_STD IN (' || V_TEMP || ') ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'AND BW.CTRY_CD = BC.CTRY_CTRY_CD ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'AND BW.COMP_NBR = BC.COMP_NBR ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'AND C.CTRY_CD = BC.CTRY_CTRY_CD ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ';
 V_QRY := V_QRY || 'GROUP BY BC.COMP_ENG_NAME, BC.CTRY_CTRY_CD, BC.COMP_NBR, C.CRTY_ARBC_NAME ';

 RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY(RG_NAME, V_QRY);
 IF ID_NULL(RG_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن البحث داخل الشركات المقاطعة', 'ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 RG_POP := POPULATE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 IF RG_POP <> 0 THEN
 -- IF RECORDGROUP IS EMPTY
 IF RG_POP = 1403 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن البحث داخل الشركات المقاطعة - خطأ رقم ' || RG_POP, 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 V_CNT := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(RG_ID);
 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 V_COMP_LIST := 'عدد الشركات المقاطعة المشابهة : ' || V_CNT || CHR(10);

 GC_ID := FIND_COLUMN('CHK_BOYCOTT_RG.COMP_NAME');
 IF ID_NULL(GC_ID) THEN
 V_COMP_LIST := V_COMP_LIST || 'لا يمكن عرض أسماء الشركات المقاطعة المشابهة';
 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 FOR I IN 1 .. V_CNT
 LOOP
 V_COMP_LIST := V_COMP_LIST || GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(GC_ID, I) || CHR(10);
 END LOOP;

 DELETE_GROUP(RG_ID);
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LIST_INDEX
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_LIST_INDEX(list_id VARCHAR2,list_element_to_add VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 total_list_count NUMBER(2);
 loop_index_var NUMBER(2) := 1;
 list_element VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 total_list_count := Get_List_Element_Count(list_id);
 LOOP
 list_element := Get_List_Element_Value(list_id, loop_index_var);

 IF list_element_to_add = list_element THEN
 RETURN loop_index_var;
 END IF;
 EXIT WHEN list_element = list_element_to_add OR loop_index_var = total_list_count;
 loop_index_var := loop_index_var + 1;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN 0;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DUTY_WITHOUT_CSTMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_DUTY_WITHOUT_CSTMS(CIF_VAL OUT NUMBER, DUTY_VAL OUT NUMBER) IS
 INV_REC DUTY.T_DCLTN_INVOICES_DUTY;
 LIN DUTY.T_DCLTN_ITEMS_DUTY;
 CALC_DT DATE;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_MSG_TXT_cif VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_TEMP NUMBER;
 V_TRF_CALC_DT DATE;
 cif_val_true NUMBER;
BEGIN
 CIF_VAL := NULL;
 DUTY_VAL := NULL;

 -- FILL THE RECORD FROM THE BLOCK
 INV_REC.INV_TYPE := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG := :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG;
 INV_REC.INS_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.INS_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD ;
 -- CR-8539 start
 INV_REC.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES ;
 INV_REC.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD ;
 -- CR-8539 end
 INV_REC.OTHER_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.OTHER_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD ;
 INV_REC.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.DISC_PCTG := :DCLTN_INVOICES.DISC_PCTG ;
 INV_REC.TOTAL_EXPS := :DCLTN_INVOICES.TOTAL_EXPS ;
 INV_REC.INV_CURCY_CD := :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD ;

 -- FILL THE RECORD FROM THE BLOCK
 LIN.PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD ;
 LIN.ITEM_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;
 LIN.INV_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN ;
 LIN.BRKR_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD ;
 LIN.BRKR_TARIFF_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_DT ;
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD ;
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_DT ;
 LIN.DUTY_TYPE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE ;
 LIN.PNLTY_RQR := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNLTY_RQR ;
 LIN.TRF_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY ;
 LIN.INV_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST ;
 LIN.CIF_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST ;
 LIN.CSTMS_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST ;
 LIN.GROSS_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT ;
 LIN.ORGNL_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY ;
 LIN.EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY ;

 CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_TRF_CALC_DT := NVL(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT, CALC_DT);

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT FINAL_CTRY_CD
 INTO V_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN

 V_TEMP := DUTY.GET_ITEM_DUTY (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT, CIF_VAL, DUTY_VAL, V_MSG_TXT);

 IF V_TEMP = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 CIF_VAL_true := DUTY.get_line_cif_without_cstms (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT,CIF_VAL,v_msg_txt_cif);

 ELSE
 CIF_VAL_true := DUTY.get_line_cif_without_cstms (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT,CIF_VAL,v_msg_txt_cif);

 V_TEMP := S_DUTY.GET_GULF_TRF_DUTY (V_FINAL_CTRY_CD, LIN.TRF_UNIT_QTY, LIN.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY, CIF_VAL,
 LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_CD, LIN.FINAL_TARIFF_DT, V_TRF_CALC_DT, DUTY_VAL, V_MSG_TXT, :DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD);
 IF V_TEMP = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF CIF_VAL_true = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT_cif, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 -- STOP ROUNGDING FROM S_DUTY FOR STATISTICAL IMPORT 14-06-2004
 DUTY_VAL := DCLTN.SET_HALALA(DUTY_VAL);
 END IF;
 DUTY_VAL := NVL(DUTY_VAL, 0);
 END IF; -- DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE

/** IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 CIF_VAL_true := DUTY.get_line_cif_without_cstms (:GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD, INV_REC, LIN, CALC_DT,CIF_VAL,v_msg_txt_cif);
 DUTY_VAL := 0;
 IF CIF_VAL_true = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT_cif, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF; */ -- DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DUTY_TYPE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_DUTY_TYPE(TRF_CD VARCHAR2, TRF_DT DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR C_TRF(T_CD VARCHAR2, T_DT DATE) IS SELECT *
 FROM TARIFF_DETAILS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = T_CD
 AND EFF_DATE = T_DT;
 TRF_REC TARIFF_DETAILS%ROWTYPE;
 V_PMT_METHOD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 OPEN C_TRF(TRF_CD, TRF_DT);
 FETCH C_TRF INTO TRF_REC;
 CLOSE C_TRF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF TRF_REC.DUTY_RATE_CODE = TARIFF.DRC_EXMPTD THEN
 IF TRF_REC.DUTY_RATE_CODE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.DRC_EXMPTD') THEN
-- RETURN (DCLTN.DT_EXM_BY_TRF);
 RETURN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EXM_BY_TRF'));
--&&& END
 ELSE
 SELECT PMT_METHOD
 INTO V_PMT_METHOD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF V_PMT_METHOD = DCLTN.DPM_DOC_INS THEN
 IF V_PMT_METHOD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DPM_DOC_INS') THEN
-- RETURN (DCLTN.DT_DOC_INS);
 RETURN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DOC_INS'));
 ELSE
-- RETURN (DCLTN.DT_DEF);
 RETURN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DEF'));
--&&& END
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DUTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_DUTY (CAN_COMMIT BOOLEAN) IS
 CIF_VAL NUMBER;
 DUTY_VAL NUMBER;
 NEED_COMMIT BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
-- IF DCLTN.CAN_CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) = 1 THEN
 IF DCLTN.CAN_CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) = 1 OR (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD=6 ) THEN
 LOCAL_GET_DUTY(CIF_VAL, DUTY_VAL);

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST <> CIF_VAL OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST IS NULL AND CIF_VAL IS NOT NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST IS NOT NULL AND CIF_VAL IS NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST := CIF_VAL;
 NEED_COMMIT := TRUE;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST <> CIF_VAL OR :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST IS NULL

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY <> DUTY_VAL OR :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY IS NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY := DUTY_VAL;
 NEED_COMMIT := TRUE;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY <> DUTY_VALTORN:DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY IS NULL

 IF NEED_COMMIT = TRUE AND CAN_COMMIT = TRUE THEN
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- DCLTN.CAN_CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) = TRUE
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FOR_EMPTY_CNTNR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FOR_EMPTY_CNTNR IS

 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :BRKR_TARIFF_CD IN ( '86090000' ,'860900000000' ) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('لا توجد بيانات شحن لتحديد هل للصنف حاويات فارغه أم لا - لتسجيل حاويات فارغه يجب الربط بالشحن أولا','WARNING');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('هل تريد التعامل مع الإرسالية كحاويات فارغة','WARNING');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN


 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS') THEN
 IF CHECK_EMPTY_CNTNR(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD) = TRUE THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CNTNR_TYPE_DESC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 CALL_EMPTY_CNTNRS_LOV;


 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT := 7;
 ADJ_UNITS;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC := 'حاويات فارغه';
 BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 /**/
 BEGIN
 CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_4(
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.MSR_ARBC_NAME
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT );
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس علي الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 /**/
 NULL ; ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن إتمام العملية – نوع إرسالية إذن تسليم المعاملة يجب أن تكون حاويات فارغة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CNTNR_TYPE_DESC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع الإرسالية كحاويات فارغة , يجب أن يكون نوع البيان بيان إستيراد','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CNTNR_TYPE_DESC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUNS(CD VARCHAR2) IS
 V_TASK_ID NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_PAYER VARCHAR2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 RET NUMBER;
 Dum NUMBER;

 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER := 0;
 V_CHK_FEES_RECALC NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_IMP_ITEM_ISN NUMBER;

 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 V_CL_VAL NUMBER;
 V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(200);
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_DOUBLE_DUTY NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_DEC_RET_LINK NUMBER;
 V_PRICING_SOFT_DEL NUMBER;
 V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;

 V_GRP76_CNT NUMBER;
 V_RECP_FLAG NUMBER;
 V_SPCFS_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_SPCFC_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_MODEL_YEAR NUMBER;
 V_DECLARED_VALUE NUMBER;
 V_REF_PRICE NUMBER;
 V_REF_YEAR NUMBER;
 V_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_ERF_PRICE_RTRN_VLU NUMBER;
 V_CHK_CAR_SPCFS BOOLEAN :=TRUE ;
BEGIN

IF CD IN ('CD_00810', 'CD_00820') THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TASK_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ITEM_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DISPLAY_ONLY', TEXT_PARAMETER, 0);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
----------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- --> 07/01/2014 AHMED A-MONIM Using Payment Methods
--M.ALI--
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_04450') THEN ---SAID ELMANSI CR-4805----02-08-2022
EXEC_FUN_CD_04450;

ELSIF CD IN ('CD_03700') THEN
RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تأكيد البضاعة سليمة بعد المعاينة؟ ', 'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ISD_CHK:=9;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3,57,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN) THEN
 str.dispalert('حدث خطأ فى كتابة النشاط يرجى الاتصال بمركز المعلومات','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_03710') THEN
RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تأكيد البضاعة غير سليمة بعد المعاينة؟ ', 'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ISD_CHK:=10;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3,58,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN) THEN
 str.dispalert('حدث خطأ فى كتابة النشاط يرجى الاتصال بمركز المعلومات','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 COMMIT;
 END IF;
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_03090') THEN CALL_DCLTN_ITEMS_JN;
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_03380') THEN CALL_LOV_RS_PRICE;
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_04310') THEN EXEC_FUN_CD_04310; --BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 17/02/2021 DM-763
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_04440') THEN EXEC_FUN_CD_04440; --BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 08/12/2021 DM-185
ELSIF CD IN ('CD_03030') THEN
SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR INTO V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE IMPORTERS.IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 AND IMPORTERS.PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_HQ_IMPR_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_HQ_IMPR_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ORGN_CERT_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,:INV_NBR);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
ELSIF CD = 'CD_03050' THEN
RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تأكيد مطابقة البضاعة المصدرة بالمدخلة مؤقتاً؟ ', 'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 --SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --:DCLTN_ITEMS.IDEN_GOODS_APPRV:=2;
 --COMMIT;
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS --YHelmy And Mohamed Aymnan CRQ22973 Fix
 SET IDEN_GOODS_APPRV = 2
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_ITEMS.dcltn_isn
 AND item_isn = :DCLTN_ITEMS.item_isn ;
 forms_ddl('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT( 'تم الحفظ بنجاح','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
ELSIF CD = 'CD_03060' THEN
RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم ألغاء تأكيد مطابقة البضاعة المصدرة بالمدخلة مؤقتاً؟ ', 'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.IDEN_GOODS_APPRV:=3;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;

 pl_id := create_parameter_list('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_CD',text_parameter,TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD));

 CALL_FORM ('LOV_DCLTN_USED_VHCL.fmx ',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_03760
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--MMAOUA 17/06/2018
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_03760 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 V$BUTTON NUMBER;
 V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_DUMP_CMP_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_HGRP_APPROV_FLAG NUMBER;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE NUMBER;
 MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
 V_INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG NUMBER; --Yasser Hassan

BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, DDC.DUMP_CMPNY_ARAB_NAME
 INTO V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, V_DUMP_CMP_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV DDCI, DCLTN_DUMP_CMPNYS DDC
 WHERE DDCI.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND DDCI.INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDC.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ;

 V$BUTTON:= STR.DISPALERT('الشركة المغرقة : ' || V_DUMP_CMP_NAME || ' هل تريد التأكيد؟','CONFIRM');
 IF V$BUTTON = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 V_HGRP_APPROV_FLAG := 1;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE := 8;
 V_INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG := 1;
 ELSE
 V_HGRP_APPROV_FLAG := 2;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE := 9;
 V_INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG := 1;

 END IF;
 UPDATE DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV SET HGRP_APPROV_DATE = SYSDATE, HGRP_APPROV_FLAG = V_HGRP_APPROV_FLAG,INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG = V_INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 2, V_ACTIVITY_TYPE, :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN||'!'||:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_3900
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_3900 IS
 V_EXIST NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST
 FROM DCLTN_VAT_EXMTN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND VAT_EXMTN_FLAG = 1
 ;
 IF V_EXIST > 0 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_VAT_EXMTN
 SET VAT_EXMTN_FLAG = 0
 , VAT_EXMTN_RSN = NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 ;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3, 62, :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD||'!'||:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT(' سيتم احتساب ضريبة القيمة المضافة على الصنف ','INFORMATION');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_3890
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_3890 IS
 V_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_RSN NUMBER;
 PL_ID PARAMLIST;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST
 FROM DCLTN_VAT_EXMTN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 ;
 IF :final_tariff_cd = '980100000001' THEN
 V_RSN := 1 ;
 ELSE
 CALL_FORM('LOV_VAT_EXMTN_RSN.FMX',
 NO_HIDE,
 NO_REPLACE
 ,NO_QUERY_ONLY
 ,PL_ID)
 ;
 IF :GLOBAL.EXMTN_RSN IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يجب اختيار سبب اعفاء الصنف من ضريبة القيمة المضافة ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXMTN_RSN = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' البند ليس للأمتعه الشخصية ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 V_RSN := :GLOBAL.EXMTN_RSN;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_EXIST = 0 THEN
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_VAT_EXMTN (PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, VAT_EXMTN_FLAG,VAT_EXMTN_RSN)
 VALUES (:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD, :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN, 1 , V_RSN)
 ;
 ELSE
 UPDATE DCLTN_VAT_EXMTN
 SET VAT_EXMTN_FLAG = 1
 , VAT_EXMTN_RSN = V_RSN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 ;
 END IF;
 DELETE FROM dcltn_stats_itm_vat
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND dcltn_stats_flg = 1
 ;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3, 61, :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD||'!'||:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT(' تم اعفاء الصنف من ضريبة القيمة المضافة ','INFORMATION');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EFC_DTA_SPECIAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EFC_DTA_SPECIAL IS
v_count NUMBER;
v_CERTIFICATE_FLAG NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GRP_CODE IN (222,224,228)
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 ;

 IF v_count > 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT CERTIFICATE_FLAG INTO v_CERTIFICATE_FLAG FROM EFC_DTA_SPECIAL_PRODCT
 WHERE EFC_DTA_SPECIAL_PRODCT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND EFC_DTA_SPECIAL_PRODCT.DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND EFC_DTA_SPECIAL_PRODCT.DCLTN_STATS_ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND EFC_DTA_SPECIAL_PRODCT.HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND EFC_DTA_SPECIAL_PRODCT.DCLTN_STATS_FLG = 1
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END ;

 IF v_CERTIFICATE_FLAG IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF v_CERTIFICATE_FLAG = 1 THEN
 str.dispalert('تم التحقق من الكفاءه','information');
 elsIF v_CERTIFICATE_FLAG = 2 then
 str.dispalert('تم التحقق من شهادة الأعتراف','information');
 end if;
 END IF;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_REC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DUP_REC(V_CALLING_TY IN VARCHAR2) IS
-- V_CALLING_TY = 'C' ===> COLLECTING FIELDS FROM RECORD .
-- V_CALLING_TY = 'F' ===> FILL FIELDS IN SCREEN WITH CLLECTED VALUES .
BEGIN
 IF (V_CALLING_TY = 'C') THEN

select
DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC ,
DCLTN_ITEMS.PROD_DT ,
DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD,
DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD,
DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT,
DCLTN_ITEMS.UNIT_INV_COST,
DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT,
DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT,
DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT,
DCLTN_ITEMS.UNITS_PER_PKG,
DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.BARREL_QTY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.BARREL_PRICE,
DCLTN_ITEMS.OIL_DENSITY,
DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST ,
DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST ,
DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST
 into

 :GLOBAL.ITEM_DESC ,
 :GLOBAL.PROD_DT ,
 :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD ,
 :GLOBAL.BRKR_TARIFF_CD ,
 :GLOBAL.INV_QTY ,
 :GLOBAL.INV_MSR_UNIT ,
 :GLOBAL.UNIT_INV_COST ,
 :GLOBAL.INTL_QTY ,
 :GLOBAL.INTL_MSR_UNIT ,
 :GLOBAL.GROSS_WT ,
 :GLOBAL.NET_WT ,
 :GLOBAL.UNITS_PER_PKG ,
 :GLOBAL.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY ,
 :GLOBAL.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY,
 :GLOBAL.TRF_UNIT_QTY ,
 :GLOBAL.BARREL_QTY ,
 :GLOBAL.BARREL_PRICE ,
 :GLOBAL.OIL_DENSITY ,
 :GLOBAL.INV_COST ,
 :GLOBAL.CSTMS_COST ,
 :GLOBAL.CIF_COST
from dcltn_items where port_cd=:DCLTN_HDR.port_cd and
 DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN= :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN;




/*
 :GLOBAL.ITEM_DESC := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC;
 :GLOBAL.PROD_DT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PROD_DT;
 :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD;
 :GLOBAL.BRKR_TARIFF_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD;
 :GLOBAL.INV_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;
 :GLOBAL.INV_MSR_UNIT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT;
 :GLOBAL.UNIT_INV_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.UNIT_INV_COST;
 :GLOBAL.INTL_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
 :GLOBAL.INTL_MSR_UNIT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT;
 :GLOBAL.GROSS_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT;
 :GLOBAL.NET_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT;
 :GLOBAL.UNITS_PER_PKG := :DCLTN_ITEMS.UNITS_PER_PKG;
 :GLOBAL.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY;
 :GLOBAL.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY;
 :GLOBAL.TRF_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY;
 :GLOBAL.BARREL_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BARREL_QTY;
 :GLOBAL.BARREL_PRICE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.BARREL_PRICE;
 :GLOBAL.OIL_DENSITY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.OIL_DENSITY;
 :GLOBAL.INV_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST ;
 :GLOBAL.CSTMS_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CSTMS_COST ;
 :GLOBAL.CIF_COST := :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST ;
*/
 ELSE
 IF (V_CALLING_TY = 'F') THEN
 IF (DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1) AND CHECK_THERE_IS_PRICING(:GLOBAL.BRKR_TARIFF_CD)=1 /* ( PRICING_DB.IS_PRICING_TARIFF_CD(:GLOBAL.BRKR_TARIFF_CD) IS NOT NULL)*/ THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.UNIT_INV_COST := 1;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.PROD_DT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.PROD_DT := :GLOBAL.PROD_DT;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD := :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD;
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EX'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PRX')) THEN
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.BRKR_TARIFF_CD IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD := :GLOBAL.BRKR_TARIFF_CD;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.ITEM_DESC IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_DESC := :GLOBAL.ITEM_DESC;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.INV_QTY IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY := :GLOBAL.INV_QTY;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.INV_MSR_UNIT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT := :GLOBAL.INV_MSR_UNIT;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.UNIT_INV_COST IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.UNIT_INV_COST := :GLOBAL.UNIT_INV_COST;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.INTL_QTY IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY := :GLOBAL.INTL_QTY;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 /* IF (:GLOBAL.INTL_MSR_UNIT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT := :GLOBAL.INTL_MSR_UNIT;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;*/

 IF (:GLOBAL.GROSS_WT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT := :GLOBAL.GROSS_WT;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.NET_WT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT := :GLOBAL.NET_WT;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.INV_COST IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_COST := :GLOBAL.INV_COST ;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.UNITS_PER_PKG IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.UNITS_PER_PKG := :GLOBAL.UNITS_PER_PKG;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY := :GLOBAL.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY := :GLOBAL.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.TRF_UNIT_QTY IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.TRF_UNIT_QTY := :GLOBAL.TRF_UNIT_QTY;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.BARREL_QTY IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.BARREL_QTY := :GLOBAL.BARREL_QTY;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 IF (:GLOBAL.BARREL_PRICE IS NOT NULL) THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_WAIVERS_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_WAIVERS_DATA IS
 V_ITEM_DT DATE;
 V_HAS_WAIVERS VARCHAR2(9000);
 CURSOR S IS SELECT DISTINCT W.WVR_SEQ_NBR WVR_SEQ_NBR,ITEM_ISSUE_DT
 FROM WAIVERS W, WVR_ITEMS WI
 WHERE W.WVR_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND W.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR

 AND WI.WVR_PORT_CD = W.WVR_PORT_CD
 AND WI.WVR_SEQ_NBR = W.WVR_SEQ_NBR
 AND WI.ISSUED_DT = W.ISSUED_DT
 AND WI.ITEM_TYPE_CD IN (15, 16)
 AND NVL(WI.ITEM_STATUS,0) <> 9
 AND ITEM_END_DT < HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE
 AND CLRNC_DT IS NULL
 AND WVR_STATUS <> 0;
 BEGIN
FOR REC IN S LOOP
V_HAS_WAIVERS := V_HAS_WAIVERS ||' هناك تعهد بإحضار مستندات برقم'||REC.WVR_SEQ_NBR||' وتاريخ'||TO_CHAR(REC.ITEM_ISSUE_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||'منتهى ولم يسدد بعد';
END LOOP;
IF V_HAS_WAIVERS IS NOT NULL THEN
STR.DISPALERT(V_HAS_WAIVERS,'ERROR');
--RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_ITEMS_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISPLAY_ITEMS_LOV(V_CALLING_TYPE IN VARCHAR2) IS

-- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONRM [EXT.:4853] @ 02/08/2005
-- I WROTE THE FOLLOWING CODE TO GIVE AVIL. TO THE USER SELECT CERTAIN ITEM OF
-- ITEMS OF DECLARATION TO DISPLAY IT OR DUPLICATE IT
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN_ITEMS';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_CUR_ITEM_ISN NUMBER;
 V_CALL_TYPE VARCHAR2(1);

 BEGIN
 V_CALL_TYPE := V_CALLING_TYPE;
 IF (:system.mode <> 'ENTER-QUERY') THEN

 V_CUR_ITEM_ISN := NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN,0);

 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);

 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS <> 'CHANGED')THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);

 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD' , TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'INV_ISN' , TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN);

 IF (V_CALL_TYPE = 'V') THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة أختيار صنف بالفاتورة لعرضه');
 ELSE
 IF (V_CALL_TYPE = 'D') THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة أختيار صنف بالفاتورة لتكراره ');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_ITEMS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF (:GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN IS NULL) AND (V_CUR_ITEM_ISN > 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN := V_CUR_ITEM_ISN ;
 V_CALL_TYPE := 'R';
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 IF (V_CALL_TYPE = 'D') THEN
 ---
 DUP_REC('C');
 CREATE_RECORD;
 DUP_REC('F');
 ---
 END IF;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_EXMPTN_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_EXMPTN_DATA IS
 DumSTR DCLTN_INS_RSNS.INS_RSN_DESC%TYPE;
 V_INS_RSN_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := NULL;
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('LINK_EXP_2_IMP', 21), 0);
 IF (V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP >= 2 AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.TEMP_ITEM=1) THEN
 BEGIN
 V_INS_RSN_TYPE:=2;
 SELECT INS_RSN_DESC
 INTO DumSTR
 FROM DCLTN_INS_RSNS
 WHERE INS_RSN_CD = :INS_RSN_CD
 AND INS_RSN_TYPE = V_INS_RSN_TYPE;
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := DumSTR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := NULL;
 END;
 ELSIF :DUTY_TYPE IN (3, 4, 5, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23, 24, 25) AND :EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := 'إعفاء مؤكد';
 ELSIF :DUTY_TYPE IN (3, 4, 5, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23, 24, 25) THEN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := 'إعفاء غير مؤكد';
 -- STRAT BY RAMY GOMAA 23-09-2004
 ELSIF (V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP >= 1 AND :DUTY_TYPE IN (12, 17, 22)) THEN -- تأمين إدخال مؤقت --
 BEGIN
 V_INS_RSN_TYPE:=1;
 SELECT INS_RSN_DESC
 INTO DumSTR
 FROM DCLTN_INS_RSNS
 WHERE INS_RSN_CD = :INS_RSN_CD
 AND INS_RSN_TYPE = V_INS_RSN_TYPE
 ;
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := DumSTR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := NULL;
 END;
 IF :DUTY_TYPE IN (17, 22) AND :EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := :U_EXM_INS_STA || ' - ' || 'إعفاء مؤكد';
 ELSIF :DUTY_TYPE IN (17, 22) THEN
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := :U_EXM_INS_STA || ' - ' || 'إعفاء غير مؤكد';
 END IF;
 -- END BY RAMY GOMAA 23-09-2004
 ELSE
 :U_EXM_INS_STA := NULL;
 END IF;
 IF :U_EXM_INS_STA IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_EXM_INS_STA', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_EXM_INS_STA', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DEL_IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- pre DELETE
PROCEDURE DEL_IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS IS
 V_RULE_ISN NUMBER ;
 V_HRMNZD_CODE NUMBER ;
 V_USED_QTY NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT RULE_ISN,HRMNZD_CODE ,USED_QTY
 INTO V_RULE_ISN , V_HRMNZD_CODE ,V_USED_QTY
 FROM IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
 WHERE DCLTN_PORT_CD = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND ITEM_ISN = :dcltn_items.ITEM_ISN ;

 IF V_RULE_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE IMPR_RULE_TARIFF_HQ
 SET REMAINED_QTY = REMAINED_QTY + V_USED_QTY
 WHERE RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = V_HRMNZD_CODE ;

 DELETE FROM IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
 WHERE RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN
 AND DCLTN_PORT_CD = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND ITEM_ISN = :dcltn_items.ITEM_ISN
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = V_HRMNZD_CODE ;
 END IF;

END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: DELETE_ACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DELETE_ACTION IS

V_SDS_SEQ NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
SELECT SDS_SEQ INTO V_SDS_SEQ
 FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;



IF V_SDS_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
DELETE FROM SMPL_ITEMS
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = ( SELECT RQST_PORT_CD FROM SMPL_REQUESTS WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND RQST_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD )
 AND RQST_NMR = ( SELECT RQST_NMR FROM SMPL_REQUESTS WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND RQST_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD )
 AND RQST_DT = ( SELECT RQST_DT FROM SMPL_REQUESTS WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND RQST_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ) ;

 DELETE FROM SMPL_REQUESTS WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND RQST_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ;


 DELETE FROM SMPL_ITEM_EXEMPTION_ADD WHERE SDS_SEQ = V_SDS_SEQ;
 DELETE FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS_ITEMS WHERE SDS_SEQ = V_SDS_SEQ;
 DELETE FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS WHERE SDS_SEQ = V_SDS_SEQ;

END IF ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;

 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CNFRM_CERT_IE2_IE3
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2016/09/08 11:34 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE cnfrm_cert_ie2_ie3
IS
 ret NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER := 0;
 v_cert_status NUMBER := 0;
 v_chk_cert_ie2_ie3 NUMBER;
BEGIN
 v_chk_cert_ie2_ie3 :=
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHK_CERT_IE2_IE3', 21), 0);

 IF NVL (v_chk_cert_ie2_ie3, 0) = 1
 THEN
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
-- IF :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd IN ('850152000001', '850153000001')
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM group_items
 WHERE grp_code = 203 AND hrmnzd_code = :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd AND :dcltn_items.DUTY_TYPE NOT IN (8,26);

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 IF :dcltn_items.iden_cert_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND :dcltn_items.iden_cert_dt IS NOT NULL
 AND :dcltn_items.ica_idnt_isn IS NOT NULL
 THEN
--==============================================================================
 v_count := 0;

 IF :dcltn_items.exmtn_decree_isn IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT '1'
 FROM exmtn_decrees ed, decree_acptd_items dai
 WHERE dai.decree_port_cd = ed.decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = ed.decree_isn
 AND dai.decree_port_cd =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_decree_isn
 AND dai.aplctn_port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND dai.item_seq = :dcltn_items.exmtn_item_seq
 AND dai.item_sub_seq =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_item_sub_seq
 AND dai.item_sta_cd = 2
 AND ed.decree_type = 1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 v_count := 0;

 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT '1'
 FROM exmtn_decrees_hq ed,
 decree_acptd_items_hq dai
 WHERE dai.decree_port_cd = ed.decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = ed.decree_isn
 AND dai.decree_port_cd =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_decree_isn
 AND dai.aplctn_port_cd =
 :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND dai.item_seq =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_item_seq
 AND dai.item_sub_seq =
 :dcltn_items.exmtn_item_sub_seq
 AND dai.item_sta_cd = 2
 AND ed.decree_type = 1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 v_cert_status := 0;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 ret :=
 str.dispalert
 ('هل ترغب في تأكيد مواصفة التحقق من مستوى كفاءة الطاقة ؟',
 'CONFIRM'
 );

 IF ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 v_cert_status := 1;
 ELSIF ret = alert_button2
 THEN
 v_cert_status := 2;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret :=
 str.dispalert
 ('هل ترغب في تأكيد إستثناء مواصفة التحقق من مستوى كفاءة الطاقة(حيث أن البند معفي) ؟',
 'CONFIRM'
 );

 IF ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 v_cert_status := 3;
 ELSIF ret = alert_button2
 THEN
 v_cert_status := 4;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO dcltn_cert_ie2_ie3
 (port_cd, item_isn,
 dcltn_isn,
 final_tariff_cd, cert_status
 )
 VALUES (:dcltn_items.port_cd, :dcltn_items.item_isn,
 :dcltn_items.dcltn_isn,
 :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, v_cert_status
 );

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE dcltn_cert_ie2_ie3
 SET final_tariff_cd = :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd,
 cert_status = v_cert_status
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND item_isn = :dcltn_items.item_isn;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END;
--==============================================================================
 ELSE
 str.dispalert ('يجب ادخال حقل رقم وتاريخ وجهة اصدار الشهادة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;
 END IF;
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CK_ITM_TMP_ALL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CK_ITM_TMP_ALL IS
 V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN%TYPE;
 V_IMP_ITEM_ISN DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN%TYPE;
 V_INV_QTY DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY%TYPE;
 V_INV_MSR_UNIT DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT%TYPE;
 V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD%TYPE;
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD%TYPE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_SUM NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP NUMBER;
 V_MAX_EXPIARY_DT DATE;
 V_DUTY_TYPE NUMBER;
 H_DATE DATE:= HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 V_ITEM_TEMP_ISN NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('LINK_EXP_2_IMP', 21), 0);

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RX') AND V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP < 2 THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM ITM_TMP_ALL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY
 AND ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY;
 IF (V_COUNT>0) THEN
 SELECT INV_QTY,MSR_UNIT, HRMNZD_CODE,ITEM_TEMP_ISN,TEMP_EXPRY_DT
 INTO V_INV_QTY,V_INV_MSR_UNIT, V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,V_ITEM_TEMP_ISN,V_MAX_EXPIARY_DT
 FROM ITM_TMP_ALL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY
 AND ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY;
 IF V_INV_MSR_UNIT <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,45,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

-- IF V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD THEN

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF (
----------------------- البيان قديم الخطاب قديم -----------------------
 ( v_final_tariff_cd = :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 )
 OR
----------------------- البيان جديد الخطاب قديم -----------------------
 ( SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 1, 8) = SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 1, 8)
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 )
 OR
----------------------- البيان قديم الخطاب جديد -----------------------
 ( SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 1, 8) = SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 1, 8)
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 )
 OR
----------------------- البيان جديد الخطاب جديد -----------------------
 ( v_final_tariff_cd = :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 )
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 )
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THEN NULL;
ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,55,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) INTO V_SUM FROM ITM_TMP_LNK_ALL
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT AND ITEM_TEMP_ISN=V_ITEM_TEMP_ISN;

 IF (V_SUM + :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY> V_INV_QTY) THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('الكمية المتبقية من صنف البيان الوارد أقل من كمية صنف بيان إعادة الصادر' ,'ERROR'); --'--/**/
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,65,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF H_DATE > V_MAX_EXPIARY_DT THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('فترة السماح للصنف المؤقت انتهت - لا يمكن الربط مع هذا الصنف','ERROR');--
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,75,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.TEMP_ITEM >0 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ربط الصنف المعاد تصديره مؤقتا بصنف بيان وارد إدخال مؤقت','ERROR');--
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_RSN_CD := NULL;
 :U_EXM_INS_STA:=NULL;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_EXM_INS_STA', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,85,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;

 END IF;
 ELSE
 CHECK_ITEM_TEMP_ENTRY;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_VALID_DECREE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_VALID_DECREE(V_DECREE_ISN OUT NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS


V_DECREE_STATUS NUMBER(2);
V_DECREE_TYPE NUMBER(2);
V_DECREE_PORT_CD NUMBER(3);
V_DECREE_EXPIRY_DT DATE;
V_CHECK_DT DATE;
V_VALID_DECREE BOOLEAN:=TRUE;
V_GOV_DECREE_SRCE NUMBER;
V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD NUMBER;
V_DECREE_EFF_DT DATE;
CURSOR FIRST_ROW_DECREE IS SELECT DECREE_STA_CD,DECREE_EXPRY_DT,DECREE_ISN,DECREE_PORT_CD,
 DECREE_SRCE_CD,EXMTN_MTHD_CD, DECREE_EFF_DT
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES WHERE
 DECREE_PORT_CD =:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_TYPE = 2
 AND DECREE_SRCE_CD = 2
 AND DECREE_NBR = 7
 AND DECREE_STA_CD=2
 ORDER BY DECREE_EXPRY_DT DESC;
BEGIN

--IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE = 2
--THEN V_DECREE_TYPE := 1; -- INDUSTERIAL
--ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IN (3,4)
--THEN
 V_DECREE_TYPE := 2; -- GOVERNOMENTAL
--END IF;


OPEN FIRST_ROW_DECREE;
 FETCH FIRST_ROW_DECREE INTO V_DECREE_STATUS, V_DECREE_EXPIRY_DT,V_DECREE_ISN,V_DECREE_PORT_CD,
 V_GOV_DECREE_SRCE,V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD , V_DECREE_EFF_DT;
 IF FIRST_ROW_DECREE%NOTFOUND THEN
 V_VALID_DECREE:= FALSE;
 END IF;

CLOSE FIRST_ROW_DECREE;
-- WHEN SHOULD THE DECREE BE EFFICTIVE?
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL
THEN V_CHECK_DT := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT;
ELSE V_CHECK_DT := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
END IF;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
V_VALID_DECREE := TRUE; -- INITIAL VALUE

IF V_DECREE_STATUS <> 2 -- NOT EFFICTIVE
THEN
 --MESSAGE('القرار غير فعال و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 --MESSAGE('القرار غير فعال و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 V_VALID_DECREE := FALSE;

ELSIF HIJDATE.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_CHECK_DT, V_DECREE_EXPIRY_DT) = 1
THEN -- EXPIRED
 --MESSAGE('لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 --MESSAGE('لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 V_VALID_DECREE := FALSE;

ELSIF HIJDATE.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_CHECK_DT, V_DECREE_EFF_DT) = -1
THEN -- NOT STARTED
 --MESSAGE('لا يمكن التعامل مع القرار - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة');
 --MESSAGE('لا يمكن التعامل مع القرار - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة');
 V_VALID_DECREE := FALSE;
END IF;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RETURN V_VALID_DECREE;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN V_VALID_DECREE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_TARIF_INST_GROUP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--CHK_TARIF_INST_GROUP
--DESCRIPTION : TO CHECK IF TARIFF IS INSIDE CERTAIN GROUP OF TARIFF INSTURCTIONS OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--PROGRAMMER : MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM MOHAMED
--VERSION : 2.0
--DATE : 08-06-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION CHK_TARIF_INST_GROUP(V_HARMONIZED_TARIFF VARCHAR2,V_DCLTN_DT DATE,V_GROUP_ID NUMBER) RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_DATE DATE;
BEGIN
 -- 1 ===> TRUE [TARIFF EXIST IN GROUP]
 -- 0 ===> FALSE [TARIFF NOT EXIST IN GROUP]
 V_DATE := V_DCLTN_DT ;
 IF V_DATE IS NULL THEN
 V_DATE :=HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM harmonized_tariff HT,
 group_items gro,
 tariff_groups tar,
 group_instructions ginst,
 tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE ((HT.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (HT.HRMNZD_CODE = V_HARMONIZED_TARIFF)
 AND (tar_inst.DECREE_STATUS = 1)
 AND (V_DATE >= tar_inst.eff_date)
 AND (V_DATE <= tar_inst.expry_date)
 AND (tar_inst.INST_TYPE = V_GROUP_ID)
 );
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------- MAIH EXCEPT IMPT ----------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE CHK_TARIFF_EXCEPT (P_MSG VARCHAR2 ,P_RET NUMBER,V_TARIFF_CD NUMBER) IS
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 v_rule_type NUMBER ;
 V_INFO_MSG VARCHAR2(1000) ;
BEGIN

 IF P_RET IN (3,4,5) THEN





 IF DCLTN.is_import_dcltn (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND P_RET IN (3,5) THEN -- CAN'T IMPORT --
 SELECT IMPR_NBR,DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_NBR , V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;
 v_rule_type := 1;
 ELSIF DCLTN.is_export_dcltn (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND P_RET IN (3,4) THEN -- CAN'T EXPORT --

 SELECT AGENT_NBR,DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_NBR , V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;

 v_rule_type := 2;
 END IF;


 IF is_impr_has_rule(:DCLTN_HDR.port_cd ,V_IMPR_NBR , v_rule_type , V_TARIFF_CD ) THEN

 V_INFO_MSG := ' هذا البند تم استثنائه من المنع لهذا المستورد ' ;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF UPPER(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM) = 'DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD' THEN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_INFO_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_INFO_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF UPPER(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM) = 'DCLTN_ITEMS.INS_TARIFF_CD' THEN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (3) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_INFO_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (2) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_INFO_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF UPPER(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM) = 'DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD' THEN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (15) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_INFO_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (2) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_INFO_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------
 COPY('1','U_EXCPT_TARIFF');

 ELSE

 STR.DISPALERT(P_MSG , 'INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
--IF V_TARIFF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN ---AAA---
 STR.DISPALERT(P_MSG , 'INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
--END IF; ---AAA---
 END IF;


END;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROCEDURE CHK_SYRIA IS --MAIH --
 v_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_final_ctry_cd NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2) /* وارد*/
 THEN
 IF :ctry_cd = 110 /*syria*/
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*) cnt
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git,
 group_countries grc,
 countries co
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = grc.grp_code
 AND co.ctry_cd = grc.ctry_cd
 AND grc.ctry_cd = 110 -- سوريا
 --AND tg.GRP_CODE = 146 AND ti.INST_CODE = 93 -- ممنوع تصديرها الى سوريا وعليها استثناء حظر
 AND tg.grp_code = 147
 AND ti.inst_code = 94 -- ممنوع استيرادها من سوريا وعليها استثناء حظر
 AND git.hrmnzd_code = :FINAL_TARIFF_CD --20079913 تفاح
 AND ti.inst_type = 12 -- بنود مستثناه من الحظر --
 ;

 IF v_cnt > 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert (' هناك استثناء حظر لذلك الصنف , يمكنك الإستمرار',
 'information'
 );
 ELSE
 str.dispalert (' هناك حظر لا يمكن استيراد هذا الصنف من سوريا',
 'error'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 5, 6) /* صادر*/
 THEN
 SELECT final_ctry_cd
 INTO v_final_ctry_cd
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn;

 IF v_final_ctry_cd = 110 /*syria*/
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*) cnt
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git,
 group_countries grc,
 countries co
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = grc.grp_code
 AND co.ctry_cd = grc.ctry_cd
 AND grc.ctry_cd = 110 -- سوريا --
 AND tg.grp_code = 146
 AND ti.inst_code = 93 -- ممنوع تصديرها الى سوريا وعليها استثناء حظر
 --AND tg.GRP_CODE = 147 AND ti.INST_CODE = 94 -- ممنوع استيرادها من سوريا وعليها استثناء حظر --
 AND git.hrmnzd_code = :FINAL_TARIFF_CD --20079913 تفاح --
 AND ti.inst_type = 12 -- بنود مستثناه من الحظر --
 ;

 IF v_cnt > 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert (' هناك استثناء حظر لذلك الصنف , يمكنك الإستمرار',
 'information'
 );
 ELSE
 str.dispalert (' هناك حظر لا يمكن تصدير هذا الصنف الى سوريا',
 'error'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

FUNCTION CHK_SABER_ITEMS(p_port_cd NUMBER ,p_dcltn_item NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS --CR-7655 ABDELHADI /0-CAN'T UPDATED

V_CNT_SABER_ITEMS NUMBER;

V_RET number;

 -- AND DC.DCLTN_DT > V_CR815_IMPR_WVR_STG_DT

 IF V_LTR_REQ >0 THEN

PROCEDURE CHK_PRC_AFTER_INV_UPDT(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_INV_ISN NUMBER) IS

 CURSOR C_DCLTN_ITMS IS

 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN

 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET PRICING_APPRV = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3, 33, DI.PORT_CD ||'!'|| DI.ITEM_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 /*
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET PRICING_APPRV = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN
 AND PRICING_APPRV = 3;
 */

END;

-- --> 09/03/2014 AHMED A-MONIM PETRO_EXPORT_EXCEPT

PROCEDURE chk_petro (v_tarriff VARCHAR2)
IS
 v_count NUMBER := 0;
 v_count1 NUMBER := 0;
 v_exist_port NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = 158
 AND ti.inst_code = 97
 AND git.hrmnzd_code = v_tarriff
 AND ti.inst_type = 12);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count1
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git,
 group_chapters gch
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gch.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = 158
 AND ti.inst_code = 97
 AND gch.chpt_code = SUBSTR (v_tarriff, 1, 2)
 AND gch.chpt_status = 0
 AND ti.inst_type = 12);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count1 := 0;
 END;

 v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + NVL (v_count1, 0);

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 v_exist_port := chk_exist_petro;

 IF v_exist_port = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('هذا البند تم إستثناؤه من حظر تصدير المشتقات البترولية',
 'information'
 );
 ELSE
 str.dispalert (' هناك حظر تصدير لهذا البند من هذا المنفذ',
 'error'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE CHK_IRON_FOR_EXPORT IS
 V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_DUTY_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RX') THEN
 V_RET := TARIFF.CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INST_EXP_IRON(:DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn,:DCLTN_HDR.port_cd,1);
 IF V_RET <> 0 THEN
 IF ( (:PORT_CD_IMPD_AT IS NULL) OR (:DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY IS NULL ) OR (:DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY IS NULL) OR
 (:DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY IS NULL) OR (:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY IS NULL) ) THEN
 STR.DispAlert('هذا البند محظور..لا يمكن استخدامه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN INTO V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY;

 SELECT DUTY_TYPE INTO V_DUTY_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN
 AND ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY;

 IF V_DUTY_TYPE <> 12 /* إدخال مؤقت */ THEN
 STR.DispAlert('هذا البند محظور..لا يمكن استخدامه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispAlert('هذا البند محظور..لا يمكن استخدامه','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 30/09/2018 02:14:46 م (QP5 v5.294) */
PROCEDURE CHK_IMPR_TRFF_WHITE_LIST
IS
 V_EXSIT NUMBER;
 V_LIST VARCHAR2 (10);
 ret NUMBER;
 V_ITM_CNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_OLD_FINAL_TARIFF_CD VARCHAR2(16):=GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FINAL_TARIFF_CD',DATABASE_VALUE);


 FUNCTION GET_WHIT_LIST_FLG
 RETURN VARCHAR2
 IS
 V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2 (20);
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH VARCHAR2 (20);
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_SERVICE_RESULT VARCHAR2 (1000);
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD VARCHAR2 (10);
 V_WHITE_LIST VARCHAR2 (10);
 V_SERVICE_NAME VARCHAR2(100):=NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('VAT_TIN_SERVICE', 21), 'GAZTSERVICETIN');
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT BUS_ID,
 BUS_ID_BRNCH,
 IMPR_TYPE_CD,
 CTRY_CD,
 BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_BUS_ID,
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH,
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD,
 V_CTRY_CD,
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF V_IMPR_TYPE_CD != 4
 THEN
 IF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'BUP002';
 ELSIF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 3
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'ZS0002';
 ELSIF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 5
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'ZS0001';
 ELSIF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 16
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'ZS0003';
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT ID_TYPE_GZT, BUS_ID_NEW
 INTO V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, V_BUS_ID
 FROM IMPR_GAZT_ID
 WHERE BUS_ID = V_BUS_ID
 AND NVL (BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0) = NVL (V_BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0)
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = V_CTRY_CD
 AND LST_TRAN_DT =
 (SELECT MAX (LST_TRAN_DT)
 FROM IMPR_GAZT_ID
 WHERE BUS_ID = V_BUS_ID
 AND NVL (BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0) =
 NVL (V_BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0)
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = V_CTRY_CD);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 V_SERVICE_RESULT :=
 LIB_USR.zakat_SERVICE.GETZAKATTINPARAM (
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??? ????????
 V_BUS_ID
 || ':'
 || -- ????? ???????
 NVL (V_BUS_ID_BRNCH, 'NULL')
 || ':'
 || -- ????? ??????
 NULL
 || ':'
 || V_CTRY_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??????
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??? ????????
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??? ????? ???????
 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 || ':3',
 V_SERVICE_NAME);

 SELECT SUBSTR (RESULT,INSTR (RESULT,':',1,6)+ 1,( INSTR (RESULT,':',1,7)- 1)- INSTR (RESULT,':',1,6))WHIT_LIST
 INTO V_WHITE_LIST
 FROM (SELECT V_SERVICE_RESULT || ':' RESULT
 FROM DUAL);

 RETURN NVL (V_WHITE_LIST, 'NOLIST');
 END GET_WHIT_LIST_FLG;


BEGIN
 IF V_OLD_FINAL_TARIFF_CD != :FINAL_TARIFF_CD THEN

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_EXSIT
 FROM dcltn_vat_exmtn
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_FLG = 1
 AND item_isn = :DCLTN_ITEMS.item_isn
 AND VAT_EXMTN_RSN = 7;

 IF V_EXSIT > 0
 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (5, 9)
 THEN
 DELETE FROM dcltn_vat_exmtn
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_FLG = 1
 AND item_isn = :DCLTN_ITEMS.item_isn;
 ELSE
 V_LIST := GET_WHIT_LIST_FLG;


 IF IMPR.Check_IMP_WHITE_LIST (:FINAL_TARIFF_CD, V_LIST) = 0
 THEN
 V_MSG :=
 'هذا الصنف تم اعفائه من الضريبة المضافة لان المستورد ضمن القائمة البيضاء للبند السابق بينما البند الجديد ليس معفي,, لايمكن التعديل';
 ret :=
 intrface.flash_alert (
 V_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'اسباب توقف الاجراءات ',
 7.5,
 0.5,
 1,
 0.5,
 1150,
 'r0g0b75',
 12);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_EXIST_SABEK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_exist_sabek (
 p_port_cd NUMBER,
 p_dcltn_isn NUMBER,
 p_item_isn NUMBER
)
 RETURN NUMBER
IS
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_hq_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
BEGIN
--==============================================================================
 BEGIN
 SELECT impr_nbr
 INTO v_impr_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = p_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn;

 SELECT hq_impr_nbr
 INTO v_hq_impr_nbr
 FROM importers
 WHERE importers.impr_nbr = v_impr_nbr AND importers.port_cd = p_port_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF v_hq_impr_nbr = 445796
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT '1'
 FROM exmtn_decrees ed,
 decree_acptd_items dai,
 dcltn_items di
 WHERE dai.decree_port_cd = ed.decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = ed.decree_isn
 AND dai.decree_port_cd = di.exmtn_decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = di.exmtn_decree_isn
 AND dai.aplctn_port_cd = di.port_cd
 AND dai.item_seq = di.exmtn_item_seq
 AND dai.item_sub_seq = di.exmtn_item_sub_seq
 AND di.port_cd = p_port_cd
 --AND di.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 AND di.item_isn = p_item_isn
 AND dai.item_sta_cd = 2
 AND ed.decree_type = 1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT '1'
 FROM exmtn_decrees_hq ed,
 decree_acptd_items_hq dai,
 dcltn_items di
 WHERE dai.decree_port_cd = ed.decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = ed.decree_isn
 AND dai.decree_port_cd = di.exmtn_decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = di.exmtn_decree_isn
 AND dai.aplctn_port_cd = di.port_cd
 AND dai.item_seq = di.exmtn_item_seq
 AND dai.item_sub_seq = di.exmtn_item_sub_seq
 AND di.port_cd = p_port_cd
 --AND di.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 AND di.item_isn = p_item_isn
 AND dai.item_sta_cd = 2
 AND ed.decree_type = 1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 RETURN (1);
 ELSE
 RETURN (0);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN (0);
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 RETURN (0);
END chk_exist_sabek;
