ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_EXCPT_QTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_excpt_qty(P_QTY NUMBER , p_rule_isn OUT NUMBER ) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER ;
 V_REMAINED_QTY NUMBER ;
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER ;
 v_rule_type NUMBER ;
 v_rule_isn NUMBER ;
 X NUMBER;
BEGIN

V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD ;


 IF DCLTN.is_import_dcltn (V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT IMPR_NBR,DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_NBR , V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;
 v_rule_type := 1;
 ELSIF DCLTN.is_export_dcltn (V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT AGENT_NBR,DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_NBR , V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;
 v_rule_type := 2;
 END IF;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS WHERE ITEM_ISN =:dcltn_items.ITEM_ISN;
IF X > 0 THEN
 SELECT irt.RULE_ISN , irt.REMAINED_QTY
 INTO v_rule_isn,V_REMAINED_QTY
 FROM importers im, impr_rules ir, impr_rule_tariff_HQ irt,IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS IRD
 WHERE (IRD.ITEM_ISN =:dcltn_items.ITEM_ISN AND IRD.RULE_ISN=IR.RULE_ISN)
 AND im.hq_impr_nbr = ir.hq_impr_nbr
 AND ( (ir.ALL_BRNCH_FLAG = 1)
 OR (0 <
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM impr_rule_ports irp
 WHERE irp.rule_isn = ir.rule_isn
 AND irp.rec_status = 1
 AND irp.port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd)
 )
 )
 AND ( (ir.rule_type IN (9, 10) AND v_rule_type = 1) /*import*/
 OR (ir.rule_type IN (9, 11) AND v_rule_type = 2) /*export*/
 )
 AND ir.rule_isn = irt.rule_isn
 AND irt.hrmnzd_code = :dcltn_items.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND irt.remained_qty >= P_QTY
 AND ir.rec_status = 1
 AND im.port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND im.impr_nbr = V_IMPR_NBR;
 ELSE
 SELECT irt.RULE_ISN , irt.REMAINED_QTY
 INTO v_rule_isn,V_REMAINED_QTY
 FROM importers im, impr_rules ir, impr_rule_tariff_HQ irt
 WHERE im.hq_impr_nbr = ir.hq_impr_nbr
 AND ( (ir.ALL_BRNCH_FLAG = 1)
 OR (0 <
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM impr_rule_ports irp
 WHERE irp.rule_isn = ir.rule_isn
 AND irp.rec_status = 1
 AND irp.port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd)
 )
 )
 AND ( (ir.rule_type IN (9, 10) AND v_rule_type = 1) /*import*/
 OR (ir.rule_type IN (9, 11) AND v_rule_type = 2) /*export*/
 )
 AND ir.rule_isn = irt.rule_isn
 AND irt.hrmnzd_code = :dcltn_items.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND irt.remained_qty >= P_QTY
 AND ir.rec_status = 1
 AND im.port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND im.impr_nbr = V_IMPR_NBR;
 END IF;
 IF V_REMAINED_QTY >= P_QTY THEN
 p_rule_isn := v_rule_isn ;

 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN FALSE;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_4
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_4 */
PROCEDURE CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_4(
 P_MSR_ARBC_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.MSR_ARBC_NAME. */
 ,P_INV_MSR_UNIT IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT MU.MSR_ARBC_NAME
 FROM MEASURE_UNITS MU
 WHERE MU.MSR_UNIT = P_INV_MSR_UNIT
 AND MU.MSR_STATUS = 1;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_MSR_ARBC_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_CHEMICAL_NO_4_TARIFF
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_CHEMICAL_NO_4_TARIFF(V_HRMNZD_CODE VARCHAR2) IS
 V_RET NUMBER;
 V_CHEMICAL_NO VARCHAR2(100):=NULL;
 AB VARCHAR(50) := NULL;
ABN VARCHAR(50) := NULL;
SUB VARCHAR(50);
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 IF V_HRMNZD_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN

 SELECT FILLER1
 INTO V_CHEMICAL_NO
 FROM HARMONIZED_TARIFF
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = V_HRMNZD_CODE;

 IF V_CHEMICAL_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CHEMICAL_NO:=V_CHEMICAL_NO||'-';

AB := NULL;
FOR NUM IN 1..LENGTH(V_CHEMICAL_NO) LOOP
 SUB := SUBSTR(V_CHEMICAL_NO, NUM, 1);

 IF ASCII(SUB) = 45 THEN

 ABN := AB||SUB||ABN;
 AB := NULL;

 ELSE
 AB :=AB||SUB;

 END IF;


END LOOP;
ABN:=SUBSTR(ABN,1,LENGTH(ABN)-1);

 V_MSG:= 'تنبيه هام : البند المدخل له رقم تسجيل كميائي ' ||ABN || CHR(10) || CHR(13)|| 'وهو ضمن المواد المدرجة في إتفاقية حظر الأسلحة الكميائية .';
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_CERT_FLDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_CERT_FLDS IS
BEGIN

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION (H_ITEM IN VARCHAR2,CNTRY IN NUMBER,INST_DATE IN DATE,INST_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_CNT NUMBER;

 CURSOR C_GITEMS IS
 SELECT G.GRP_CODE --,G.GRP_DOMAIN
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS I,TARIFF_GROUPS G
 WHERE I.GRP_CODE = G.GRP_CODE
 AND I.HRMNZD_CODE = H_ITEM
 AND (G.GRP_DOMAIN = 1
 OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1
 FROM GROUP_COUNTRIES
 WHERE CTRY_CD = CNTRY
 AND GRP_CODE = G.GRP_CODE
 )

 );
BEGIN
 FOR REC IN C_GITEMS LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM TARIFF_INSTRUCTIONS I, GROUP_INSTRUCTIONS G
 WHERE G.INST_CODE = I.INST_CODE
 AND G.GRP_CODE = REC.GRP_CODE
 AND I.INST_TYPE = INST_TYPE_CD
 AND I.DECREE_STATUS = 1
 AND ((NVL(I.INST_DUTY_CD, 4) = 4) OR ((I.INST_DUTY_CD = 6) AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2))) OR ((I.INST_DUTY_CD = 7) AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6))) )
 AND TO_CHAR(I.EFF_DATE ,'RRRR/MM/MI') <= TO_CHAR(INST_DATE,'RRRR/MM/MI')
 AND TO_CHAR(I.EXPRY_DATE,'RRRR/MM/MI') > TO_CHAR(INST_DATE,'RRRR/MM/MI');

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 RETURN 0;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END CHECK_TRF_ITEM_INSTRUCTION;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_NAMES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_NAMES(ORG_NAME VARCHAR)IS
 -- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM 29-09-2005
 strOutput VARCHAR2(2000);
 strTMPLT VARCHAR2(2000);
 CurrChar VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_COUNTER NUMBER;
 V_TST_NAME BOOLEAN;

BEGIN

 strTMPLT := ORG_NAME;
 V_TST_NAME := FALSE;

 WHILE LENGTH(strTMPLT)> 0 LOOP
 CurrChar := SUBSTR(strTMPLT,1,1);
 IF CurrChar = '0' OR CurrChar = '1' OR CurrChar = '2' OR CurrChar = '3' OR CurrChar = '4' OR CurrChar = '5' OR
 CurrChar = '6' OR CurrChar = '7' OR CurrChar = '8' OR CurrChar = '9' OR CurrChar = ' ' THEN
 CurrChar := '';
 --else
 END IF;
 IF CurrChar = ' ' THEN
 strTMPLT := LTRIM(SUBSTR(strTMPLT,2));
 ELSE
 strTMPLT := SUBSTR(strTMPLT,2);
 END IF;
 strOutput := strOutput || CurrChar;
 END LOOP;

 strOutput := RTRIM(LTRIM(strOutput));

 IF (LENGTH(strOutput) < 4) THEN
 V_TST_NAME := FALSE;
 ELSE
 V_COUNTER := 1 ;
 CurrChar := SUBSTR(strOutput,1,1);
 WHILE V_COUNTER <= LENGTH(strOutput) LOOP
 IF UPPER(CurrChar) <> UPPER(SUBSTR(strOutput,V_COUNTER,1)) THEN
 V_TST_NAME := TRUE;
 BREAK;
 END IF;
 V_COUNTER := V_COUNTER +1;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 IF V_TST_NAME = FALSE THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(1, 290, 'ERROR');
 :Global.NAME_FLAG := 'F';
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_MILITARY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_military(V_TYPE_OPERATION CHAR) IS
 FUNCTION IN_MIL_TAR (V_HARM VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 FOUND NUMBER;
 BEGIN


 SELECT 1 INTO FOUND FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ITEMS G
 WHERE G.HRMNZD_CODE=V_HARM
 AND GRP_CODE IN (30,73,74,76)) ;
 RETURN 1;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END;


BEGIN
IF UPPER(V_TYPE_OPERATION)='I' THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN

 IF :FINAL_TARIFF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF IN_MIL_TAR(:FINAL_TARIFF_CD)= 1 THEN
 IF :ROUTE_DESC IS NULL OR :BUY_CTRY_CD IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ادخال بلد شراء الشحنة ومسار الشحنة ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :ROUTE_DESC:=NULL;
 :BUY_CTRY_CD:=NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF LENGTH(RTRIM(LTRIM(:ROUTE_DESC)))<10 AND :ROUTE_DESC IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ادخال مسار الشحنة بعدد احرف لايقل عن 10','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSIF UPPER(V_TYPE_OPERATION)='U' THEN
 IF :FINAL_TARIFF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF IN_MIL_TAR(:FINAL_TARIFF_CD)!= 1 THEN
 :ROUTE_DESC:=NULL;
 :BUY_CTRY_CD:=NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ITEM_TEMP_ENTRY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_ITEM_TEMP_ENTRY(OPERATION_MODE NUMBER:=0) IS
 /*
 OPERATION_MODE
 0 FOR ADD
 1 FOR UPDATE
 */
 V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN%TYPE;
 V_IMP_ITEM_ISN DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN%TYPE;
 V_INV_QTY DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY%TYPE;
 V_INV_MSR_UNIT DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT%TYPE;
 V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD%TYPE;
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD%TYPE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_SUM NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP NUMBER;
 V_MAX_EXPIARY_DT DATE;
 V_DUTY_TYPE NUMBER;
 H_DATE DATE:= HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
BEGIN
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('LINK_EXP_2_IMP', 21), 0);

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RX') AND V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP < 2 THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 -- THIS CODE COMMENTED UPON HESAM REQ. BY SHERIFT 04-04-2005
 --IF :PORT_CD_IMPD_AT IS NULL OR :DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY IS NULL OR :DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY IS NULL OR :DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY IS NULL OR :DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY IS NULL THEN
 ----STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال معلومات بيان الاستيراد', 'ERROR'); --'--
 --STR.DISPARBMSG(21,25,'ERROR');
 --TERMINATE_FUN;
 --END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_ISN) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY;

 IF (V_COUNT>0) THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN ,DCLTN_STA_CD INTO V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN,V_DCLTN_STA_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY;

 IF V_DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_RLSD'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_CLSD')) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('البيان الوارد غير مفسوح','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في ربط بيانات الوارد والصادر - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR'); --'--/**/
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,35,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;

 --TO GET ITEM INFORMATION --
 BEGIN
 SELECT INV_QTY,INV_MSR_UNIT, FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 INTO V_INV_QTY,V_INV_MSR_UNIT, V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN
 AND ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في ربط بيانات الوارد والصادر - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR'); --'--/**/
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,35,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;
 --TO CHECK TARIFF, MSR_UNIT AND QTY --
 IF V_INV_MSR_UNIT <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('وحدة صنف البيان الوارد مختلفة عن صنف بيان إعادة الصادر' ,'ERROR'); --'--/**/
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,45,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;


/*
 IF V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('بند تعرفة صنف البيان الوارد مختلفة عن صنف بيان إعادة الصادر' ,'ERROR');
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,55,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
*/

 IF
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 (
----------------------- البيان قديم الخطاب قديم -----------------------
 ( v_final_tariff_cd = :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 )
 OR
----------------------- البيان جديد الخطاب قديم -----------------------
 ( SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 1, 8) = SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 1, 8)
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 )
 OR
----------------------- البيان قديم الخطاب جديد -----------------------
 ( SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 1, 8) = SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 1, 8)
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) = '0000'
 )
 OR
----------------------- البيان جديد الخطاب جديد -----------------------
 ( v_final_tariff_cd = :dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd
 AND SUBSTR (v_final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 AND SUBSTR (:dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, 9, 4) <> '0000'
 )
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 )
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 --STR.DISPALERT('بند تعرفة صنف البيان الوارد مختلفة عن صنف بيان إعادة الصادر' ,'ERROR');
 str.disparbmsg (21, 55, 'ERROR');
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;


 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(SUM(INV_QTY),0) INTO V_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD_IMPD_AT =:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY =:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_TYPE_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY =:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY =:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY
 AND DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY =:DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY
 AND (ITEM_ISN <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN OR :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN IS NULL);

 IF (V_SUM + :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY> V_INV_QTY) THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('الكمية المتبقية من صنف البيان الوارد أقل من كمية صنف بيان إعادة الصادر' ,'ERROR'); --'--/**/
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,65,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR'); --'--/**/
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,5,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;
 --BY SHERIFT 03-02-2005
 BEGIN
 SELECT ITEM_ISN,DUTY_TYPE INTO V_IMP_ITEM_ISN,V_DUTY_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_IMP_DCLTN_ISN
 AND ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY;

 SELECT MAX(DIL.EXPIARY_DT) INTO V_MAX_EXPIARY_DT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEM_LETRS DIL
 WHERE DIL.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT
 AND DIL.ITEM_ISN=V_IMP_ITEM_ISN;

 IF H_DATE > V_MAX_EXPIARY_DT THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('فترة السماح للصنف المؤقت انتهت - لا يمكن الربط مع هذا الصنف','ERROR');--
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,75,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;

 IF V_DUTY_TYPE = 12 AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.TEMP_ITEM >0 THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EMPTY_CNTNR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_EMPTY_CNTNR(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_PORT_CD NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS

 CURSOR CNTNR IS
 SELECT * FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_SUM NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 FOR I IN CNTNR LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM VSSL_BLS VB
 WHERE VB.SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 8
 AND VB.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND VB.MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND VB.MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND VB.MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND VB.BL_SEQ IN (SELECT BL_SEQ FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI
 WHERE SDI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SDI.DO_NBR = I.DO_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_ISS_DT = I.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SDI.MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND SDI.MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND SDI.MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = I.MFST_PORT_CD);

 V_SUM := V_SUM + V_COUNT;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_SUM = 0 THEN
 RETURN(FALSE);
 ELSIF V_SUM > 0 THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHCK_ITEM_GRP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHCK_ITEM_GRP (V_HRMNZD_CODE VARCHAR2,GRP_CD NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER

 IS
 V_FOUND NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF V_HRMNZD_CODE IS NULL THEN
 RETURN -1; --MISSING HRMNZD CODE
 END IF;

 IF (GRP_CD = 107 AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 1 OR :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 2) ) OR
 (GRP_CD = 121 AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 3 OR :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 4 OR :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 5 OR :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 6) ) OR
 (GRP_CD <> 107 AND GRP_CD <> 121)
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_FOUND
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GROUP_ITEMS.GRP_CODE = GRP_CD
 AND GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = V_HRMNZD_CODE;
 ELSE
 V_FOUND := 0 ;
 END IF;


 IF V_FOUND > 0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;

 RETURN 0;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHANGE_RET_REP_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- MODIFYIED BY KAMEL@4145 IN 20/04/2008 OT ACHIEVE NEW BUSINESSES REQUIRED FOR BOOKED ITEMS
PROCEDURE CHANGE_RET_REP_ITEM IS
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_RET_BILL_NBR NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_RET_HANDING_NBR NUMBER;
 V_RET_ITEM_NBR NUMBER;
 V_SUM_ITEM_QTY NUMBER;
 V_SUM_ITEM_WT NUMBER;
 V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS NUMBER;
 V_RET_REPS NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_CD,RET_BILL_NBR,RET_ITEM_NBR INTO V_PORT_CD,V_RET_BILL_NBR,V_RET_ITEM_NBR
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE (PORT_CD,RET_BILL_NBR) IN (SELECT PORT_CD,RET_BILL_NBR
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) = 2
 AND NVL(STATUS ,0) = 0)
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD ,0) = 2
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD ,0) = 2
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ;

 IF V_CNT = 1 THEN

 UPDATE RET_ITEMS
 SET STAGE_CD = 99 , STATUS = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR = V_RET_ITEM_NBR
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD ,0) = 2
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ;

 UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET STAGE_CD = 99 , STATUS = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR ;


 BEGIN
 SELECT RET_HANDING_NBR INTO V_RET_HANDING_NBR
 FROM RET_HANDING_BILLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET_REPS
 FROM RET_REPS RR
 WHERE RR.PORT_CD=V_PORT_CD
 AND RR.RET_HANDING_NBR=V_RET_HANDING_NBR
 AND RR.STAGE_CD = 2 AND RR.STATUS = 0;

 IF V_RET_REPS =0 THEN

 UPDATE RET_HANDINGS
 SET STATUS = 9
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RET_HANDING_NBR = V_RET_HANDING_NBR;

 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;

 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد خطأ في سجلات محاضر التسليم' ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END ;

 ELSIF V_CNT > 1 THEN
 UPDATE RET_ITEMS
 SET STAGE_CD = 99 , STATUS = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND RET_ITEM_NBR = V_RET_ITEM_NBR
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD ,0) = 2
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ;
 END IF;

SELECT SUM(ITEM_QTY) ,SUM(ITEM_WT)
 INTO V_SUM_ITEM_QTY ,V_SUM_ITEM_WT
 FROM RET_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND STATUS = 0 ;


IF V_SUM_ITEM_QTY IS NULL AND V_SUM_ITEM_WT IS NULL THEN
 V_SUM_ITEM_QTY:=0;
 V_SUM_ITEM_WT :=0;
END IF;


UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET BILL_QTY=V_SUM_ITEM_QTY,BILL_WT=V_SUM_ITEM_WT,BLNC_QTY=V_SUM_ITEM_QTY,BLNC_WT=V_SUM_ITEM_WT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR;




 --هل يوجد صنف خطير أم لا
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS FROM RET_ITEMS RI
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1
 FROM harmonized_tariff HT,group_items gro,tariff_groups tar,group_instructions ginst,tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE ((HT.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (HT.HRMNZD_CODE =RI.HRMNZD_CODE )
 AND (tar_inst.DECREE_STATUS = 1)
 AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT >= TO_CHAR(tar_inst.eff_date,'RRRR-MM-MI'))
 AND (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT <= TO_CHAR(tar_inst.expry_date,'RRRR-MM-MI'))
 AND (tar_inst.INST_TYPE= 7)))
 AND PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR=V_RET_BILL_NBR
 AND STATUS=0;


IF V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS=0 THEN

UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET BILL_CTGRY = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR;

ELSIF V_COUNT_DANGEROUSE_ITEMS>0 THEN

UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET BILL_CTGRY = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND RET_BILL_NBR = V_RET_BILL_NBR;

END IF;
--STOPPED BY KAMEL TO SOLVE PROBLEM OF UNCHANGE ITEM DECLARATION STATUS
 /*FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 IF FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم أسترجاع الصنف ...','INFORMATION');
 END IF;*/
 EXCEPTION

 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم استلام الصنف في مستودع المحجوزات لا يمكن استرجاعه' ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد خطأ في سجلات محاضر الحجز ' ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;

 DISP_EXMPTN_DATA;
 -- END BY SHERIFT 30-01-2005
 COMMIT;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;

END;

 -------------------- REQ_CLRNC_DTLS --------------------------------

-- ReqClrncDtlsItemIsn REQ_CLRNC_DTLS.ITEM_ISN%TYPE;

 -------------------- INS_CASHES --------------------------------

 InsCachesCashDt INS_CASHES.CASH_DT%TYPE;

 InsCachesInsReqDt INS_CASHES.INS_REQ_DT%TYPE;

 ,InsReqDt INS_CASHES.INS_REQ_DT%TYPE)
 IS
 SELECT CASH_ISN,CASH_NBR,CASH_DT,CLRNC_SEQ,CASH_RSN,PRINT_CNT
 FROM INS_CASHES
 WHERE PORT_CD=Port AND INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqNbr AND INS_REQ_DT=InsReqDt;

 -------------------- CASH_DTLS --------------------------------

 CashDtlsCashAmt CASH_DTLS.CASH_AMT%TYPE;
 CashDtlsCashTo CASH_DTLS.CASH_TO%TYPE;
 CashDtlsCheckNbr CASH_DTLS.CHECK_NBR%TYPE;
 CashDtlsCheckDt CASH_DTLS.CHECK_DT%TYPE;
 CashDtlsSrcePortAmt CASH_DTLS.SRCE_PORT_AMT%TYPE;

 CURSOR CUR_CachesDtls (Port CASH_DTLS.PORT_CD%TYPE,CashIsn CASH_DTLS.CASH_ISN%TYPE)
 IS
 SELECT CASH_ISN,CASH_DTL_SEQ,ACCT_SEQ,CASH_AMT,CASH_TO
 FROM CASH_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD=Port AND CASH_ISN=CashIsn;
 -------------------- BRNCH_DAILYS --------------------------------
 BrnchDailyPort BRNCH_DAILYS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyBankCd BRNCH_DAILYS.BANK_CD%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyBankBrnchCd BRNCH_DAILYS.BANK_BRNCH_CD%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyRevDt BRNCH_DAILYS.REV_DT%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyNeedPrint BRNCH_DAILYS.NEED_PRINT%TYPE;

 CURSOR CUR_BrnchDaily(Port BRNCH_DAILYS.PORT_CD%TYPE,Bank BRNCH_DAILYS.BANK_CD%TYPE,
 BankBrnch BRNCH_DAILYS.BANK_BRNCH_CD%TYPE,RevDt BRNCH_DAILYS.REV_DT%TYPE)
 IS
 SELECT BANK_CD,BANK_BRNCH_CD,REV_DT,NEED_PRINT
 FROM BRNCH_DAILYS
 WHERE PORT_CD=Port AND BANK_CD=BANK_CD AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BankBrnch AND REV_DT=RevDt;

 -------------------- BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS --------------------------------
 BrnchDailyDtlPort BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlBankCd BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.BANK_CD%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.BANK_BRNCH_CD%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlRevDt BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.REV_DT%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.ACCT_SEQ%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.Amt%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlSrceAmt BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.SRCE_PORT_AMT%TYPE;

 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur INS_REQ_DTLS.ACCT_SEQ%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur INS_REQ_DTLS.AMT%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_New INS_REQ_DTLS.ACCT_SEQ%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New INS_REQ_DTLS.AMT%TYPE;

 CURSOR CUR_BrnchDailyDtl(Port BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.PORT_CD%TYPE,Bank BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.BANK_CD%TYPE,
 BankBrnch BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.BANK_BRNCH_CD%TYPE,RevDt BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.REV_DT%TYPE)
 IS
 SELECT ACCT_SEQ,AMT
 FROM BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD=Port AND BANK_CD=BANK_CD AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BankBrnch AND REV_DT=RevDt;

BEGIN
 IF Port_CD_Par IS NULL OR Item_ISN_Par IS NULL THEN
 --message('I/P ERROR');message('I/P ERROR');--
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 IF NOT IS_STMT_PAYED THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 /**/
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -------- START CHECKING ---------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------

 IF Item_Duty NOT IN (2,10,11,12,13,14,15) THEN

 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 -------------------- DCLTN_ITEMS --------------------------------
 DcltnItemsPort :=Port_CD_Par;
 DcltnItemsItemIsn :=Item_ISN_Par;

 OPEN CUR_DcltnItem(DcltnItemsPort ,DcltnItemsItemIsn);
 FETCH CUR_DcltnItem
 INTO DcltnItemsDcltnIsn,DcltnItemsItemSeq,DcltnItemsDutyType,DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 IF CUR_DcltnItem%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_DcltnItem;
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_DcltnItem;


 DeclaratnPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 DeclaratnDcltnIsn :=DcltnItemsDcltnIsn;

 OPEN CUR_Declaration(DeclaratnPort,DeclaratnDcltnIsn);
 FETCH CUR_Declaration INTO DeclaratnDcltnNbr,DeclaratnDcltnDt,DeclaratnDcltnTypeCd,DeclaratnDcltnSta;
 IF CUR_Declaration%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_Declaration;
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_Declaration;


 CollOrdrPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 CollOrdrNbr :=DeclaratnDcltnNbr;
 CollOrdrDt :=DeclaratnDcltnDt;
 CollOrdrCtgry :=DeclaratnDcltnTypeCd ;

 OPEN CUR_CollOrder(CollOrdrPort,CollOrdrNbr,CollOrdrDt,CollOrdrCtgry);
 FETCH CUR_CollOrder INTO CollOrdrBankCd,CollOrdrBankBrnchCd,CollOrdrCollDt,CollOrdrSta;
 IF CUR_CollOrder%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_CollOrder;
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_CollOrder;

 -------------------- COLL_ORDER_DETAIL --------------------------------
 CollOrdrDtlsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 CollOrdrDtlsNbr :=CollOrdrNbr;
 CollOrdrDtlsDt :=CollOrdrDt;
 CollOrdrDtlsCtgry :=CollOrdrCtgry;


 InsReqsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 OPEN CUR_InsReqs(InsReqsPort,CollOrdrNbr,CollOrdrDt,CollOrdrCtgry);
 FETCH CUR_InsReqs INTO InsReqsNbr,InsReqsDt,InsReqsConfDt,InsReqsPmt,InsReqsCrLetrNbr,InsReqsCrLetrDt,InsReqsCrLetrType;
 IF CUR_InsReqs%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_InsReqs;
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_InsReqs;

 -------------------- INS_REQS_DETAIL --------------------------------
 InsReqsDtlsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsReqsDtlsNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsReqsDtlsDt :=InsReqsDt;

 -------------------- INS_CASHES --------------------------------
 InsCachesPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsCachesInsReqNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsCachesInsReqDt :=InsReqsDt;


 SELECT COUNT(C.CASH_ISN)
 INTO Dum
 FROM INS_CASHES C,CASH_DTLS CD
 WHERE C.PORT_CD=CD.PORT_CD AND C.CASH_ISN=CD.CASH_ISN AND
 C.PORT_CD=PORT_CD_Par AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsCachesInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsCachesInsReqDt AND
 C.CASH_NBR IS NOT NULL /* استمارة مرقمة *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur /* رقم الحساب الحالي*/; /**/

 IF DUM>0 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 IF InsReqsPmt=2 THEN -- تأمين بخطاب ضمان

 -------------------- INS_REQ_CLRNCS & REQ_CLRNC_DTLS --------------------------------
 InsReqClrncsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsReqClrncsInsReqDt :=InsReqsDt;

 ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq :=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur;

 Dum:=0;
 SELECT COUNT(C.INS_REQ_NBR)
 INTO Dum
 FROM INS_REQ_CLRNCS C, REQ_CLRNC_DTLS CD
 WHERE C.PORT_CD = CD.PORT_CD AND C.INS_REQ_NBR = CD.INS_REQ_NBR AND C.INS_REQ_DT = CD.INS_REQ_DT AND
 C.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt AND
 C.CLRNC_TYPE =1 /* مصادرة *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq /* رقم الحساب الحالي*//**/ AND
 C.CNFSCTN_NBR IS NOT NULL /* خطاب المصادرة مطبوع *//**/;
 IF DUM>0 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 -------------------- CREDIT_LETTERS --------------------------------
 CreditLetterPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 CreditLetterNbr :=InsReqsCrLetrNbr;
 CreditLetterDt :=InsReqsCrLetrDt;
 CreditLetterType :=InsReqsCrLetrType;

 OPEN CUR_CreditLetter(CreditLetterPort,CreditLetterNbr,CreditLetterDt,CreditLetterType);
 FETCH CUR_CreditLetter INTO CreditLetterOriglAmt,CreditLetterCurTotAmt,CreditLetterUsedAmt,
 CreditLetterSta,CreditLetterRlsNbr,CreditLetterRlsDt;
 IF CUR_CreditLetter%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_CreditLetter;
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_CreditLetter;

 IF CreditLetterRlsNbr IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- تأمين بخطاب ضمان --'--
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

 BrnchDailyDtlAmt BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.Amt%TYPE;

 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur INS_REQ_DTLS.ACCT_SEQ%TYPE;
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur INS_REQ_DTLS.AMT%TYPE;

 BankBrnch BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.BANK_BRNCH_CD%TYPE,RevDt BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS.REV_DT%TYPE)
 IS
 SELECT ACCT_SEQ,AMT
 FROM BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD=Port AND BANK_CD=BANK_CD AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BankBrnch AND REV_DT=RevDt;

 -------------------- INS_BALCS --------------------------------
 InsBalcsPort INS_BALCS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
 InsBalcsBalcDt INS_BALCS.BALC_DT%TYPE;
 InsBalcsAcctSeq INS_BALCS.ACCT_SEQ%TYPE;
 InsBalcsCashAmt INS_BALCS.CASH_AMT%TYPE;

BEGIN
 IF Port_CD_Par IS NULL OR Item_ISN_Par IS NULL OR DUTY_TYPE_NEW IS NULL THEN
 --message('I/P ERROR');message('I/P ERROR');--
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 IF DUTY_TYPE_NEW NOT IN (10,11,12,13,14,15) THEN
 str.DispAlert(' لا بد أن يكون البند المحاسبي الجديد من أحد بنود التأمين ','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -------- START CHECKING ---------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------

 -------------------- DCLTN_ITEMS --------------------------------
 DcltnItemsPort :=Port_CD_Par;
 DcltnItemsItemIsn :=Item_ISN_Par;

 OPEN CUR_DcltnItem(DcltnItemsPort ,DcltnItemsItemIsn);
 FETCH CUR_DcltnItem
 INTO DcltnItemsDcltnIsn,DcltnItemsItemSeq,DcltnItemsDutyType,DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 IF CUR_DcltnItem%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_DcltnItem;
 str.DispAlert('صنف البيان غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_DcltnItem;


 DeclaratnPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 DeclaratnDcltnIsn :=DcltnItemsDcltnIsn;

 OPEN CUR_Declaration(DeclaratnPort,DeclaratnDcltnIsn);
 FETCH CUR_Declaration INTO DeclaratnDcltnNbr,DeclaratnDcltnDt,DeclaratnDcltnTypeCd,DeclaratnDcltnSta;
 IF CUR_Declaration%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_Declaration;
 str.DispAlert('البيان غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_Declaration;


 CollOrdrPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 CollOrdrNbr :=DeclaratnDcltnNbr;
 CollOrdrDt :=DeclaratnDcltnDt;
 CollOrdrCtgry :=DeclaratnDcltnTypeCd ;

 OPEN CUR_CollOrder(CollOrdrPort,CollOrdrNbr,CollOrdrDt,CollOrdrCtgry);
 FETCH CUR_CollOrder INTO CollOrdrBankCd,CollOrdrBankBrnchCd,CollOrdrCollDt,CollOrdrSta;
 IF CUR_CollOrder%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_CollOrder;
 str.DispAlert('الفاتورة غير موجودة','ERROR'); --'----mohamed.nouh 15-11-2022 CR-5749
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_CollOrder;

 -------------------- COLL_ORDER_DETAIL --------------------------------
 CollOrdrDtlsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 CollOrdrDtlsNbr :=CollOrdrNbr;
 CollOrdrDtlsDt :=CollOrdrDt;
 CollOrdrDtlsCtgry :=CollOrdrCtgry;

 CollOrdrAcctSeq_Cur :=GetAcctSeq(DcltnItemsDutyType);
 CollOrdrAcctSeq_New :=GetAcctSeq(DUTY_TYPE_NEW);
 CollOrdrAmt_Cur :=0;
 CollOrdrAmt_New :=0;

 IF CollOrdrAcctSeq_Cur=-1 OR CollOrdrAcctSeq_New=-1 THEN
 str.DispAlert('نوع الرسوم على الصنف غير معروفة ','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 OPEN CUR_CollOrderDtl(CollOrdrDtlsPort,CollOrdrDtlsNbr,CollOrdrDtlsDt,CollOrdrDtlsCtgry);
 LOOP
 FETCH CUR_CollOrderDtl INTO CollOrdrDtlsAcctSeq,CollOrdrDtlsAmt;
 EXIT WHEN CUR_CollOrderDtl%NOTFOUND;

 IF CollOrdrDtlsAcctSeq = CollOrdrAcctSeq_Cur THEN
 CollOrdrAmt_Cur:=CollOrdrDtlsAmt;
 END IF;
 IF CollOrdrDtlsAcctSeq =CollOrdrAcctSeq_New THEN
 CollOrdrAmt_New:=CollOrdrDtlsAmt;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF CollOrdrAmt_Cur=0 THEN
 CLOSE CUR_CollOrderDtl;
 str.DispAlert('صنف الفاتورة غير موجود','ERROR'); ---mohamed.nouh 15-11-2022 CR-5749
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_CollOrderDtl;


 InsReqsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 OPEN CUR_InsReqs(InsReqsPort,CollOrdrNbr,CollOrdrDt,CollOrdrCtgry);
 FETCH CUR_InsReqs INTO InsReqsNbr,InsReqsDt,InsReqsConfDt,InsReqsPmt,InsReqsCrLetrNbr,InsReqsCrLetrDt,InsReqsCrLetrType;
 IF CUR_InsReqs%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_InsReqs;
 str.DispAlert('التأمين غير موجود','ERROR');--'--
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_InsReqs;

 -------------------- INS_REQS_DETAIL --------------------------------
 InsReqsDtlsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsReqsDtlsNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsReqsDtlsDt :=InsReqsDt;

 InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur :=GetAcctSeq(DcltnItemsDutyType);
 InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_New :=GetAcctSeq(DUTY_TYPE_NEW);
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur :=0;
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_New :=0;

 IF InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur=-1 OR InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_New=-1 THEN
 str.DispAlert('نوع الرسوم على طلب الربط بالتأمين غير معروفة ','ERROR'); --'--
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 FOR InsReqsDtl_Rec IN CUR_InsReqsDtl(InsReqsDtlsPort,InsReqsDtlsNbr,InsReqsDtlsDt)
 LOOP
 IF InsReqsDtl_Rec.ACCT_SEQ = InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur THEN
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur:=InsReqsDtl_Rec.AMT;
 InsReqsDtlsExpry:=InsReqsDtl_Rec.REQ_EXPRY_DT; -- for the case of insertion
 InsReqsDtlsSta:=InsReqsDtl_Rec.INS_REQ_STA; -- for the case of insertion
 ELSIF InsReqsDtl_Rec.ACCT_SEQ = InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_NEW THEN
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_New:=InsReqsDtl_Rec.AMT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur=0 THEN
 str.DispAlert('صنف التأمين غير موجود','ERROR'); --'--
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 -------------------- INS_CASHES --------------------------------
 InsCachesPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsCachesInsReqNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsCachesInsReqDt :=InsReqsDt;


 SELECT COUNT(C.CASH_ISN)
 INTO Dum
 FROM INS_CASHES C,CASH_DTLS CD
 WHERE C.PORT_CD=CD.PORT_CD AND C.CASH_ISN=CD.CASH_ISN AND
 C.PORT_CD=PORT_CD_Par AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsCachesInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsCachesInsReqDt AND
 C.CASH_NBR IS NOT NULL /* استمارة مرقمة *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur /* رقم الحساب الحالي*/; /**/

 IF DUM>0 THEN
 str.DispAlert('يوجد استمارة صرف مرقمة ، لا يمكن التعديل','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 IF InsReqsPmt=1 THEN -- تأمين نقدى
 -------------------- BRNCH_DAILYS --------------------------------
 BrnchDailyPort :=CollOrdrPort;
 BrnchDailyBankCd :=CollOrdrBankCd;
 BrnchDailyBankBrnchCd :=CollOrdrBankBrnchCd;
 BrnchDailyRevDt :=CollOrdrCollDt;
 -------------------- BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS --------------------------------
 BrnchDailyDtlPort :=BrnchDailyPort;
 BrnchDailyDtlBankCd :=BrnchDailyBankCd;
 BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd :=BrnchDailyBankBrnchCd;
 BrnchDailyDtlRevDt :=BrnchDailyRevDt;

 ELSIF InsReqsPmt=2 THEN -- تأمين بخطاب ضمان

 -------------------- INS_REQ_CLRNCS & REQ_CLRNC_DTLS --------------------------------
 InsReqClrncsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsReqClrncsInsReqDt :=InsReqsDt;

 ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq :=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur;

 Dum:=0;
 SELECT COUNT(C.INS_REQ_NBR)
 INTO Dum
 FROM INS_REQ_CLRNCS C, REQ_CLRNC_DTLS CD
 WHERE C.PORT_CD = CD.PORT_CD AND C.INS_REQ_NBR = CD.INS_REQ_NBR AND C.INS_REQ_DT = CD.INS_REQ_DT AND
 C.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt AND
 C.CLRNC_TYPE =1 /* مصادرة *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq /* رقم الحساب الحالي*//**/ AND
 C.CNFSCTN_NBR IS NOT NULL /* خطاب المصادرة مطبوع *//**/;
 IF DUM>0 THEN
 str.DispAlert(' تم طباعة خطاب مصادرة ، يجب حذف الخطاب أولاً ','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 -------------------- CREDIT_LETTERS --------------------------------
 CreditLetterPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 CreditLetterNbr :=InsReqsCrLetrNbr;
 CreditLetterDt :=InsReqsCrLetrDt;
 CreditLetterType :=InsReqsCrLetrType;

 OPEN CUR_CreditLetter(CreditLetterPort,CreditLetterNbr,CreditLetterDt,CreditLetterType);
 FETCH CUR_CreditLetter INTO CreditLetterOriglAmt,CreditLetterCurTotAmt,CreditLetterUsedAmt,
 CreditLetterSta,CreditLetterRlsNbr,CreditLetterRlsDt;
 IF CUR_CreditLetter%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE CUR_CreditLetter;
 str.DispAlert('خطاب الضمان غير موجود','ERROR');--'
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE CUR_CreditLetter;

 IF CreditLetterRlsNbr IS NOT NULL THEN
 str.DispAlert(' تم الإفراج عن خطاب الضمان ','ERROR'); --'
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- تأمين بخطاب ضمان --'


 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -------- START UPDATING ---------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------

 -------------------- DCLTN_ITEMS --------------------------------
 /*BEGIN
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET DUTY_TYPE=DUTY_TYPE_NEW
 WHERE PORT_CD=DcltnItemsPort AND ITEM_ISN=Item_ISN_Par ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating DCLTN_ITEMS ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;*//**/

 -------------------- COLL_ORDER_DETAIL --------------------------------
 BEGIN
 CollOrdrAmt_Cur :=CollOrdrAmt_Cur - DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty; -- subtract the the duty from current account
 IF CollOrdrAmt_Cur<0 THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error IN COLL_ORDER_DETAIL value ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- IF THE ACCOUNT AMOUNT IS ZERO , DELETE
 IF CollOrdrAmt_Cur=0 THEN
 DELETE FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD=CollOrdrDtlsPort AND COLL_ORDR_NBR=CollOrdrDtlsNbr AND COLL_ORDR_DT=CollOrdrDtlsDt
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY=CollOrdrDtlsCtgry AND ACCT_SEQ=CollOrdrAcctSeq_Cur;
 END IF;

 -- UPDATE THE ACCOUTN AMOUNT
 IF CollOrdrAmt_Cur>0 THEN
 UPDATE COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 SET AMT=CollOrdrAmt_Cur
 WHERE PORT_CD=CollOrdrDtlsPort AND COLL_ORDR_NBR=CollOrdrDtlsNbr AND COLL_ORDR_DT=CollOrdrDtlsDt
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY=CollOrdrDtlsCtgry AND ACCT_SEQ=CollOrdrAcctSeq_Cur;
 END IF;

 -- IF THE NEW ACCOUNT AMOUNT IS ZERO , INSERT
 IF CollOrdrAmt_New =0 THEN
 CollOrdrAmt_New := DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 INSERT INTO COLL_ORDER_DTLS (PORT_CD, COLL_ORDR_NBR, COLL_ORDR_DT, COLL_ORDR_CTGRY, ACCT_SEQ,
 AMT, SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 VALUES(CollOrdrDtlsPort,CollOrdrDtlsNbr,CollOrdrDtlsDt,CollOrdrDtlsCtgry
 ,CollOrdrAcctSeq_New,CollOrdrAmt_New,0);
 -- IF THE NEW ACCOUNT AMOUNT > ZERO , UPDATE
 ELSIF CollOrdrAmt_New >0 THEN
 CollOrdrAmt_New := CollOrdrAmt_New+DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 UPDATE COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 SET AMT=CollOrdrAmt_NEW
 WHERE PORT_CD=CollOrdrDtlsPort AND COLL_ORDR_NBR=CollOrdrDtlsNbr AND COLL_ORDR_DT=CollOrdrDtlsDt
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY=CollOrdrDtlsCtgry AND ACCT_SEQ=CollOrdrAcctSeq_NEW;
 END IF;


 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating COLL_ORDER_DETAIL ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;

 -------------------- INS_REQS_DETAIL --------------------------------
 BEGIN
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur :=InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur - DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty; -- subtract the the duty from current account
 IF InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur<0 THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error IN INS_REQS_DETAIL value ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- IF THE ACCOUNT AMOUNT IS ZERO , DELETE
 IF InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur=0 THEN
 DELETE FROM INS_REQ_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD=InsReqsDtlsPort AND INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqsDtlsNbr AND INS_REQ_DT=InsReqsDtlsDt
 AND ACCT_SEQ=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur;
 END IF;

 -- UPDATE THE ACCOUTN AMOUNT
 IF InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur>0 THEN
 UPDATE INS_REQ_DTLS
 SET AMT=InsReqsDtlsAmt_Cur
 WHERE PORT_CD=InsReqsDtlsPort AND INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqsDtlsNbr AND INS_REQ_DT=InsReqsDtlsDt
 AND ACCT_SEQ=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur;
 END IF;



 -- IF THE NEW ACCOUNT AMOUNT IS ZERO , INSERT
 IF InsReqsDtlsAmt_New =0 THEN
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_New := DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 INSERT INTO INS_REQ_DTLS (port_cd, ins_req_nbr, ins_req_dt,
 acct_seq, amt, req_expry_dt,
 ins_req_sta, srce_port_amt
 ) VALUES(InsReqsDtlsPort,InsReqsDtlsNbr,InsReqsDtlsDt,
 InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_New,InsReqsDtlsAmt_New,InsReqsDtlsExpry,InsReqsDtlsSta,0);
 -- IF THE NEW ACCOUNT AMOUNT > ZERO , UPDATE
 ELSIF InsReqsDtlsAmt_New >0 THEN
 InsReqsDtlsAmt_New := InsReqsDtlsAmt_New+DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 UPDATE INS_REQ_DTLS
 SET AMT=InsReqsDtlsAmt_New
 WHERE PORT_CD=InsReqsDtlsPort AND INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqsDtlsNbr AND INS_REQ_DT=InsReqsDtlsDt
 AND ACCT_SEQ=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_NEW;
 END IF;



 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating INS_REQS_DETAIL ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;

 -------------------- INS_CASHES --------------------------------
 BEGIN
 OPEN CUR_InsCaches(InsCachesPort,InsCachesInsReqNbr,InsCachesInsReqDt);
 LOOP
 FETCH CUR_InsCaches INTO InsCachesCashIsn,InsCachesCashNbr,InsCachesCashDt,
 InsCachesClrncSeq,InsCachesCashRsn,InsCachesPrintCnt;
 EXIT WHEN CUR_InsCaches%NOTFOUND;
 -------------------- CASHE_DTLS --------------------------------
 DELETE FROM CASH_DTLS CD
 WHERE CD.PORT_CD=InsCachesPort AND CD.CASH_ISN=InsCachesCashIsn
 AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur /* رقم الحساب الحالي*//**/
 ;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CUR_InsCaches;

 DELETE FROM INS_CASHES C
 WHERE C.PORT_CD=InsCachesPort AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsCachesInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsCachesInsReqDt AND
 0=( SELECT COUNT(CASH_ISN)
 FROM CASH_DTLS CD
 WHERE CD.PORT_CD=InsCachesPort AND CD.CASH_ISN=C.CASH_ISN);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating INS_CASHES ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;


 IF InsReqsPmt=2 THEN -- تأمين بخطاب ضمان
 -------------------- INS_REQ_CLRNCS --------------------------------
 -------------------- REQ_CLRNC_DTLS --------------------------------
 -------------------- INS_REQ_CLRNCS & REQ_CLRNC_DTLS --------------------------------
 BEGIN


 InsReqClrncsPort :=PORT_CD_Par;
 InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr :=InsReqsNbr;
 InsReqClrncsInsReqDt :=InsReqsDt;

 ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq :=InsReqsDtlsAcctSeq_Cur;

 Total_Conf :=0;
 Total_Release :=0;

 -- مجموع مبالغ المصادرة التى لم يتم طباعة خطاب مصادرة لها--
 SELECT NVL(SUM(CD.AMT),0)
 INTO Total_Conf
 FROM INS_REQ_CLRNCS C, REQ_CLRNC_DTLS CD
 WHERE C.PORT_CD = CD.PORT_CD AND C.INS_REQ_NBR = CD.INS_REQ_NBR AND C.INS_REQ_DT = CD.INS_REQ_DT AND
 C.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt AND
 C.CLRNC_TYPE =1 /* مصادرة *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq /* رقم الحساب الحالي*//**/ AND
 C.CNFSCTN_NBR IS NULL /* خطاب المصادرة غير مطبوع *//* just to make sure *//**/;

 -- مجموع مبالغ التعلية -- --
 SELECT NVL(SUM(CD.AMT),0)
 INTO Total_Release
 FROM INS_REQ_CLRNCS C, REQ_CLRNC_DTLS CD
 WHERE C.PORT_CD = CD.PORT_CD AND C.INS_REQ_NBR = CD.INS_REQ_NBR AND C.INS_REQ_DT = CD.INS_REQ_DT AND
 C.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt AND
 C.CLRNC_TYPE =2 /* تعلية *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq /* رقم الحساب الحالي*//**/ AND
 C.CNFSCTN_NBR IS NULL /* خطاب المصادرة غير مطبوع *//**/;


 -- مسح تفاصيل المصادرة و التعلية --
 FOR Clr_Rec IN CUR_InsReqClrns(InsReqClrncsPort,InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr,InsReqClrncsInsReqDt)
 LOOP
 DELETE FROM REQ_CLRNC_DTLS CD
 WHERE CD.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND CD.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND CD.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt
 AND CD.CLRNC_SEQ=Clr_Rec.CLRNC_SEQ /* المسلسل *//**/ AND CD.ACCT_SEQ=ReqClrncDtlsAcctSeq /* رقم الحساب الحالي*//**/;
 END LOOP;

 DELETE FROM INS_REQ_CLRNCS C
 WHERE C.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND C.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND C.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt AND
 0=( SELECT COUNT(INS_REQ_NBR)
 FROM REQ_CLRNC_DTLS CD
 WHERE CD.PORT_CD=InsReqClrncsPort AND CD.INS_REQ_NBR=InsReqClrncsInsReqNbr AND
 CD.INS_REQ_DT=InsReqClrncsInsReqDt AND CD.CLRNC_SEQ=C.CLRNC_SEQ);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating INS_REQ_CLRNCS & REQ_CLRNC_DTLS ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;

 -------------------- CREDIT_LETTERS --------------------------------
 BEGIN
 -- Total_Conf مجموع المصادرة --
 -- Total_Release مجموع التعلية --
 CreditLetterCurTotAmt:=CreditLetterCurTotAmt-Total_Release;
 CreditLetterUsedAmt:=CreditLetterUsedAmt+Total_Release+Total_Conf;

 UPDATE CREDIT_LETTERS
 SET CURR_TOT_AMT=CreditLetterCurTotAmt , USED_AMT=CreditLetterUsedAmt
 WHERE PORT_CD=CreditLetterPort AND CR_LETR_NBR=CreditLetterNbr AND CR_LETR_DT=CreditLetterDt AND CR_LETR_TYPE=CreditLetterType;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating CREDIT_LETTERS ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 END IF;-- تأمين بخطاب ضمان --

 IF InsReqsPmt=1 THEN -- تأمين نقدى
 -------------------- BRNCH_DAILYS --------------------------------
 /*BEGIN
 UPDATE BRNCH_DAILYS
 SET NEED_PRINT=1
 WHERE PORT_CD=BrnchDailyPort AND BANK_CD=BrnchDailyBankCd AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BrnchDailyBankBrnchCd
 AND REV_DT=BrnchDailyRevDt;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating BRNCH_DAILYS ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 END; */
 -------------------- BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS --------------------------------
 BEGIN

 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur :=GetAcctSeq(DcltnItemsDutyType);
 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_New :=GetAcctSeq(DUTY_TYPE_NEW);
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur :=0;
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New :=0;

 IF BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur=-1 OR BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_New=-1 THEN
 str.DispAlert('نوع الرسوم على الصنف غير معروفة ','ERROR');
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 OPEN CUR_BrnchDailyDtl(BrnchDailyDtlPort,BrnchDailyDtlBankCd,BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd,BrnchDailyDtlRevDt);
 LOOP
 FETCH CUR_BrnchDailyDtl INTO BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq,BrnchDailyDtlAmt;
 EXIT WHEN CUR_BrnchDailyDtl%NOTFOUND;

 IF BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq = BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur THEN
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur:=BrnchDailyDtlAmt;
 END IF;
 IF BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq =BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_New THEN
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New:=BrnchDailyDtlAmt;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CUR_BrnchDailyDtl;


 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur:=BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur-DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;

 IF BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur= 0 THEN
 DELETE FROM BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD=BrnchDailyDtlPort AND BANK_CD=BrnchDailyDtlBankCd AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd
 AND REV_DT=BrnchDailyDtlRevDt AND ACCT_SEQ=BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur;
 END IF;

 IF BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur> 0 THEN
 UPDATE BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS
 SET AMT=BrnchDailyDtlAmt_Cur
 WHERE PORT_CD=BrnchDailyDtlPort AND BANK_CD=BrnchDailyDtlBankCd AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd
 AND REV_DT=BrnchDailyDtlRevDt AND ACCT_SEQ=BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_Cur;
 END IF;

 IF BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New=0 THEN
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New:=DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 INSERT INTO BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS(PORT_CD,BANK_CD,BANK_BRNCH_CD,REV_DT,ACCT_SEQ,AMT,SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 VALUES(BrnchDailyDtlPort,BrnchDailyDtlBankCd,
 BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd,BrnchDailyDtlRevDt,
 BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_NEW,BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New,0);
 ELSIF BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New> 0 THEN
 BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New:=BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New+DcltnItemsOrgnlDuty;
 UPDATE BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS
 SET AMT=BrnchDailyDtlAmt_New
 WHERE PORT_CD=BrnchDailyDtlPort AND BANK_CD=BrnchDailyDtlBankCd AND BANK_BRNCH_CD=BrnchDailyDtlBankBrnchCd
 AND REV_DT=BrnchDailyDtlRevDt AND ACCT_SEQ=BrnchDailyDtlAcctSeq_NEW;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating BRNCH_DAILY_DTLS ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 -------------------- INS_BALCS --------------------------------
 BEGIN

 DELETE FROM INS_BALCS
 WHERE BALC_DT>=CollOrdrCollDt;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.DispAlert('Error updating INS_BALCS ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 END IF; -- تأمين نقدى
 --COMMIT;
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CARS_MODEL_OPERATION

PROCEDURE CARS_MODEL_OPERATION(DATABASE_EFFECT NUMBER,OPR_CHK_HRM_NEW NUMBER DEFAULT 0,V$TARIFF_CD VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL) IS

BEGIN


IF ((TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') >= '1430-03-03' AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)) OR (:DCLTN_DT IS NULL AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2))) THEN

IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (1,2) THEN ----------------CONDICTION DELETED By Walid Elkatan on 25-02-2021 DM-179----------


IF OPR_CHK_HRM_NEW=1 THEN
/*
DECLARE


CURSOR CUR_HRMNZ IS SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD,CARS_MODEL FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE
 PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND
 DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND ITEM_ISN !=:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ;

 THERE_IS_ITEMS_OTHER NUMBER:=0;
 NEW_CAR NUMBER:=0;
 OLD_CAR NUMBER:=0;
 VALIDATE_CAR NUMBER := CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE (:FINAL_TARIFF_CD);
BEGIN

IF :PARAMETER.P_IMPR_TYPE_CD !=4 THEN

FOR HRMNZ IN CUR_HRMNZ LOOP


 IF CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE (HRMNZ.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)= 0 THEN
 THERE_IS_ITEMS_OTHER:= 1;
 END IF;

 IF HRMNZ.CARS_MODEL=1 THEN
 NEW_CAR:= 1;
 END IF;

 IF HRMNZ.CARS_MODEL= 0 THEN
 OLD_CAR:= 1;
 END IF;


END LOOP;

IF OLD_CAR=1 AND :CARS_MODEL=1 AND VALIDATE_CAR=1 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لاتستطيع انشاء صنف سيارة جديدة مع صنف سيارات قديمة','ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;


IF NEW_CAR=1 AND VALIDATE_CAR=0 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لاتستطيع انشاء صنف بضاعة مع صنف سيارة جديدة','ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF THERE_IS_ITEMS_OTHER=1 AND :CARS_MODEL=1 AND VALIDATE_CAR=1 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لاتستطيع انشاء سيارة جديدة مع بضائع','ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;



IF NEW_CAR=1 AND :CARS_MODEL=0 AND VALIDATE_CAR=1 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لاتستطيع انشاء صنف سيارة قديمة مع صنف سيارات جديدة','ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END IF;

END;


*/ NULL;

END IF;

IF OPR_CHK_HRM_NEW=0 THEN
 IF CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE (V$TARIFF_CD)= 1 THEN
 CAR_MODEL_LAYOUT(1);
 ELSE
 CAR_MODEL_LAYOUT(0);
 IF DATABASE_EFFECT=1 THEN
 :CARS_MODEL:=NULL;
 :CARS_MODEL_CON_DT:=NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
ELSE
CAR_MODEL_LAYOUT(0);
END IF; ----------------DELETED By Walid Elkatan on 25-02-2021 DM-179----------

ELSE
CAR_MODEL_LAYOUT(0);
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAR_MODEL_LAYOUT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CAR_MODEL_LAYOUT(OPR NUMBER) IS
BEGIN



IF ((TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') >= '1430-03-03' AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)) OR (:DCLTN_DT IS NULL AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2))) THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (1,2) THEN ----------------CONDICTION DELETED By Walid Elkatan on 25-02-2021 DM-179----------
 IF OPR=1 THEN

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL IS NULL AND
 ( GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED)='TRUE' OR
 GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',INSERT_ALLOWED)='TRUE' ) THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSIF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS',UPDATE_ALLOWED)='FALSE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.CARS_MODEL', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
END IF; ----------------DELETED By Walid Elkatan on 25-02-2021 DM-179----------


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE(V$HRMNZD_CODE VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS


FOUND NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN



SELECT 1 INTO FOUND FROM DUAL WHERE
 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE=V$HRMNZD_CODE AND GRP_CODE=76);


RETURN FOUND;

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
RETURN 0;

END;

 END IF;

PROCEDURE CALL_LOV_SEA_BILL IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'BILL';
 RET NUMBER;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_INS_RSN_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_INS_RSN_LOV(V_INS_RSN_TYPE NUMBER:=1) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'INS_RSNS_LOV';
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.INS_RSN_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.INS_RSN_DESC := NULL;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'اختيار سبب الإدخال المؤقت');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_INS_RSN_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_INS_RSN_TYPE);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_INS_RSNS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
IF :GLOBAL.INS_RSN_CD <> 18 THEN
DECLARE
X NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM group_items
WHERE grp_code = 179 AND hrmnzd_code=:FINAL_TARIFF_CD;
IF X = 0 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('البند غير مسموح بادخاله مؤقتاً', 'ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_EMPTY_CNTNRS_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'EMPTY_CNTNRS';
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة أنـواع الـحــاويات');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 4.1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT' , TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'TARIFF_LOV', TEXT_PARAMETER,1);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_EMPTY_CNTNRS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);


 DECLARE
 V_FOUND_CNTR NUMBER:=0;

 BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_FOUND_CNTR
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VC,
 CNTNR_TYPES CT
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND CT.TYPE_SIZE = :GLOBAL.TYPE_SIZE
 AND SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR
 AND SDI.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT
 AND SDI.ITEM_SEQ = VBI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND SDI.BL_SEQ = VBI.BL_SEQ
 AND SDI.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.PORT_CD = VC.PORT_CD
 AND VBI.CNTNR_SEQ = VC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VBI.MFST_TYPE = VC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.MFST_NBR = VC.MFST_NBR
 AND VBI.MFST_DT = VC.MFST_DT
 AND VC.SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 8
 AND SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD = CT.CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 AND (VC.CNTNR_MRK,VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD) NOT IN

 (SELECT CNTNR_MRK,CNTNR_TYPE_CD FROM WVR_ITEMS,WAIVERS
 WHERE WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND WAIVERS.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_SEQ_NBR = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_SEQ_NBR)
 AND (WAIVERS.ISSUED_DT = WVR_ITEMS.ISSUED_DT)
 AND WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_STATUS <> 9 AND WAIVERS.CLRNC_DT is null
 AND WAIVERS.WVR_STATUS <> 0);
 IF V_FOUND_CNTR = 0 THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 STR.DISPALERT('لقد تم اسنفاذ جميع الحاويات الفارغة المربوطة على الشحن','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 END;



 IF :GLOBAL.TYPE_SIZE IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE := :GLOBAL.TYPE_SIZE;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE_DESC :=' قدم '|| :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE|| ' حاويات ';
 :INV_QTY := :GLOBAL.CNTNR_COUNT;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END CALL_EMPTY_CNTNRS_LOV;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_LOV_RE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
PROCEDURE CALL_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_LOV_RE (P_MODE VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_RE';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ NUMBER;
 --
 CURSOR V_INV_ITEMS_CUR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DIT.ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DIT, DCLTN_DUMP_HZS DDH, DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS DDP, DCLTN_DUMP_CMPNYS DDC
 WHERE DIT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND DIT.INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND DDH.WEIGHT_QTY_FLAG = 1
 AND DIT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = DDH.HRMNZD_CODE
 --AND DIT.FINAL_TARIFF_DT = DDH.EFF_DATE
 AND DDH.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 AND DDH.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 AND HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DDP.DUMP_ST_DATE AND DDP.DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDC.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 AND DIT.CTRY_CD = DDC.CTRY_CD
 AND DIT.INV_MSR_UNIT <> DDH.INV_MSR_UNIT
 ;
 CURSOR V_PERIOD_CUR (V_DUMP_CMP_SEQ NUMBER) IS
 SELECT DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS
 WHERE HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DUMP_ST_DATE AND DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = V_DUMP_CMP_SEQ
 ;
 V_PERIOD_REC V_PERIOD_CUR%ROWTYPE;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := '';
 MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
BEGIN
 IF P_MODE = 'INSERT' THEN
 FOR INV_ITEMS_REC IN V_INV_ITEMS_CUR LOOP
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CHR (10) || 'الوحدة غير متطابقة في الصنف رقم ' || TO_CHAR(INV_ITEMS_REC.ITEM_SEQ) ;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 --
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG , 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN();
 ELSE
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_name );
 end if;
 --
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_HEIGHT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 12);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'الشركات المغرقة / 2');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_inv_isn', TEXT_PARAMETER, 0 );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 2 );
 --str.dispalert(' :DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_isn ==> ' ||:DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_isn,'error');--
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_G_DT', TEXT_PARAMETER, TO_CHAR(HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT),'dd-mm-yyyy') );
 IF P_MODE = 'UPDATE' THEN
 SELECT DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, DDCI.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ INTO V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, V_DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV DDCI, DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS DDP
 WHERE DDCI.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND DDCI.INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DDP.DUMP_ST_DATE AND DDP.DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DDCI.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 AND DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 ;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ);
 END IF;
 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP.fmx',no_hide,no_replace,no_query_only,pl_id);
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :GLOBAL.OK = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 IF P_MODE = 'INSERT' THEN
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE := 11;
 V_MSG := 'تم تحديد الشركة المغرقة ';
 ELSIF P_MODE = 'UPDATE' THEN
 DELETE FROM DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 ;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE := 10;
 V_MSG := 'تم تغيير الشركة المغرقة إلى ';
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Str.DispAlert(' MH 00 :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ ==> '||:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ,'error');--
 -- Str.dispalert(' MH 01 date to_greg ==> ' || HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT),'error');--
 -- Str.dispalert(' MH 02 date ==> ' || :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT,'error');--
 DECLARE
 v_cnt NUMBER ;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS
 WHERE HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DUMP_ST_DATE AND DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ
 ;
 IF v_cnt = 0 THEN
 str.dispalert('الشركة المختارة خارج أي من الفترات المغرقة','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN();
 END IF;
 END ;
 OPEN V_PERIOD_CUR(:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ);
 LOOP
 FETCH V_PERIOD_CUR INTO V_PERIOD_REC;
 EXIT WHEN V_PERIOD_CUR%NOTFOUND;
 --Str.DispAlert(' MH 100 ','error');
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV (PORT_CD, INV_ISN, DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ, INSPECT_USR_CODE, INSPECT_DATE, INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG)
 VALUES
 (:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN, :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ, V_PERIOD_REC.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, SYSDATE, 2)
 ;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE V_PERIOD_CUR;
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 2, V_ACTIVITY_TYPE, :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN||'!'||:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;
 str.dispalert(V_MSG || :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_NAME,'INFORMATION');
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- EXCEPTION
 -- WHEN OTHERS THEN
 -- Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--MMAOUA 18/06/2017
-- modified by DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
PROCEDURE CALL_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_LOV(P_MODE VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ NUMBER;
 CURSOR V_INV_ITEMS_CUR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DIT.ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DIT, DCLTN_DUMP_HZS DDH, DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS DDP, DCLTN_DUMP_CMPNYS DDC
 WHERE DIT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND DIT.INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND DDH.WEIGHT_QTY_FLAG = 1
 AND DIT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = DDH.HRMNZD_CODE
 --AND DIT.FINAL_TARIFF_DT = DDH.EFF_DATE
 AND DDH.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 AND DDH.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 AND HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DDP.DUMP_ST_DATE AND DDP.DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDC.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 AND DIT.CTRY_CD = DDC.CTRY_CD
 AND DIT.INV_MSR_UNIT <> DDH.INV_MSR_UNIT;
 CURSOR V_PERIOD_CUR (V_DUMP_CMP_SEQ NUMBER) IS
 SELECT DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS
 WHERE HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DUMP_ST_DATE AND DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = V_DUMP_CMP_SEQ;
 V_PERIOD_REC V_PERIOD_CUR%ROWTYPE;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := '';
 MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
BEGIN
 IF P_MODE = 'INSERT' THEN
 FOR INV_ITEMS_REC IN V_INV_ITEMS_CUR LOOP
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CHR (10) || 'الوحدة غير متطابقة في الصنف رقم ' || TO_CHAR(INV_ITEMS_REC.ITEM_SEQ) ;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG , 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN();
 ELSE
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
--Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_HEIGHT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 12);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'الشركات المغرقة');

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_inv_isn', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_isn );
--str.dispalert(' :DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_isn ==> ' ||:DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_isn,'error');--
Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_G_DT', TEXT_PARAMETER, TO_CHAR(HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT),'dd-mm-yyyy') );



 IF P_MODE = 'UPDATE' THEN
 SELECT DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, DDCI.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ INTO V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, V_DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV DDCI, DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS DDP
 WHERE DDCI.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD
 AND DDCI.INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DDP.DUMP_ST_DATE AND DDP.DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DDCI.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 AND DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ);
 END IF;

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :GLOBAL.OK = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 -- DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
 IF P_MODE = 'INSERT' AND :GLOBAL.DUMP_APRV_STS = 2 AND CHECK_EGHRAK_OK = 1 THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 CALL_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_LOV_RE('INSERT');
 RETURN;
 -- END DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022

 ELSIF P_MODE = 'INSERT' AND :GLOBAL.DUMP_APRV_STS = 1 THEN
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE := 11;
 V_MSG := 'تم تحديد الشركة المغرقة ';

 -- DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
 ELSIF P_MODE = 'UPDATE' AND :GLOBAL.DUMP_APRV_STS = 2 AND CHECK_EGHRAK_OK = 1 THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 CALL_DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_LOV_RE('UPDATE');
 RETURN;
 -- END DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
 ELSIF P_MODE = 'UPDATE' THEN
 -- DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
 IF CHECK_EGHRAK_OK = 1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV
 SET INSPECT_APPROV_FLAG = :GLOBAL.DUMP_APRV_STS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN
 AND DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ
 ;
 END IF;
 -- END DM-123 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 10/03/2022
 DELETE FROM DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD AND INV_ISN = :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN;
 V_ACTIVITY_TYPE := 10;
 --V_MSG := 'تم تغيير الشركة المغرقة إلى ';
 V_MSG := 'تمت المطابقة'; -- issue CR-3284 Mohamed Shehata 02-08-2022
 END IF;

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Str.DispAlert(' MH 00 :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ ==> '||:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ,'error');--
-- Str.dispalert(' MH 01 date to_greg ==> ' || HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT),'error');--
-- Str.dispalert(' MH 02 date ==> ' || :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT,'error');--

DECLARE
v_cnt NUMBER ;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*)
INTO v_cnt
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS
 WHERE HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DUMP_ST_DATE AND DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ;
IF v_cnt = 0 THEN
str.dispalert('الشركة المختارة خارج أي من الفترات المغرقة','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN();
END IF;

END ;
 OPEN V_PERIOD_CUR(:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ);
 LOOP FETCH V_PERIOD_CUR INTO V_PERIOD_REC;
 EXIT WHEN V_PERIOD_CUR%NOTFOUND;
--Str.DispAlert(' MH 100 ','error');


 INSERT INTO DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV (PORT_CD, INV_ISN, DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ, INSPECT_USR_CODE, INSPECT_DATE)
 VALUES (:DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN, :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ, V_PERIOD_REC.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, SYSDATE);
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE V_PERIOD_CUR;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 2, V_ACTIVITY_TYPE, :DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN||'!'||:GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;
 str.dispalert(V_MSG || :GLOBAL.DUMP_CMP_NAME,'INFORMATION');
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTION
 -- WHEN OTHERS THEN
 -- Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_CURRENCIES_LOV

PROCEDURE CALL_CURRENCIES_LOV(V_CD_ITEM VARCHAR2, V_CURCY_ITEM VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'CTRY_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.CURCY_ARBC_NAME := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.CURCY_ENG_NAME := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.CURCY_INTL_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.CURCY_STATUS := NULL;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة العملات');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_CURRENCIES.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');

 END IF;


 IF :GLOBAL.CURCY_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF V_CD_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.CURCY_CD, V_CD_ITEM);
 END IF;

 IF V_CURCY_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.CURCY_ARBC_NAME, V_CURCY_ITEM);
 END IF;
 END IF; -- :GLOBAL.CURCY_CD IS NOT NULL

END CALL_CURRENCIES_LOV;
