ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_RQRD_DUTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CALC_RQRD_DUTY RETURN NUMBER IS
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 RET := ROUND (NVL(:ORGNL_DUTY ,0),2) - ROUND (NVL(:EXMTD_DUTY, 0),2) - ROUND (NVL (:KSA_DUTY,0),2);-- CR-7466

IF RET <0 THEN
RET:=0 ;
END IF ;

 RETURN RET;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: BAR_CODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION BAR_CODE RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_BAR_CODE_CHR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_BAR_CODE_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_BAR_CODE_CHR
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 999
 AND VAR_NAME = 'USE_BAR_CODE'
 ;

 V_BAR_CODE_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_BAR_CODE_CHR);

 IF V_BAR_CODE_NBR = 1 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: APPROVE_CERT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE APPROVE_CERT IS
DEPT_ID NUMBER;
BEGIN

BEGIN
SELECT SPCL_DEPT_ID
 INTO DEPT_ID
FROM DECLARATIONS
WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END ;


 --***************** <<>> MOHAMED HABIB <<>> *********************
 --***************وظيفه التأكيد على شهادة المطابقه ****************
 --***************************************************************

IF :IDEN_CERT_APPRV=8 AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) AND DEPT_ID IS NULL THEN
STR.DispALERT(' هذة المعامله يجب تحويلها للمعمل لاسباب الاختيار العشوائى لا يمكن تأكيد شهادة المطابقة ','information');
terminate_fun;
ELSE


 IF(:IDEN_CERT_APPRV =1 OR :IDEN_CERT_APPRV IS NULL) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) AND DEPT_ID IS NULL THEN -- رئيس مجموعة

 UPDT_CERT(2,2); -- رئيس مجموعة --

 ELSIF :IDEN_CERT_APPRV IN (3,5) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_RSTRCT') AND DEPT_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.RSTRCT_DEPT') THEN -- موظف قيود

 UPDT_CERT(4,2);

 ELSIF :IDEN_CERT_APPRV IN(6,8) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_SMPL') AND DEPT_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.LAB_DEPT') THEN -- موظف تحليل عينات--

 UPDT_CERT(7,2);

 END IF;





END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_UNITS IS
 INTL_VAL NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT');
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY IS NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY');
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT IS NOT NULL THEN
 INTL_VAL := UNIT.UNIT2UNIT(:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT, :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT, :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY);
 IF INTL_VAL = -1 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY' , TRUE);
 ELSE -- INTL_VAL = -1
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY := INTL_VAL;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY' , FALSE);
 END IF; -- INTL_VAL = -1

 IF :PARAMETER.P_SUP_QTY <> 1 THEN -- BY MOHAMED ABD ELMONEM (EXT. 4853) @ 10/6/2004 TO SUPPORT QTY
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT = UNIT.MU_GRS_KG THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('UNIT.MU_GRS_KG') THEN
--&&& END
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT' , FALSE);
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT IS NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT' , TRUE);
 END IF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT = UNIT.MU_NET_KG THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('UNIT.MU_NET_KG') THEN
--&&& END
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT' , FALSE);
 ELSE
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_ITEMS.NET_WT' , TRUE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT IS NULL

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_INV_VAL_FLDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_INV_VAL_FLDS (CHANGE_FLDS BOOLEAN) IS
 CAN_UPDATE BOOLEAN;
 v_recs NUMBER;--CR-7757
 v_ship_on NUMBER;--CR-7757
 v_insur_on NUMBER;--CR-7757
BEGIN
 IF CHANGE_FLDS = FALSE THEN
 CAN_UPDATE := FALSE;
 ELSE
 IF (GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES', UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' OR
 GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES', INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE')



 THEN
 CAN_UPDATE := TRUE;
 ELSE
 CAN_UPDATE := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 -- ADJUST INV_NBR AND INV_CURCY FIELDS
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE = DCLTN.IT_EXCEP THEN
 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.IT_EXCEP') THEN
--&&& END
 -- ADJUST INV_NBR
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_NBR := NULL;
 END IF;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_NBR', FALSE);

 -- ADJUST INV_CURCY
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD := DCLTN.KSA;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA');
--&&& END
 SELECT CURCY_ARBC_NAME
 INTO :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_NAME
 FROM CURRENCIES
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- WHERE CURCY_CD = DCLTN.KSA;
 WHERE CURCY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA');
--&&& END
 END IF;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 ELSE
 IF :GLOBAL.CHANGE_INV_DATE = 0 THEN
 -- ADJUST INV_NBR
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_NBR', TRUE);

 -- ADJUST INV_CURCY
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 END IF; -- :DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE

 --CR-7757
 IF get_setting_cr_7757 = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_recs
 FROM invoice_types
 WHERE INVOICE_TYPE_CD = :inv_type
 AND SHIPPING_REQUIRED_FLAG = 1
 ;
 IF v_recs > 0 THEN
 v_ship_on := 1;
 ELSE
 v_ship_on := 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 v_ship_on := DCLTN.ENABLE_FRT_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD);
 END IF;
 --END CR-7757
 -- ADJUST FREIGHT FIELDS
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.ENABLE_FRT_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD) = TRUE THEN
 --IF DCLTN.ENABLE_FRT_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN -- CR-7757
--&&& END
 IF v_ship_on = 1 THEN -- new mechanism
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG', TRUE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS' , TRUE);

 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS, 0) > 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' THEN -- CR-7757 -- حقل شحن البوليصة
 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD = 4 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS' , TRUE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;--CR-7757
 ELSE -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS, 0) > 0
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_NAME := NULL;

 :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS := NULL;

 :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' THEN -- CR-7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;--CR-7757
 END IF; -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS, 0) > 0
 ELSE -- DCLTN.ENABLE_FRT_FLDS() = TRUE
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS := NULL;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_type < 10 THEN --CR-7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG', FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 ELSE
 --CR-7757 START
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS' , TRUE);
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_EXPS, 0) > 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 --CR-7757 END
 END IF;
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.SHPMT_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' THEN -- CR-7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CARGO_EXPS' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.BILL_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;--CR-7757
 END IF; -- DCLTN.ENABLE_FRT_FLDS() = TRUE



 -- ADJUST INSURANCE FIELDS
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.ENABLE_INS_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD) = TRUE THEN
 --CR-7757
 IF get_setting_cr_7757 = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_recs
 FROM invoice_types
 WHERE INVOICE_TYPE_CD = :inv_type
 AND INSUR_REQUIRED_FLAG = 1
 ;
 IF v_recs > 0 THEN
 v_insur_on := 1;
 ELSE
 v_insur_on := 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 v_insur_on := DCLTN.ENABLE_INS_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD);
 END IF;
 --END CR-7757

 --IF DCLTN.ENABLE_INS_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN -- old mechanism--CR-7757
--&&& END
 IF v_insur_on = 1 THEN -- new mechanism -- CR-7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS' , TRUE);
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS, 0) >= 0 THEN --(>= instead of >) -- CR-7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS, 0) > 0
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;

 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF; -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS, 0) > 0
 ELSE -- DCLTN.ENABLE_INS_FLDS() = TRUE
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 IF :INV_TYPE < 10 THEN--CR7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 --CR-7757 START
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS' , TRUE);
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_EXPS, 0) > 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS, 0) > 0
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INS_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 --CR-7757 END
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- DCLTN.ENABLE_INS_FLDS() = TRUE

 -- CR-8539 start
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_recs
 FROM invoice_types
 WHERE INVOICE_TYPE_CD = :inv_type
 AND INTERNAL_FEES_REQ_FLAG = 1
 ;
 IF v_recs = 1 THEN --true
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES' , TRUE);
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES, 0) > 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 ELSE --
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.DSP_INTERNAL_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.DSP_INTERNAL_CURCY_NAME' , FALSE);
 END IF; --
 ELSE -- false
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.DSP_INTERNAL_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FEES' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.INT_TRANSPORT_FEES_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- CR-8539 end

 -- ADJUST OTHER FIELDS
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.ENABLE_OTH_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD) = TRUE THEN
 IF DCLTN.ENABLE_OTH_FLDS(:DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
--&&& END
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS' , TRUE);
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS, 0) > 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS, 0) > 0
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;

 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF; -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS, 0) > 0
 ELSE -- DCLTN.ENABLE_OTH_FLDS() = TRUE
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 IF :DCLTN_INVOICES.inv_type < 10 THEN --CR-7757
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS' , FALSE);
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD' , FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 --CR-7757 START
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS' , TRUE);
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS, 0) > 0 THEN
 INTRFACE.Make_Field_Entrable('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD' , TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD2', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE -- NVL(:DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_EXPS, 0) > 0
 IF CAN_UPDATE = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_CD := NULL;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.OTHER_CURCY_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 --CR-7757 END
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- DCLTN.ENABLE_OTH_FLDS() = TRUE
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS IS
 v_rule_isn NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 IF name_in('U_EXCPT_TARIFF') = '1' THEN
 IF chk_excpt_qty(:dcltn_items.INTL_QTY,v_rule_isn) THEN
 INSERT INTO IMPR_RULE_DCLTNS (RULE_ISN,DCLTN_PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,HRMNZD_CODE,USED_QTY,REC_STATUS)
 VALUES(v_rule_isn,:dcltn_items.port_cd,:dcltn_items.ITEM_ISN,:dcltn_items.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:dcltn_items.INTL_QTY,1);
 UPDATE IMPR_RULE_TARIFF_HQ
 SET REMAINED_QTY = REMAINED_QTY - :dcltn_items.INTL_QTY
 WHERE RULE_ISN = v_rule_isn
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = :dcltn_items.FINAL_TARIFF_CD ;
 COPY('0','U_EXCPT_TARIFF');
 ELSE
 str.dispalert('الكمية المتبقية للإستثناء لا تكفي','error');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure ;
 END IF ;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_CNTNR_WVR_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADD_CNTNR_WVR_ITEMS(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_ITEM_ISN NUMBER) IS
 V_CURR_H_DATE DATE := HIJDATE .Cur_Hij_Date;
 V_WVR_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_ISSUED_DT DATE;
 BETWEEN_VACATION DATE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_VAC_DAYS NUMBER;

 CURSOR CUR_CNTNR_RMRKS IS
 SELECT VC.CNTNR_MRK, VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD, ROWNUM
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VC,
 CNTNR_TYPES CT
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND CT.TYPE_SIZE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE
 AND SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR
 AND SDI.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT
 AND SDI.ITEM_SEQ = VBI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND SDI.BL_SEQ = VBI.BL_SEQ
 AND SDI.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.PORT_CD = VC.PORT_CD
 AND VBI.CNTNR_SEQ = VC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VBI.MFST_TYPE = VC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.MFST_NBR = VC.MFST_NBR
 AND VBI.MFST_DT = VC.MFST_DT
 AND VC.SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 8
 AND SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD = CT.CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 AND (VC.CNTNR_MRK,VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD) NOT IN
 (SELECT CNTNR_MRK,CNTNR_TYPE_CD FROM WVR_ITEMS,WAIVERS
 WHERE WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND WAIVERS.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_SEQ_NBR = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_SEQ_NBR)
 AND (WAIVERS.ISSUED_DT = WVR_ITEMS.ISSUED_DT))


 ;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN -- MAIN

 SELECT WVR_SEQ_NBR,ISSUED_DT
 INTO V_WVR_SEQ_NBR,V_ISSUED_DT
 FROM WAIVERS
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM WVR_ITEMS
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND WVR_SEQ_NBR = V_WVR_SEQ_NBR
 AND TO_CHAR(ISSUED_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') = TO_CHAR(V_ISSUED_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI')
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- STRG.GET_VACATION_DAYS(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD, V_CURR_H_DATE, HIJDATE.Add_Hij_Days (V_CURR_H_DATE, 180));
 V_VAC_DAYS := STRG.GET_VACATION_DAYS(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD, V_CURR_H_DATE, HIJDATE.Add_Hij_Days (V_CURR_H_DATE, 180),:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,V_MSG_TXT);

 IF V_VAC_DAYS IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
--&&& END
 BETWEEN_VACATION := HIJDATE.Add_Hij_Days (V_CURR_H_DATE,180 + V_VAC_DAYS);

 FOR I IN CUR_CNTNR_RMRKS LOOP
 INSERT INTO WVR_ITEMS
 (WVR_PORT_CD,
 WVR_SEQ_NBR,
 ISSUED_DT,
 ITEM_SER_NBR,
 ITEM_ISSUE_DT,
 ITEM_END_DT,
 ITEM_TYPE_CD,
 DOC_DCLTN_ISN,
 DOC_STATS_ISN,
 DOC_INVOISE_ISN,
 ITEM_RMRKS,
 TOT_QTY,
 TOT_WGHT,
 CIF_AMOUNT,
 BANK_CD,
 BANK_BRNCH_CD,
 RCPT_NBR,
 RCPT_DT,
 EXCEPTION_CD,
 EXCEPTION_NOTES,
 ITEM_STATUS,
 ITEM_CLRNC_DT,
 RQST_NMR,
 RQST_DT,
 SMPL_NBR,
 CNTNR_MRK,
 CNTNR_TYPE_CD,
 CNTNR_DCLTN_NBR,
 CNTNR_DCLTN_DT,
 CNTNR_DCLTN_TYPE,
 DOC_NBR)
 VALUES
 (V_PORT_CD,
 V_WVR_SEQ_NBR,
 V_ISSUED_DT,
 V_COUNT + I.ROWNUM,
 V_CURR_H_DATE,
 BETWEEN_VACATION,
 21,
 V_ITEM_ISN,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 1,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.GROSS_WT/:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 I.CNTNR_MRK,
 I.CNTNR_TYPE_CD,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL)
 ;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
END ADD_CNTNR_WVR_ITEMS;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_CNTNR_WVR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADD_CNTNR_WVR IS
 V_CURR_H_DATE DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 V_WVR_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.CNTNR_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN -- MAIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM WAIVERS
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 SELECT WVR_SEQ.NEXTVAL INTO V_WVR_SEQ_NBR FROM DUAL;

 INSERT INTO WAIVERS
 (WVR_PORT_CD,
 WVR_SEQ_NBR,
 ISSUED_DT,
 WVR_TYPE,
 DCLTN_TYPE,
 DCLTN_ISN,
 STATS_ISN,
 IMPR_NBR,
 BRK_PORT_CD,
 BRK_LIC_TYPE,
 BRK_LIC_NBR,
 WVR_STATUS,
 CLRNC_DT)
 VALUES
 (:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,
 V_WVR_SEQ_NBR,
 V_CURR_H_DATE,
 2,
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- DCLTN.DT_IS,
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),
--&&& END
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,
 NULL,
 :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR,
 DECODE(:DCLTN_HDR.LIC_TYPE,2,99,5,99,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD),
 :DCLTN_HDR.LIC_TYPE,
 :DCLTN_HDR.LIC_NBR,
 1,
 NULL)
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END ADD_CNTNR_WVR;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_TRF_EXEMPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADD_TRF_EXEMPTION IS
V_CURR_H_DATE DATE:= HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
V_DUTY_RATE NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 ------------------------
 SELECT tar_inst.INST_DUTY_RATE
 INTO V_DUTY_RATE
 FROM harmonized_tariff HT,
 group_items gro,
 tariff_groups tar,
 group_instructions ginst,
 tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE (
 (HT.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (HT.HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)
 AND (tar_inst.DECREE_STATUS = 1)
 AND (V_CURR_H_DATE >= tar_inst.eff_date)
 AND (V_CURR_H_DATE <= tar_inst.expry_date)
 AND (tar_inst.INST_TYPE BETWEEN 81 AND 90)
 );

---------------------------------------
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY <> NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY ,0) OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY <> NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY,0) OR
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST <> NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF ,0) THEN

 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS SET
 DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE = 1,
 DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR = NULL,
 DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE = NULL,
 DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ = NULL,--DM-313
 EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD = NULL,
 EXMTN_DECREE_ISN = NULL,
 EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ = NULL,
 EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ = NULL,
 AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN = NULL,
 AGRMNT_NO = NULL,
 EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD = NULL,
 EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN = NULL,
 EXT_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ = NULL,
 SYS_EXMTN_NBR = 1,
 SYS_EXMTN_SUB_NBR = 1,
 SYS_EXMTN_DT = V_CURR_H_DATE,

 EXMTN_RATE = V_DUTY_RATE/:DCLTN_ITEMS.L_INS_TRFD_DUTY_RATE,
 EXMTD_QTY = :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY * (V_DUTY_RATE/:DCLTN_ITEMS.L_INS_TRFD_DUTY_RATE) ,
 EXMTD_DUTY = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY * (V_DUTY_RATE/:DCLTN_ITEMS.L_INS_TRFD_DUTY_RATE),
 EXMTD_CIF = :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST * (V_DUTY_RATE/:DCLTN_ITEMS.L_INS_TRFD_DUTY_RATE),

 EXMTN_APRVL_DT = V_CURR_H_DATE,
 EXMTN_APPRV_USR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,
 EXMTN_NOTE = 'إعفاء رسوم بنود معانة من النظام'

 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN;

 END IF;
---------------------------------------------

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ------------------------
 END IF;

----------------------------------------

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DECLTN_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DECLTN_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'DCLTN_PARAM';

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار البيان');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;

 END IF;


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV(V_PORT_CD VARCHAR2, V_PORT_NAME VARCHAR2, V_PORT_TYPE VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'SD_PORT_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.PORT_TYPE := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME := NULL;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'الجمارك السعوديه');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.1);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_SD_PORTS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF V_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_CD, V_PORT_CD);
 END IF;

 IF V_PORT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_NAME, V_PORT_NAME);
 END IF;

 IF V_PORT_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_TYPE, V_PORT_TYPE);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_DCLTN_TYPES_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_DCLTN_TYPES_LOV(V_TYPE_CD VARCHAR2, V_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'DCLTN_TYPE_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.TYPE_NAME := NULL;
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'أنواع البيان الجمركي');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER,5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER,5);
 --IF :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID = 6841 THEN --
 IF :SYSTEM.CURRENT_FORM = 'DCLN2295' THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 END IF;

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_TYPE.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF V_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.TYPE_ID, V_TYPE_CD);
 END IF;

 IF V_TYPE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.TYPE_NAME, V_TYPE_NAME);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END CALL_DCLTN_TYPES_LOV;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 cust_clk Timer;
 SYSTEM_DATE VARCHAR2(20);
 SDATE1 DATE;
 V_FUN_ITEM_REC TMPLT.CUR_Fun_Items%ROWTYPE;
 x number := 0.0;
-- y number := 5.25;
 y number := 5.17;
 RET PLS_INTEGER;
 WND PLS_INTEGER;
 ENAB VARCHAR2(100);

begin
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY('CGSO$WINDOW_1',WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);

 WND := WIN_API_UTILITY.GET_ACTIVE_WINDOW();
 RET := SEC_DLL.IsWndCaptionDisplayed(WND);
 IF RET = 1 THEN
 TOGGEL_WND;
 END IF;

 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS );
 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_VIEW_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS_ON_CANVAS );
 TMPLT.HEIGHT := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', HEIGHT);


 TMPLT.LOAD_FUNCTIONS(:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 TMPLT.ENB_DIS_FUN_BUT;


 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', visible, property_true);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', display_position, x,y);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY ('TITLE', visible, property_true);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT1',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RE_ENTER_QUERY',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('LAST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FIRST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_UP',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_DOWN',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXECUTE',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.EXIT := 0;

 IF CHECK_TIMEOUT = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 hWind PLS_INTEGER;
 CheckTimer TIMER;
 BEGIN
 hWind := get_window_property(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_HANDLE);
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Start_Timer(hWind);
 CheckTimer := Create_Timer('CheckTimeout',120000,repeat);
 END;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID) = TRUE THEN
IF CHECK_EDI_MSG_TIMER = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN VARCHAR2(200);
 BEGIN
 V_VAR_VALUE := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'EDI_MSG_TIMER',30);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'MSG_DISPLAY_PERIOD',30);

 IF (V_VAR_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (V_VAR_VALUE > 0 AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN > 0) THEN

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('RETURN_EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('RETURN_EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
END IF;
END IF;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 0;
 :GLOBAL.TIMER := 0;
 :global.item_name := NULL;


BEGIN
SYS.DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.set_module (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME,'NEBRAS')||' '||nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,' '), NULL);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;
END;

 SELECT obj_version, obj_status
 INTO v_obj_version, v_obj_status
 FROM sc_sys_obj_ver
 WHERE sysobj_id = :parameter.p_module_id
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD /* Central By Nasser 20-02-2025 */ ;

 IF v_obj_version > nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,1)
 THEN

 THEN
 str.dispalert ('إصدار الشاشة الحالي ( '||nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,1) || ' ) قديم , من فضلك قم بالتحديث ', 'ERROR');

 IF v_obj_status = 1
 THEN
 EXIT_FORM ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;

--&&& END

 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 ITEM_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF INV_CNT = 0 AND ITEM_CNT <> 0 THEN
 SET_RELATION_PROPERTY('CGFK$DCLTN_IT_DCLTN_INV_FK', PREVENT_MASTERLESS_OPERATION, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;

 -- SEARCH FOR THE DECLARATION
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 EXECUTE_QUERY;

 -- ADJUST LAYOUT
 INIT_INV_ITEMS_FORM;

 IF INV_CNT = 0 AND ITEM_CNT <> 0 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('DCLTN_ITEMS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 ELSE
 GO_BLOCK('DCLTN_INVOICES');
 END IF;

 ELSE
 -- SEARCH FOR THE DECLARATION
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 EXECUTE_QUERY;

 -- ADJUST LAYOUT
 INIT_INV_ITEMS_FORM;

 GO_BLOCK('DCLTN_INVOICES');
 END IF;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 BEGIN
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 v_inactive_time NUMBER;
 V_msg_count NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'CHECKTIMEOUT' THEN
 v_inactive_time := Win_API_Session.Timeout_get_inactive_time;
 IF v_inactive_time >= 600 then
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Delete_Timer;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 1;
 BELL;
 EXIT_FORM (NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSIF v_inactive_time >= 360 then
 BELL;
 END IF;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_ERROR_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_MESSAGE_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'EDI_MSG' THEN
 for_edi_msg(V_msg_count);
 IF V_msg_count > 0 THEN
 BELL;BELL;BELL;BELL;
 :EDI_MSG.EDI_MSG_TXT := 'توجد رسائل بعدد '|| V_msg_count ||' مطلوب اتخاذ اجراءات عليها';
 TURN_MSG;
 end if;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'RETURN_EDI_MSG' THEN
 RETURN_MSG;
 END IF;
 WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG;
END;

--
--DESCRIPTION : DOUBLE DUTY
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 03-05-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_DOUBLE_DUTY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'INSERT_INV' THEN
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 GO_BLOCK('DCLTN_INVOICES');
 CREATE_RECORD;
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT := 0;
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT', FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.CHK_INV_CNT := 0;

 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'INSERT_ITEM' THEN
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT', TRUE);
 :DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT := :DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT + 1;

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DCLTN_INVOICES.ITEMS_CNT', FALSE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_INVOICES', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 GO_BLOCK('DCLTN_ITEMS');
 CREATE_RECORD;
 --BY SHERIFT 03-05-2005 --
 V_ITEM_DOUBLE_DUTY :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('ITEM_DOUBLE_DUTY',999),0);
 IF V_ITEM_DOUBLE_DUTY = 1 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('هل ترغب في إضافة رسم ثاني علي الصنف الجديد','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = alert_button1 THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNLTY_RQR := 1;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNLTY_RQR := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.PNLTY_RQR := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

 END IF;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TAB-PAGE-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$NEW_TAB_PAGE */
/* Show related canvases for this tab */
BEGIN
 IF( :SYSTEM.TAB_NEW_PAGE IN ( 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_1', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_2', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_3' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$TAB_CHANGED;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-DATABASE-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 :PARAMETER.P_NEED_PRINT :=0;
 :GLOBAL.INV_UPDT :=0;

-- by maih to fix message problem
if :GLOBAL.unit_inv_cost = 1 and :GLOBAL.unit_inv_cost_sv= 1 and :DCLTN_items.unit_inv_cost is not null then
str.dispalert(' لقد تم حفظ التغييرات على السعر الافرادى','information');
:GLOBAL.unit_inv_cost := 0 ;
:GLOBAL.unit_inv_cost_sv:= 0;
end if;


END;

BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DRCT_CLRNC =1 THEN
UPDATE DCLTN_INVOICES SET
 items_cnt =
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcltn_items WHERE
 DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD)
 WHERE PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
END IF;




END;
